Zakona) dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Prijavom na natječaj svaki kandidat daje privolu Osnovnoj školi Remete za obradu osobnih podataka u skladu s propisima kojima je propisana zaštita osobnih podataka za svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka i objave rezultata natječaja. Rok za podnošenje prijava kandidata je osam (8) dana od dana objave natječaja. Kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj smatrat će se samo osoba koja podnese pravodobnu i potpunu prijavu te ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja. Nepravodobne i/ili nepotpune prijave, kao i one koje ne zadovaljavaju uvjete iz natječaja neće se uzimati u obzir, a njihove podnositelje se neće posebno obaviještavati o tome. Kandidat/kinja koji/a je pravodobno dostavio/la potpunu prijavu sa svim ispravama odnosno prilozima i ispunjava uvjete natječaja dužan/a je pristupiti procjeni odnosno testiranju prema odredbama Pravilnika. Odluku o vremenu, mjestu i načinu održavanja procjene vrednovanja kandidata/kinje Škola će objaviti na mrežnoj stranici Osnovne škole Remete http://www.os-remete-zg.skole.hr s napomenom da se kandidati/kinje neće posebno pozivati. Obavijest o ishodu natječajnog postupka, objavit će se na mrežnoj stranici Osnovne škole Remete http://www.os-remete-zg.skole.hr najkasnije u roku od osam dana od dana sklapanja ugovora s odabranim kandidatom. U slučaju da se na natječaj prijave kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom propisu, kandidati će se obavijestiti prema članku 17. stavku 4. Pravilnika. Prijave na natječaj s potrebnom dokumentacijom kandidati dostavljaju neposredno (osobno) ili poštom na adresu: Osnovna škola Remete, 10 000 Zagreb, Remete 99a s naznakom „za natječaj: Kuhar/ica- Slastičar/ka 2“.

jobs.title: VODITELJ/VODITELJICA YUFE DIGITALIZACIJE I INTEROPERABILNOSTI SUSTAVA (YUFE HUB)
jobs.description:
SVEUČILIŠTE U RIJECI, Trg braće Mažuranića 10, raspisuje NATJEČAJ br. 20/26 za zasnivanje radnog odnosa na sljedećem radnom mjestu na projektu YUFEPulse Voditelj YUFE digitalizacije i interoperabilnosti sustava (YUFE Hub) - voditelj ustrojstvene jedinice 4 - na projektu YUFEPulse na određeno puno radno vrijeme (m/ž 1 izvršitelj/ica) Posebni uvjeti za zasnivanje radnog odnosa:
  • HKO-a 7.1.sv ili 7.1.st
  • najmanje dvije godine radnog iskustva
  • aktivno znanje engleskog jezika u govoru i pismu
  • napredno poznavanje rada na računalu
  • razvijene analitičke sposobnosti i sposobnost rješavanja tehničkih problema spremnost na kontinuirano učenje, praćenje razvoja digitalnih tehnologija te daljnje stručnousavršavanje
Opis poslova:
  • pruža podršku aktivnostima YUFE Pulse radnog paketa WP11: Digitalisation, posebice zadatku T11.2 (Interoperability Deployment and Partner Onboarding
  • sudjeluje u uvođenju YUFE Hub-a u produkcijsku i podržava njegovu operativnu stabilnost na Sveučilištu u Rijeci
  • koordinira i usklađuje proces uvođenja (onboardinga) i ostalih YUFE partnerskih sveučilišta u YUFE Hub, pružajući tehničke smjernice, dokumentaciju i podršku pri testiranju konektora
  • surađuje sa Sveučilišnim računskim centrom (SRCE) na razvoju i tehničkoj implementaciji sustava potrebnih za povezivanje Sveučilišta u Rijeci s YUFE Hub-om
  • doprinosi izradi okvira za dugoročno upravljanje interoperabilnošću i održivost digitalne infrastrukture Sveučilišta u Rijeci
  • obavlja sve ostale stručne poslove u području digitalizacije i interoperabilnosti sustava, po nalogu institucijskog koordinatoraili neposrednog voditelja
Probni rad 3 mjeseca. Pod radnim iskustvom podrazumijeva se vrijeme provedeno u radnom odnosu na poslovima odgovarajuće vrste i razine složenosti nakon stjecanja kvalifikacije određene razine prema Hrvatskom kvalifikacijskom okviru (HKO-u). Na natječaj se po jednakim uvjetima mogu prijaviti osobe obaju spolova. Pojmovi koji imaju rodno značenje koriste se neutralno i odnose se jednako na oba spola. U prijavi na natječaj pristupnici trebaju obavezno navesti osobne podatke: ime i prezime, datum i mjesto rođenja, adresu stanovanja, broj telefona, e-adresu, naziv radnog mjesta na koje se prijavljuju te napomenu o povratu natječajne dokumentacije. Prijavu na natječaj je potrebno vlastoručno potpisati. Uz prijavu na natječaj potrebno je priložiti: životopis, dokaz o traženoj stručnoj spremi (presliku diplome), elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje o radnom stažu (ne stariju od mjesec dana), presliku osobne iskaznice ili domovnice te ostale potvrde o zadovoljavanju uvjeta/prednosti za radno mjesto (preslike ugovora o radu odnosno druge odgovarajuće dokaze kojima se dokazuje zadovoljavanje uvjeta/prednosti za radno mjesto). Kao dokaz o odgovarajućem poznavanju engleskog jezika prihvatit će se potvrda ili certifikat o znanju engleskog jezika, preslika ocjena iz odgovarajuće isprave o obrazovanju ili vlastoručno potpisana izjava pristupnika o ispunjavanju navedenog uvjeta a kao dokaz o poznavanju rada na računalu prihvatit će se preslika uvjerenja ili potvrde, drugi odgovarajući dokaz odnosno vlastoručno potpisana izjava pristupnika o ispunjavanju navedenog uvjeta. Sveučilište zadržava pravo provođenja provjere znanja, vještina i sposobnosti kandidata pisanim testiranjem i/ili intervjuom. U slučaju provedbe navedenih provjera kandidati su im obvezni pristupiti, u protivnom će se smatrati da su odustali od daljnjeg sudjelovanja u natječajnom postupku. Povrat natječajne dokumentacije izvršit će se na zahtjev pristupnika. Pristupnik zahtjev treba navesti u tekstu prijave. Rok za podnošenje prijave je 8 dana od dana posljednje objave natječaja u odgovarajućim glasilima. Prijave s prilozima podnose se poštom na adresu: Sveučilište u Rijeci, Trg braće Mažuranića 10, Rijeka s obaveznom naznakom za natječaj - naziv radnog mjesta. O rezultatima natječaja pristupnici će biti obaviješteni. Sveučilište zadržava pravo djelomično ili u cijelosti poništiti natječaj i ne izabrati nijednog kandidata bez posebnog obrazloženja. Pristupnici koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema Zakonu o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti svu potrebnu dokumentaciju predviđenu člankom 103. predmetnog Zakona, prema popisu na poveznici: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf. Pristupnici koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (NN 84/21), dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti svu potrebnu dokumentaciju predviđenu člankom 49. predmetnog Zakona, prema popisu na poveznici: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Pristupnici koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (NN 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20) u prijavi na natječaj dužni su se pozvati na to pravo te priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, kao i dokaz o invaliditetu. Dokazom o invaliditetu smatraju se javne isprave o invaliditetu na temelju kojih se osoba može upisati u očevidnik zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom koji se vodi pri Hrvatskom zavodu za mirovinsko osiguranje. https://mrosp.gov.hr/najcesca-pitanja-i-odgovori-7348/zakon-o-profesionalnoj-rehabilitaciji-izaposljavanju-osoba-s-invaliditetom-7475/pod-kojim-uvjetima-osobe-s-invaliditetom-ostvarujuprednost-pri-zaposljavanju-7477/7477 Pristupnici kojima hrvatski jezik nije materinski jezik moraju priložiti dokaz o poznavanju hrvatskog jezika (razina B2) prema Zajedničkom europskom referentnom okviru za jezike. Prijavom na natječaj pristupnici su izričito suglasni da Sveučilište u Rijeci, kao voditelj obrade osobnih podataka, može prikupljati, koristiti i dalje obrađivati njihove osobne podatke u svrhu provođenja natječajnog postupka, sukladno odredbama Opće Uredbe (EU) 2016/679 o zaštiti osobnih podataka i Zakona o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka (NN 42/18).

jobs.title: Finance Manager
jobs.description:
What we’re all about

Quantexa is a global leader in AI-powered Decision Intelligence. As one of the UK’s fastest-growing technology companies, we’re on a mission to help organisations make better, more trusted decisions.

As we continue to grow globally, we’re looking for an ambitious and detail-oriented Finance Manager to join our Financial Reporting team, playing an important role in supporting accurate financial reporting across our growing international business.

At Q, we’re looking for people who share that vision — people who are curious, collaborative and excited to make an impact. People like you.

The Opportunity.

In this role, you’ll take ownership of key areas of the reporting cycle, working across multiple entities to ensure accurate and timely financial information. You’ll bring strong technical accounting expertise, support robust financial controls and help identify opportunities to improve how we operate.

You’ll also work closely with colleagues across Finance and the wider business, providing insight and guidance on financial matters and helping to ensure we have the right processes in place to support effective decision-making.

What You’ll Be Doing.

  • Support the Month-End: Play a key role in the month-end close alongside the Group Reporting team, owning accruals, prepayments and balance sheet reconciliations for your areas, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.

  • Lead Accounts Payable: Own the end-to-end accounts payable process, from supplier onboarding and invoice processing to payment runs, ensuring suppliers are paid accurately and on time with robust controls in place.

  • Own Project Accounting: Track the financial performance of specific initiatives, ensuring costs are captured, allocated and reported correctly, and providing clear insight to project stakeholders.

  • Manage Travel & Expenses: Oversee travel spend and the travel and expense systems used across the business, maintaining clear policies, driving compliance and identifying opportunities to control costs.

  • Strengthen Our Treasury Function: Contribute to the treasury function by building and maintaining cash flow models, producing cash reporting and forecasts, and managing our day-to-day banking relationships.

What You’ll Bring.

  • A professional accounting qualification (CIMA, ACCA or equivalent)

  • Proven experience in an operational finance role, with hands-on ownership of accounts payable, cash management and month-end processes.

  • Hands-on experience building cash flow models and forecasts, and working directly with banking partners.

  • Advanced Excel capabilities and experience tracking and reporting spend at a project or initiative level.

  • Experience managing and developing people and resources within an operational finance team, with excellent communication skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Industry experience within a high-growth tech or SaaS company.

  • Experience implementing or managing travel and expense systems (e.g. Ramp, Navan or similar).

  • Hands-on experience with ERP systems like NetSuite.

  • A track record of automating and improving AP, treasury or expense processes.

Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realise your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognised and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary & Company bonus

  • 25 days annual leave (with the option of buying up to 5 days, and rolling over up to 10), plus national holidays + your birthday off!

  • Pension scheme with a company contribution of 6% (when you contribute 3%)

  • Private Healthcare, including dental & optic cover

  • Life Insurance and Income Protection

  • Regularly bench-marked salary rates

  • Enhanced Maternity, Paternity, Adoption, or Shared Parental Leave

  • Well-being days

  • Volunteer Day off

  • Work from Home Equipment

  • Commuter, Tech and cycle to work schemes

  • Free Subscription to a meditation, relaxation and sleep app

  • Continuous Training and Development

  • Spend up to 2 months working outside of your country of employment over a rolling 12-month period with our ‘Work from Anywhere’ policy

  • Team Social Budget & Company-wide Socials

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know - we’re happy to assist.

No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Sales Director EMEA
jobs.description:
About Dotfile

Dotfile is building the AI-native Compliance Operating System for financial institutions. Our mission is to make compliance simple, safe and smart, helping financial institutions onboard customers, manage risk and operate globally.

 

Compliance remains one of the most manual functions in financial services. While most institutions still rely on fragmented tools and human-driven workflows, we believe AI is enabling a fundamental shift toward autonomous compliance. Our ambition is to build Level 5 Compliance: software that can gather evidence, investigate complex situations, assess risk and execute defensible decisions under defined policies.

 

Dotfile has grown into one of Europe’s fastest-growing compliance technology companies. Today, 100+ financial institutions across 15 countries rely on Dotfile for critical compliance operations, with a rapidly growing presence in the US.

 

We recently raised our Series A from leading US and European investors and software operators. We’re now entering our next chapter: investing heavily in product and AI, expanding internationally, and building the team that can make Dotfile the global standard for compliance infrastructure.

Overview

As a Sales Director EMEA you will be part of the leadership team, reporting directly to the CRO. You will be leading a team of Account Executives. Now that the company has a repeatable sales motion, your task will be to build a well-oiled revenue engine. You will drive ARR growth by hiring and developing sales talents, lead expansion in new geographies and segments, and set an upmarket trajectory to increase ACV.


The position is based in Paris and frequent travel is to be expected.

Responsibilities

  • Participate in the definition of acquisition, retention and expansion strategies that align with business goals. Spearhead our internationalisation efforts,

  • Work with your team to identify, nurture and execute on key opportunities to drive high value deals, serve as an Executive Sponsor for critical customer and prospect relationships

  • Build, mentor, and lead our sales team to exceed targets. Implement effective recruitment strategies to assemble a top-tier sales force

  • Oversee the creation of training programs, sales materials, and a comprehensive onboarding process. Own SalesOps, including revenue forecasting and tooling

  • Develop and maintain a strong network of customers, partners, and industry thought-leaders

  • Implement and operate the outbound acquisition machine ;

  • Lead cross-functional initiatives with with Marketing, Product and Solution Consultants to address new market segments

  • Be an ambassador for the company, participate in industry events and represent Dotfile

About you

  • Over three years of sales leadership experience in Enterprise SaaS or Fintech, ideally in the compliance and fraud sectors, utilizing a proven sales playbook (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message) and consistently exceeding quota and revenue goals.

  • Experience within the Financial Services industry

  • Prior success selling into large, complex environments with multiple decision makers

  • Proven track record of helping VC-backed startups go from $1M ARR to $10M ARR

  • Strong technical acumen and project management skills coupled with a data-driven mindset

  • Extensive knowledge and proven experience in conducting business across various sectors in the EMEA region. Native-level English and French proficiency

  • Successful experience building, managing and retaining high performing teams across multiple markets

  • A proven ability to build connections with industry subject matter experts and customer executives

  • Outstanding communication skills, high energy and deep empathy

  • Willingness to embark on the startup journey, get your hands dirty and close deals yourself

What we offer

  • A front row seat at a fast-growing startup with global ambitions

  • CEO and Board exposition

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Ability to work from our Paris Office

The interview process

  • Round 1: First conversation to get to know you, understand what drives you, and explore why this role excites you.

  • Round 2: Two-part discussion where you'll walk us through your career journey and the choices that shaped it, followed by a values-based conversation where you'll share real examples of how you demonstrate Ownership, Pace & Intensity, High Standards, and Resilience.

  • Round 3: Deep dive into one of your key projects with someone from a different team, offering a fresh, cross-functional perspective on how you work.

  • Round 4: Practical exercise, case study tailored to the role, giving you the opportunity to showcase your skills on a real-world challenge.

  • Round 5: Final conversation with our founders to discuss your long-term vision and explore how you see yourself growing with us.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Python/Django) - (F/H/X) - CDI
jobs.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏠 Where you'll fit in:

Kraken’s technology is written and maintained by a multi-discipline engineering team of around 1,400 people globally, which includes server-side, client-side, and mobile engineers. We follow an agile way of working, where individual teams are given the freedom to choose the tools that are most appropriate for managing their work.

Kraken is a great place to learn, work with talented engineers and level-up your skills. Some of our coding conventions are open-source.

 

Our technology

Our backend developers use Python. Most of our websites are powered by Django and GraphQL (Graphene). Our CircleCI CI/CD pipeline runs tens of thousands of tests, deploying into AWS EKS defined by Terraform over 100 times per day and observed with tools like Sentry and Datadog. This allows us to move fast and at scale, without compromising reliability. Teams work differently but the commitment to quality is the same.

Developers at Kraken are empowered to use cutting-edge AI tools and models. Any generated code is still owned by a human.

 

What we do

Kraken Engineering has multiple disciplinary groups with their own management structures and teams working together to create a unified Kraken that can be deployed to any territory in the world to achieve clients’ goals.

Client Engineering is the development arm responsible for making sure our clients receive the best possible experience and their needs are met with high quality solutions.

 

🚀 What you’ll own

  • We have lots of difficult design challenges to solve. The French energy market is complicated, outdated and process-heavy - there's an awful lot of domain modelling that we need to get right. Strong attention to detail is essential.

  • You will be working in a multi-disciplinary software engineering team; solving design challenges; domain modeling; solving technical problems; engineering solutions for smart meters, writing robust fault-tolerant software primarily in Python and Django, Celery, and async processing

  • We have challenging technical problems to solve; like processing tens of millions of meter readings a day. We need the right technology in place to handle this smoothly as well as feeding data into a machine learning pipeline that models and predicts consumption. Or thinking about how we adapt Kraken to improve other utilities like water and broadband.

  • There's a great opportunity for disruption in the French energy market. The big suppliers still dominate, but are not exactly popular. The energy landscape is changing as we move to more dis-aggregated forms of generation, with less predictability, more dynamism and smarter technology.

🧠 What you bring to the party

  • Python (minimum 7 y.e.)

  • Django (or equiv. web framework)

  • Fluent in French, and level B2 at least in English

  • Domain modelling

  • HTTP and REST APIs

  • Writing robust and fault-tolerant software

  • Celery and async processing

  • Postgres

⭐️ Bonus points

  • AWS

  • Terraform, Packer, Consul

  • React and Redux

Every email and notification we send is part of how customers experience Lendable, and a 5.0★ Trustpilot rating across more than 100,000 reviews sets a high bar for it: communication has to be clear, timely and honest. As our Senior Product Manager for CRM & Growth, you'll own the products and systems that shape how customers hear from us across their lifecycle, from first interaction through to retention and reactivation.

Product here isn't backlog grooming.   • 5+ years in product management, with substantial experience in CRM, lifecycle, messaging or growth for a consumer product at meaningful scale

  • Strong product management fundamentals: you've taken a product or channel from problem definition through launch and iteration, and owned both the product and the technical sides of delivery

  • A track record of owning measurable outcomes in engagement, retention or revenue, not just shipping features

  • Strong SQL and analytical skills, and experience designing and interpreting A/B tests, with the habit of measuring impact rigorously rather than relying on vanity metrics

  • Enough technical depth to work credibly with engineers on messaging infrastructure, deliverability and platform integrations, and clear communication across technical and commercial audiences

  • Experience launching a new channel or capability end to end, such as push notifications across mobile and web

jobs.title: Architect/Staff Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About OLIX

AI is growing faster than any technology in history and the explosion in demand has created a massive infrastructure gap; we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. The industry is still leaning on a ten-year-old hardware blueprint that has reached its limit. A new paradigm that is faster and more efficient will be the biggest economic opportunity of the next century and create the most important company of the next decade. The OLIX Decode Accelerator 1 (DX-1) is the first accelerator architected specifically for decode. Rack-scale co-design of logic, data movement, packaging, optics and interconnect enables a step change in system level performance.

The Role

As a Staff Embedded Software Engineer, you will be the design authority for a major area of the DX-1 platform firmware, within the overall platform architecture. This is the software that makes a rack of custom silicon bootable, manageable and observable, from pre-silicon simulation and FPGA prototypes through first silicon into production.

The kind of work you would own: bare-metal and real-time firmware on resource-constrained cores, embedded Linux on the platform processors, the BMC and management plane, and register-level control of the ASIC over its management link. You will report to the Platform Architect who leads the Embedded team and work closely with the FPGA, ASIC and Systems Software teams.

You bring exceptional depth on both sides of the hardware-software boundary, the judgment to identify what matters most and why, and the ability to influence and align engineering teams without relying on formal authority. It is a hands-on individual-contributor role. We will judge it by what others can build on: specs other teams work to, firmware that is ready when the hardware is, and designs that still hold up a year on.

Responsibilities

  • Lead a major area of the platform firmware. Boot and update, platform management or register-level control of the ASIC, agreed with you based on your strengths. Own its design, interfaces and roadmap within the platform architecture, and be accountable for it reaching production.

  • Make the interfaces explicit. Write down the contracts your area depends on and exposes, from register maps to update and telemetry flows, so the teams on either side can build against them.

  • Support bring-up and validation. When a bring-up or test problem turns out to be in boot, drivers or the management plane, you are the person who gets called. Help the teams running it get to the cause, and write up what you find so nobody has to rediscover it.

  • Define failure and update behaviour. How a fault in a node, rail or link is contained so it does not take out the rack, what gets logged so we can find the cause, and what happens if a firmware update is interrupted halfway.

  • Build things the team keeps using. Reference implementations, firmware tests on the infrastructure the validation teams already run, and contributions to the device models.

  • Pick the problems that matter. Identify the highest-impact technical risks in the platform firmware and at its interfaces to the FPGA and silicon teams, and make sure they get solved.

  • Develop the senior engineers around you. Review their designs as well as their code, set them up to lead areas of their own, and take an active part in hiring.

Skills & Experience

  • Depth on both sides of the hardware-software boundary. Bare-metal or RTOS firmware on resource-constrained cores, and embedded Linux BSP work (Yocto/OpenEmbedded, U-Boot or UEFI, drivers, device tree).

  • Systems fundamentals. Memory ordering and barriers, coherent and non-coherent shared memory, synchronisation with and without atomics, interrupt latency, and timing and memory-bandwidth budgets.

  • Taken firmware through a silicon or board bring-up, from pre-silicon simulation or emulation and FPGA prototypes to first power-on, and able to walk us through what went wrong and how it was found. More than one generation, or firmware for an ASIC whose tape-out you worked towards, is a significant advantage.

  • Platform management in a rack-scale context. OpenBMC or equivalent, Redfish, PLDM over MCTP, and the buses underneath (I2C/SMBus/PMBus, SPI, UART), including power sequencing and fault isolation.

  • Register-level control of an ASIC or large FPGA over a management link, including against a simulation model before silicon exists. Precision timing (IEEE 1588 PTP, White Rabbit, SyncE), SerDes or optical link bring-up, or secure boot would all be an advantage.

  • Technical leadership without formal authority. A specification, methodology, or tool you authored that teams outside your own adopted and still use, and the design document behind it.

  • Outstanding technical communicator. You can articulate architectural decisions and their consequences clearly to engineers, managers and senior leadership alike, and write design documents that other teams build to.

Compensation & Equity

  • Competitive Salary: Commensurate with your experience, skills, and location

  • Equity & Ownership: Meaningful stock options. You’re not just joining the mission; you’re owning a piece of it

  • Proximity Bonus: We value your time. To minimise your commute and maximise your life, we offer an annual Living-Local Bonus if your residence is within 20 minutes of the office

  • Retirement Benefits: Employer-contributed retirement plans to help you build long-term financial security.

Due to U.S. export control regulations, candidates’ eligibility to work at OLIX depends on their most recent citizenship or permanent residency status. We are generally unable to consider applicants whose most recent citizenship or permanent residence is in certain restricted countries (currently including Iran, North Korea, Syria, Cuba, Russia, Belarus, China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Venezuela). Applicants who have subsequently obtained citizenship or permanent residency in another country not subject to these restrictions may still be eligible.

About OLIX

AI is growing faster than any technology in history and the explosion in demand has created a massive infrastructure gap; we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. The industry is still leaning on a ten-year-old hardware blueprint that has reached its limit. A new paradigm that is faster and more efficient will be the biggest economic opportunity of the next century and create the most important company of the next decade. The OLIX Decode Accelerator 1 (DX-1) is the first accelerator architected specifically for decode. Rack-scale co-design of logic, data movement, packaging, optics and interconnect enables a step change in system level performance.


The Role

We're hiring a senior infrastructure engineer to own the internal platform our engineering teams build, test, and collaborate on, spanning AWS and on-prem compute, storage, networking, build and CI/CD systems, and the security that protects all of it, while working closely with our IT & Security team, who own identity, devices, and corporate security. You'll turn slow, manual, loosely secured workflows into fast, reproducible, and genuinely secure ones. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role with the freedom to define how internal infrastructure and its security work here from the ground up. If you care about engineering velocity, solid networking, best-in-class security, and a well-run technical environment in equal measure, there's a lot to dig into.

Responsibilities

  • Build and operate the platform: design, provision, and run the AWS, Kubernetes, and bare-metal infrastructure that powers development, simulation, and testing workloads.

  • Automate everything: own infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and provisioning pipelines so environments are reproducible, version-controlled, and fast to stand up or tear down.

  • Improve the developer platform: build and maintain CI/CD, internal tooling, and self-service workflows that let hardware, software, and compiler engineers ship without waiting on you.

  • Tune for performance: optimise networking (VLANs, firewalls, VPNs, and low-latency/high-bandwidth fabrics) and storage for the throughput and latency that chip design, compiler, and simulation workloads require.

  • Own reliability and observability: implement monitoring, alerting, and capacity planning, and drive availability and performance across hybrid cloud and on-prem environments.

  • Own platform security: implement least-privilege cloud IAM, secrets management, data protection, and network segmentation across self-hosted and cloud infrastructure, in partnership with IT & Security.

  • Isolate workloads: give each engineering group (chip design and EDA, compiler and agentic workloads, simulation) an isolated, independently scalable environment with clear cost attribution and strong protection for sensitive design data.

  • Drive continuous improvement: proactively find and fix the bottlenecks, manual steps, and reliability gaps that slow the wider engineering team down.

Skills & Experience

  • Deep expertise in infrastructure, platform, or DevOps/SRE engineering, with a track record of owning systems end to end.

  • Strong infrastructure-as-code and automation skills: Terraform, Ansible, and scripting in Python and Bash.

  • Solid networking fundamentals.

  • Hands-on AWS depth and experience operating across hybrid cloud and on-prem/bare-metal environments.

  • Strong grasp of infrastructure security: IAM, secrets management, network security, and hardening across cloud and self-hosted systems.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex, cross-layer issues in a fast-moving environment.

  • A collaborative communicator who can work with hardware and compiler engineers and explain infrastructure trade-offs clearly.

Compensation & Equity

  • Competitive Salary: Commensurate with your experience, skills, and location

  • Equity & Ownership: Meaningful stock options. You’re not just joining the mission; you’re owning a piece of it

  • Proximity Bonus: We value your time. To minimise your commute and maximise your life, we offer an annual Living-Local Bonus if your residence is within 20 minutes of the office

  • Retirement Benefits: Employer-contributed retirement plans to help you build long-term financial security.

Due to U.S. export control regulations, candidates’ eligibility to work at OLIX depends on their most recent citizenship or permanent residency status. We are generally unable to consider applicants whose most recent citizenship or permanent residence is in certain restricted countries (currently including Iran, North Korea, Syria, Cuba, Russia, Belarus, China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Venezuela). Applicants who have subsequently obtained citizenship or permanent residency in another country not subject to these restrictions may still be eligible.

Compensation: £169K • Multiple Ranges

  • London • Starting from £169K
  • Austin • Starting from $262K

jobs.title: Engineering Lead
jobs.description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an Engineering Lead with proven experience to help scale our platform, set technical direction, and build a high-performing team that delivers meaningful product experiences. You will be at the center of how we make complex data accessible, reliable, and impactful, guiding engineers to solve high-value challenges across data, product, and infrastructure. Our managers do more than oversee projects. They shape critical decisions that influence every part of product development.

We expect our leads to come from a highly technical background, as well as being masters of their craft, able to dive into details, sharpen fundamentals, and continually hone their skills. Cavalry officers must be able to ride horses. You are a skilled engineer with leadership experience, bringing not only a deep love for the engineering craft but also the recognition that your greatest impact comes from enabling others to thrive.

What you’ll work on

Every day is different, but here’s a dose of the kind of things you’ll be doing:

  • Build and guide a high-performing, cross-functional engineering team. Foster a culture where engineers feel motivated, empowered, and proud of the impact they create.

  • Stay engaged with technical design, code reviews, and architectural decisions, setting a high bar for technical excellence while balancing leadership responsibilities.

  • Translate ambitious product visions into scalable, production-ready solutions by making sound, data-driven technical and strategic decisions.

  • Partner closely with product managers, designers, and data teams to align on priorities, shape roadmaps, and deliver user features and platform capabilities.

  • Coach and develop senior engineers, enabling them to take ownership of technical initiatives and expand their influence across the organization.

  • Maintain a deep understanding of system architecture, performance, and reliability to guide long-term investment in stability and scalability.

  • Hire, onboard, and support exceptional engineering talent. Dedicate time to one-on-one conversations to understand motivations, build trust, and strengthen team dynamics.


About You

This role will be a great fit if you:

  • Proven experience leading high-performing engineering teams and delivering impactful products.

  • Have deep technical expertise, including in software development and system design. You will ideally have expertise in at least one of our core technologies (e.g., Python, TypeScript, AWS, Terraform) and experience designing and building scalable systems.

  • Product and design-oriented, skilled at translating user and business needs into high-quality solutions.

  • Effective communicator and collaborator across engineering, product, and design.

  • Passionate about mentoring, developing talent, and fostering inclusive, positive team culture.

  • Committed to operational excellence, long-term technical quality, and reliable systems.

  • Track record of shipping iteratively at a fast cadence while ensuring sustainable growth.

Benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

Financial & Insurance

  • Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

  • Equity

  • Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

  • Group Life Assurance

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

Time off

  • 25 holiday days per year

  • Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Training & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • Quarterly team socials

  • Summer and Winter company social events

Hybrid Policy

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your Talent Partner will share hybrid working details for this role.

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer - Remote
jobs.description:
About Us

Parity is one of the world’s most experienced companies building the core infrastructure behind blockchain — the system that allows information and value to be shared securely without needing an intermediary. We’re laying the foundation for a better web which respects the freedom and data of individuals, and empowers developers to build better, more trustworthy online services.


Our remote-first, global team develop open-source software that anyone can use or improve. This includes Polkadot, Polkadot SDK, and Kusama — key parts of the Web3 tech stack, the next generation of the internet. Our mission is to make Polkadot the most active and innovative community in blockchain, powering a new era of connected and decentralised applications.

About the Team

Parity’s Security Engineering team is at the forefront of protecting the Polkadot ecosystem by designing and implementing secure software, auditing code for vulnerabilities, and building cutting-edge ML tools to automate security analysis. We work closely with development teams to embed security best practices across our open-source stack, ensuring that our blockchain infrastructure is robust, resilient, and secure by design.

About the Role

As a security-focused software engineer, you will go beyond traditional application security - you’ll audit and ideally write secure Rust code where needed, conduct deep manual and automated code audits, and leverage machine learning to enhance security across our ecosystem. This is an opportunity to shape the security landscape of the next generation of decentralized applications and protocols.

  • Assist in developing Secure Software – Write and optimise Rust code to build security-critical components and tools.

  • Code Auditing & Vulnerability Analysis – Perform deep manual and automated code reviews to identify and mitigate security vulnerabilities.

  • ML-Powered Security – Design and implement machine learning models for automated security analysis, anomaly detection, and threat mitigation.

  • Bug Bounty & Vulnerability Management – Manage bug bounty submissions, triage security reports, and collaborate with ethical hackers to resolve issues.

  • Secure Development Best Practices – Work with engineering teams to integrate security best practices into the software development lifecycle.

  • Threat Modeling & Risk Assessment – Identify and assess security risks in our blockchain infrastructure, smart contracts, and core software.

  • Stay Cutting-Edge – Research and implement the latest advancements in secure coding, ML-driven security, and blockchain security.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience with secure coding practices and memory safety concepts.

  • Background in code auditing, vulnerability analysis, or exploit development.

  • Experience triaging and resolving bug bounty reports.

  • Knowledge of machine learning techniques applied to security (e.g., anomaly detection, fuzzing, automated threat detection).

  • Familiarity with cryptographic principles, blockchain security, or decentralized systems.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and an offensive security mindset.

If you're excited about writing secure software, auditing code, and pioneering ML-driven security solutions for Web3, we’d love to hear from you!

About Working With Us

Joining Parity means joining team mates who are genuinely excited about the impact their projects are having, and the opportunity to grow alongside some of the brightest minds in the Web3 space! You’ll work remotely and flexibly, while still getting to meet your team mates throughout the year at team and company-wide retreats.

Upon receiving an offer, all candidates undergo a background check through Zinc, our trusted third-party provider. Team members will be taken on as a contractor via our UK entity. View our Applicant Notice to see how we use your data.

Parity is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome diversity in our global team and care about everyone in our collective feeling included and welcome.

Is this position not quite your match? Browse our other open roles.

jobs.title: Business Development Specialist
jobs.description:
About Motorway

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

About the role

This is a consultative B2B sales role focused on driving platform adoption across UK car dealerships and encouraging active daily auction participation.

You’ll manage a varied portfolio of dealer partners across the UK, ranging from onboarding brand-new businesses and winning back lapsed accounts, to optimizing performance for established, regular buyers. Rather than hard-selling from a rigid script, your goal is to ask great questions, understand each dealership’s unique business goals and position the value of Motorway to demonstrate a clear ROI. You will ultimately build high-value, collaborative and long-term relationships.

Whether you’re delivering a powerful first impression to a new account or embedding repeatable, profitable processes into an existing or lapsed partner's daily routine, you'll act as a trusted advisor to help them win. We don't expect you to know everything on day one, but we do look for solid sales foundations, curiosity, and a drive to learn. We’ll back you with structured coaching, dedicated mentorship, and all the tools you need to succeed.

What You’ll Do

  • Consult & Position: Conduct high-level business conversations to uncover dealership needs, positioning Motorway as an essential, long-term inventory solution.

  • Drive Network Activity: Onboard new dealership partners, re-engage cold or lapsed accounts, and nurture regular users to drive daily auction participation.

  • Demonstrate Value Fast: Clearly articulate ROI to new or hesitant dealers while building repeatable, sustainable buying habits for mature accounts.

  • Pipeline Ownership: Maintain exceptional CRM hygiene using HubSpot to log activity, manage your pipeline, and report accurately.

  • Overcome Friction: Confidently navigate objections, address dealer pain points, and follow up consistently to keep conversations moving forward.

  • Collaborate for Impact: Work closely with cross-functional teams to resolve dealer challenges and feed market insights back to our product team.

  • Hit Targets: Take ownership of your numbers, proactively seeking coaching and feedback whenever you spot room to grow.

Who You Are

  • Sales Foundations: You have background experience in B2B or outbound sales, working comfortably against key performance targets.

  • Consultative Mindset: You ask smart questions before pitching, listening intently to tailor your value proposition to each business.

  • Adaptable Communicator: Exceptional telephone manner with the confidence to speak to business owners and decision-makers at all levels.

  • CRM Competent: Comfortable managing a pipeline and staying organised across a busy, diverse portfolio using HubSpot (or a similar CRM).

  • Resilient & Driven: Rejection doesn't derail you; it motivates you to follow up. You’re genuinely energised by hitting and exceeding targets.

  • Relationship Builder: You're motivated by true customer success and prefer doing things right over closing a bad deal fast.

  • Continuous Learner: You’re coachable and take ownership of your development.

Life in the Team

The B2B Sales team at Motorway is a tight-knit, collaborative group who work hard, celebrate wins together, and genuinely look out for one another. You’ll be encouraged to test new approaches, ask questions, and share ideas.

You'll be based in our multi-story, sea-fronted Brighton office located in the heart of the city next to Churchill Square, where vibrant culture and professional growth go hand in hand.

We offer a fantastic range of benefits to help you thrive

  • £26,000 starting salary (OTE £48,000)

  • Great work-life balance with standard shifts from 9am to 5:30pm

  • Sea fronted office location with regular social events, office drinks, weekly massages and free snacks to keep you going!

  • Flexibility to work from home 1 day per week to help nail that work life balance

  • Stock options so you can share in Motorway’s growth and future success

  • Pension scheme to plan for your future with our provider NEST

  • Strong commitment to your personal development including budget for books, courses, conferences, etc!

  • Opt-in comprehensive health insurance through BUPA including fitness discounts

  • Cycle to work scheme - save big ££ on a new bike and accessories

  • One paid volunteering day a year for you to use as you wish

  • Generous parental benefits including 6 months full paid maternity leave, 4 weeks paternity leave and and workplace nursery scheme

  • ... and much more!

jobs.title: Gymnasielärare i kemi och biologi till Berzeliusskolan
jobs.description: Söker du en roll där din kunskap och engagemang får vägleda elever genom deras gymnasietid? Hos oss blir du en del av en stor skola med stort engagemang och många kollegor. Välkommen till oss!Dina arbetsuppgifterUtgångspunkten för dig som lärare är att:    Arbeta med planering, undervisning, utvärdering och värdegrundsarbete utifrån läroplanen, både självständigt och i samarbete med kollegor.    Samarbeta med ämneskollegor för att driva och utveckla undervisningen.    Samarbeta med vårdnadshavare, kollegor och andra som förekommer i skolan för att nå en högre måluppfyllelse och skapa bästa förutsättningar för varje elev.    Utgå från den elevgrupp du möter och skapa en varierande och utmanande undervisning.    Använda digitala verktyg som en naturlig del i din undervisning.     Främja ett kollegialt lärande genom diskussion och reflektion vid såväl planerade som spontana tillfällen.    Ta tillvara på olika professioners erfarenheter och kunskaper, för att gynna elevernas lärande samt din egen och verksamhetens utveckling.I rollen ingår ett mentorskap, där du tillsammans med en kollega följer en elevgrupp över tre år. Tjänsten innefattar även handledning av elever i deras gymnasiearbete inom kemi och biologi. Din arbetsplatsBerzeliusskolan är en centralt belägen skola i Linköping med moderna lokaler. Här finns grundskolans högstadium, gymnasieskola och anpassad gymnasieskola. Gymnasieskolan omfattar naturvetenskaps- och teknikprogrammen samt introduktionsprogrammet med inriktning mot språkintroduktion och individuellt alternativ. Totalt finns ca 1900 studerande, varav drygt 1000 inom gymnasiet, och ca 330 anställda på skolan.På Berzeliusskolan jobbar vi tillsammans och strävar efter en atmosfär som välkomnar alla. Det betyder att vi har tydliga rutiner, handlingsplaner och en väl utbyggd elevhälsa för att skapa en trygg miljö för elever och personal. Vårt mål är att Berzeliusskolan ska vara det bästa valet för elevers lärande och utveckling.Du som sökerI första hand söker vi dig som har lärarlegitimation med behörighet att undervisa i kemi och biologi i gymnasiet. I andra hand söker vi dig med slutförd lärarutbildning för gymnasiet med behörighet att undervisa i kemi och biologi. Alternativt är du i slutet av din utbildning för att bli lärare i gymnasiet med behörighet att undervisa i kemi och biologi.Det är ett krav att du har erfarenhet av arbete i läroplansstyrd skola via praktik eller som anställd. Det är meriterande om du har undervisat i gymnasiet. Det är också meriterande om du har erfarenhet av att sätta betyg alternativt dokumenterat elevers lärande under läsåret.I din roll som lärare i gymnasiet behöver du:    Ha goda kunskaper om skolans uppdrag och vara väl bekant med läroplanen (Gy11/Gy25) och övriga styrdokument.    Ha en god kommunikativ förmåga i både tal och skrift i det svenska språket, för att organisera och genomföra arbetet så att eleven får stöd i sin språk- och kommunikationsutveckling enligt läroplanen.    Vara en god förebild.    Ha förmågan att anpassa din undervisning och göra eleverna delaktiga i utformningen av undervisningen.    Arbeta på ett kvalitetsmedvetet sätt för att skapa goda förutsättningar för elevens utveckling och lärande samt dokumenterar det.    Samarbetar väl med kollegor, vårdnadshavare och andra kontakter som förekommer i din yrkesroll.Övrig informationI denna ansökan bifogar du inget personligt brev. Du ansöker med e-legitimation. Saknar du e-legitimation? Kontakta ansvarig HR-konsult eller chef, så hjälper vi dig.Tillträde: 2027-01-07 eller enligt överenskommelseAnställningsform: TillsvidareanställningFör att tjänsten ska gälla tillsvidare måste lärarlegitimation uppvisas, fram till dess gäller visstidsanställning.Sysselsättningsgrad: 100%Antal lediga befattningar: 1Ref. nr: 17997Besök gärna https://www.linkoping.se/arbete-och-lediga-jobb/jobba-hos-oss för att ta del av medarbetarberättelser, förmåner, kollektivavtal och lönestatistik.Du som har en utfärdad lärarlegitimation samt behörighetsförteckning, vänligen bifoga dessa som filer tillsammans med dina ansökningshandlingar när du söker tjänsten. Är du utbildad lärare men ännu inte har ansökt om lärarlegitimation, vänligen bifoga utbildningsintyg eller examensbevis. Är du under utbildning till lärare, bifoga nationellt resultatintyg på hittills avslutade kurser vid högskola eller universitet. Tillsammans formar vi framtidsstadenLinköping är en av Europas mest innovativa städer och möjligheternas kommun. Med energi, mod och hjärta gör vi vår stad ännu bättre. Vi drivs av nyfikenheten och viljan att hitta nya lösningar. Och av att förgylla vardagen och förbättra livskvaliteten för våra invånare.

jobs.title: Forskningschef - till ...
jobs.description: VTI, Statens väg- och transportforskningsinstitut, söker nu en forskningschef till enheten Mobilitet, aktörer och planering.Om rollenDina arbetsuppgifter blir att, utifrån VTI:s verksamhetsmål, leda och utveckla enhetens verksamhet och medarbetare. Du har personal- och ekonomiansvar samt ansvarar för enhetens strategier och vetenskapliga kvalitet.Då verksamheten är uppdragsfinansierad är en viktig del av arbetet att hålla sig uppdaterad kring forskningsutlysningar och andra finansieringsmöjligheter och att ha goda kontakter med uppdragsgivare. Som chef har du ansvaret för att, tillsammans med dina medarbetare, generera nya forskningsidéer och ansökningar samt att initiera och genomföra olika FoU-projekt och satsningar. Arbetet innebär också eget deltagande i och ledning av forskningsprojekt.Som forskningschef är du en aktiv företrädare för VTI och enheten när det gäller samverkan i såväl nationella som internationella sammanhang. Du ska skapa goda förutsättningar för samverkan mellan andra forskningschefer och medarbetare för att bidra till VTI:s fortsatta utveckling inom transportforskningen. Det är också viktigt att bygga nätverk och hitta samarbetsmöjligheter med problemägare och också med andra forskningsutförare.Du rapporterar till chefen för avdelning Samhälle, miljö och transporter och ingår tillsammans med övriga forskningschefer på avdelningen i avdelningsrådet.Om digDu har doktorsexamen inom ett för tjänsten relevant tvärvetenskapligt område samt dokumenterad erfarenhet av chefskap med fullt personal- och budgetansvar.Du har god förmåga att initiera, utveckla och externt finansiera forskning samt erfarenhet av att leda forskningsverksamhet i en uppdragsfinansierad organisation. Vidare har du egen vetenskaplig produktion med dokumenterade resultat och god kännedom om det aktuella forskningsfältet. Vetenskapliga meriter utöver doktorsexamen, exempelvis docentur eller motsvarande vetenskaplig kompetens, är meriterande.Arbetet kräver utvecklade externa nätverk och intresse för marknadsföring och affärsmässiga kontakter. Du har därför en god kommunikativ förmåga och goda språkkunskaper i svenska och engelska.Om VTIVTI är en uppdragsmyndighet som bedriver tillämpad forskning och kvalificerade utredningar inom transportområdet. Vi är omkring 250 medarbetare och finns i Linköping, Stockholm, Göteborg, Lund och Skellefteå. VTI har en årlig omsättning på omkring 300 miljoner kronor.  Den tvärvetenskapliga enheten Mobilitet, aktörer och planeringsprocesser bedriver forskning som bl.a. är inriktad på hur transportpolitiska beslut påverkar vägen mot ett hållbart samhälle och hur trafikmiljöer påverkar människors trygghet och möjlighet att resa?  Forskningen kan delas in i tre områden:Transportpolicy och transportplanering – hur lokala, regionala och nationella beslut och planeringsprocesser påverkar transportsystemet i stort och omställningen till hållbara transportsystem.Mobilitet och tillgänglighet och handlar om hur social hållbarhet och transporträttvisa kan uppnås i transportplaneringen och hur människor involveras i beslut som påverkar deras mobilitet och tillgänglighet.Trygghet och säkerhet för personer som använder transportsystemet och befinner sig i olika trafikmiljöer samt arbetsvillkor för personer som arbetar i transportsektorn.Enheten har ca 20 medarbetare placerade i Stockholm, Linköping och Lund.Tjänsten som forskningschef är placerad i Linköping.Mer informationMer information om VTI och specifikt om enheten MAP hittar du här: https://www.vti.se/forskning/forskningsomraden/forskningsenheter/mobilitet-aktorer-och-planeringInformation om hur vi hanterar dina personuppgifter kan du läsa om på: https://www.vti.se/om-vti/personuppgifter Vi undanber oss alla erbjudanden om annonserings- eller rekryteringshjälp i samband med denna rekrytering.Ref. nr: 2026/0435-3.1AnsökanVälkommen att skicka in din ansökan, senast den 12 november 2026, med personligt brev, CV, examensbevis samt betygskopior och andra handlingar du vill åberopa. Ansökan som inkommer efter sista ansökningsdag kommer inte att beaktas.

jobs.title: Head of Finance / FP&A (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Du machst unser Wachstum steuerbar.

TEILE entwickelt und produziert High-End-Lautsprecher, DJ- und Audio-Equipment sowie Merch – Design-Objekte mit kompromisslosem Klang, von der ersten Idee bis zum fertigen Produkt. Eine Brand, die man nicht nur hört, sondern auch tragen will. Unsere Lautsprecher prägen den Sound von ausgewählten Clubs, Festivals, Bars, Hotels und Restaurants weltweit.

Hinter TEILE steht eine weltweite Community mit sehr hoher Reichweite auf Instagram – Menschen, die unsere Produkte nicht nur kaufen, sondern zeigen, teilen und weitertragen.

Gerade bauen wir neue Vertriebskanäle auf: eigener Onlineshop, Social Commerce, Handels- und Objektpartner sowie Kooperationen mit großen Marken. Wir wachsen schnell – und bisher ohne Finanzfunktion. Es gibt kein Controlling, keine strukturierte Datenbasis, keine Systeme, die miteinander sprechen. Genau das baust du auf – von der ersten Zeile an.

Deine Mission

Du wirst die Person, die TEILE steuerbar macht. Du bringst den Blick eines CFO mit und baust trotzdem gern selbst – vom ersten Forecast bis zur Datenpipeline.

Dabei arbeitest du direkt mit unserem CEO und dem Gründerteam zusammen und machst KI von Anfang an zum Kern unserer Steuerung: automatisierte Reportings, datenbasierte Entscheidungen und smarte Prozesse statt manueller Routinen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Finance & FP&A aufbauen: Planung, Forecast, Liquidität und Reporting – mit einer Steuerungslogik, die mit uns skaliert.
  • Profitabilität sichtbar machen: Deckungsbeiträge pro Produkt, Kanal und Projekt – von der Werkstatt bis zum Webshop.
  • Finanzierung begleiten: Darlehen, Working-Capital-Finanzierung und Investoren-Unterlagen.
  • Eine Datenbasis für alle: Shop-, Marketing-, Produktions-, Vertriebs- und Finanzdaten in einer Plattform zusammenführen (z. B. Shopify) – Dashboards statt Excel-Silos.
  • AI-First denken: KI und Automatisierung produktiv in Finance, Marketing, Supply Chain und Customer Service bringen.
  • Tech-Landschaft verantworten: Tools auswählen, Systeme verbinden, externe Dienstleister steuern.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Finance, Controlling oder FP&A – idealerweise in einem produzierenden Unternehmen mit physischen Produkten
  • Du hast Planung, Controlling und Reporting schon einmal selbst aufgebaut – nicht nur übernommen
  • Ein Plus: Hintergrund bei einer Big-4-Gesellschaft (PwC, KPMG, EY, Deloitte)
  • Datenaffinität: BI-Tools, Data-Warehouse-Logik, gern SQL – du baust selbst mit
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Tools und Prozessautomatisierung
  • Strategisch denkend, hands-on, pragmatisch – du brauchst kein großes Team, um zu liefern
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse
  • Ebenfalls ein Plus: Erfahrung mit Shopify und D2C

Das erwartet dich

  • Eine Schlüsselrolle mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum – du baust deinen Bereich von null auf
  • Direkter Draht zu CEO und Gründern, kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Ein Produkt, das man hört: High-End-Sound an besonderen Orten weltweit
  • Starkes Wachstum, neue Kanäle, internationale Projekte – und die Perspektive, ein eigenes Team aufzubauen
  • Homeoffice nach Absprache

Arbeitsmodell

  • Standort Freiburg im Breisgau (Produktion) oder Berlin
  • Vollzeit
  • Regelmäßige Präsenz vor Ort an beiden Standorten

Lust, TEILE mit aufzubauen?

jobs.title: CRO Manager e-commerce (H/F)
jobs.description:

Leads Power est expert en génération de leads. Nous déployons de plus en plus fort un pôle e-commerce spécialisé, avec une exigence : la performance ne s'arrête pas à la plateforme publicitaire, elle se joue aussi sur le site.

jobs.title: Tågtekniker EuroMaint Blackvreten - Håll Arlanda Express rullande!

Vi gör en bakgrundskontroll innan anställning erbjuds. Då denna tjänst är säkerhetsklassad ingår även en hälsoundersökning i rekryteringsprocessen, denna bekostas av oss. I denna rekryteringsprocess tillämpar vi löpande urval.Profilbeskrivning:Om EuroMaintEuroMaint erbjuder kvalificerat tekniskt underhåll som tillgodoser kundernas behov av väl fungerande fordonsflottor. Vi har ett nät av verkstäder från Luleå i norr till Malmö i söder, samt två verkstäder i Norge. Hos oss arbetar många specialister inom underhåll av järnvägsfordon. EuroMaint har en omsättning på ca 1 900 MSEK och cirka 1 100 medarbetare (2024). EuroMaint ägs av den börsnoterade spanska tågtillverkaren CAF sedan juli 2019.Våra värderingar:     Professionalism – vi strävar efter hög kvalitet, innovation och resultat.     Förtroende – vi arbetar med ärlighet, integritet och laganda.     Hållbarhet – vi tar ansvar för människor, miljö och framtid.

jobs.title: Tågtekniker EuroMaint Nässjö - Håll Krösatågen rullande!

jobs.title: Junior Business Data Analyst
jobs.description:
PIX4D is seeking a talented Business Data Analyst to bridge Finance, Product Management and Commercial Operations (Sales and Marketing), develop complex analytical tools to drive strategic decisions and optimize processes. You will be a member of PIX4D’s dynamic Finance team, in a hybrid work environment, based in Lausanne, Switzerland.

In this cross-functional role, you will query complex datasets, build dashboards, define KPIs, and translate emerging trends into actionable insights for stakeholders. You will balance data integrity with commercial impact, transforming raw data into insights that support high-level strategic decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Data Analysis & Reporting: Cleaning, manipulating, and analyzing large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies.
  • Dashboard Development: Creating interactive dashboards and reports using dashboarding tools and leveraging AI-powered tools for enhanced automation and visualization.
  • AI & Automation: Leveraging Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to streamline data workflows and enhance intelligent decision-making.
  • Database Querying: Using SQL to extract and prepare data from various systems.
  • Actionable Insights: Translating complex data into clear, actionable recommendations for business growth, efficiency, and optimization.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Working with cross-functional teams to define business requirements and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
  • Data Governance: Ensuring data integrity, accuracy, and standardization.

Requirements

  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in SQL, Excel (advanced), and experience using data visualization tools (e.g. Tableau, Power BI, Looker).
  • AI Proficiency: Familiarity with Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations.
  • Analytical Abilities: Strong statistical knowledge, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
  • Communication: Ability to tell a story with data to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Education/Experience: A master’s degree in business, economics, statistics, or data analytics, coupled with a first experience in supporting data-driven decisions.

What we offer

  • Exciting work with cutting-edge technology in an international company.
  • Well-located office near Lausanne, with easy access by public transport.
  • Flexible working hours and hybrid work possibility.
  • 25 days of paid vacation.
  • Employee Assistance Program with Lyra providing Mental, Legal and Financial assistance.
  • Contribution to some events: Bike to Work (the biggest health and cycling promotion campaign in Switzerland), Lausanne Triathlon.
  • Discounts for local stores, restaurants and other services.
  • Company Social Events.
  • Learning and professional development opportunities.

Working environment

PIX4D is a unique, fun, and intellectually stimulating company where you can grow and excel in your field. Our environment is authentic and multicultural, a place where we respect and learn from each other in the pursuit of being the best at what we do. Get more information here.

Recruitment

PIX4D promotes diversity and offers opportunities across all levels and career paths in all of its offices regardless of gender, race, or religion. We use standardized and structured interviews to ensure all candidates are treated equally and avoid any discrimination.

Company
When you work at PIX4D, you empower professionals worldwide to digitize reality through survey-grade georeferenced 2D maps and 3D models. These outputs can be measured, analyzed, and shared, all based on data from images taken by plane, drone, or mobile phone.

We build solutions that take advantage of technology including reality capture, computer vision, digital twins, and machine learning to help solve our customers' most complex challenges.

Founded in 2011, PIX4D has its headquarters in Lausanne, Switzerland and commercial and R&D offices in Denver, Berlin, Tokyo, Bucharest and Madrid.

Additional information

All our candidate applications are screened by humans and not an AI recruiter.
