jobs.title: Software Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.description:
About CircuitHub

CircuitHub is reshaping electronics manufacturing with The Grid, a factory-scale robotics platform that makes small-batch, high-mix electronics assembly radically more efficient. Think semiconductor-fab precision applied to the chaotic world of prototyping and low-volume production: a 10x throughput improvement in one of the world's most foundational industries.

We've raised $45M from top-tier investors including Plural, Y Combinator and Google Ventures, and we're already profitable. Our customers include a major EV maker, a top AI lab and many of the worlds largest companies.

The Grid isn't a prototype. It's live, scaling fast and delivering real revenue, and we're building the team that will scale it further.

The Role

CircuitHub makes electronics on demand. Engineers upload a circuit board design; we buy the parts, build the board in our own robotic factory and ship it. More and more of that business is now run by AI agents, and we want you to help build them.

These aren't chatbots. Our agents have real jobs:

  • They inspect boards. An agent checks camera images of every panel we build for wrong, rotated or missing parts.

  • They program robots. Agents read datasheets so our pick-and-place machines know how to handle each new part.

  • They watch the factory. They spot stray parts in robot storage, diagnose printer faults and clear stuck machines.

  • They run the back office. They book supplier invoices, chase late orders, explain quotes and triage bugs.

  • They write our code. Most of what our team ships starts in an agent session.

What you'll do

Find a process people still do by hand and automate it end to end: decide what needs judgement and what needs plain code, build the tools, and prove it works before it runs alone. Then make it cheaper, faster and right more often. You'll also improve the platform every agent runs on, and work closely with the people your work serves, from factory operators to finance.

How we build

  • Evals first. An agent earns the right to work alone: blind tests against people's verdicts, shadow runs beside the humans, replays of past decisions. We track accuracy and cost per run, and re-test whenever we change a model, a prompt or the effort level.

  • Agents judge, code writes. Agents return structured answers. Plain code checks them against a second source and makes every change.

  • Classical first, model second. Cheap vision and maths narrow the problem so the model only looks where it matters.

  • Safe by construction. Agents work in sandboxed cloud machines that never hold real credentials, and tool calls are built so a business action can't run twice.

Recent work

  • Image alignment ranks the parts on each board photo. The worst 20% of parts hold about 90% of real defects, so the agent only inspects those. In a blind re-run it caught all 13 defects operators had marked.

  • A photo check for stray parts in robot storage scored 10 out of 10 blind, at about 8¢ a photo. The model it replaced caught about half.

  • Agent tool calls leave durable receipts, so a session killed mid-deploy resumes without sending the same email or order twice.

  • Invoices extracted from supplier emails matched what a person had entered 66 times out of 66.

  • A constraint solver replans the whole factory every two minutes, across robots, ovens and people.

What we look for

  • You've put LLM agents into production and can tell us what broke and how you knew it was working.

  • You're a strong software engineer first. Most of this job is real engineering, not prompting: concurrency, idempotency, data modelling, security.

  • You build the eval before you trust the result.

  • You like the physical world: cameras, robots, parts rotated by 90°.

  • Bonus: computer vision, optimisation or electronics.

Stack

  • Agents: Claude Code, Codex, Claude and OpenAI APIs, MCP, skills in plain Markdown

  • Code: TypeScript (Bun, React), Python (FastAPI, Dagster, OpenCV, OR-Tools), PostgreSQL

  • Infra: Nix and NixOS, Nomad, Terraform, Vault, AWS, Modal sandboxes, OpenTelemetry

Als Mitarbeiter:in in der Kundenbetreuung bist du die Stimme von Nelly für Patient:innen. Mit Empathie, Klarheit und einem guten Gespür für Bedürfnisse begleitest du sie durch aufkommende Fragen. Du sorgst dafür, dass sich die Patient:innen unsere Kund:innen jederzeit gut betreut fühlen.

 

Über Nelly

Wir sind ein Tech-Unternehmen und glauben, dass sich Gesundheitsversorgung deutlich weniger nach Papierkram anfühlen sollte und viel mehr nach Menschen. Deshalb entwickeln wir Technologie, mit der medizinische Praxen einfach, effizient und ohne administratives Chaos arbeiten können.

Unsere Plattform verwandelt komplexe und zeitaufwendige Prozesse in intelligente, automatisierte Workflows – von der Patient Journey über Abrechnung bis hin zu modernen Zahlungslösungen. Und das Wichtigste zum Schluss: Wir arbeiten nur mit netten Menschen. Das ist unsere wichtigste Regel. Keine Egos, kein Drama, sondern neugierige, engagierte und empathische Menschen, die gemeinsam etwas Sinnvolles aufbauen wollen.

jobs.title: Global Investigator (Triage)
jobs.description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

As a Global Investigator on the triage team, you will be the first line of operational defense in a fast-moving crypto disruption pipeline. You will process inbound complaint data, validate outputs from our artificial-intelligence (AI) investigation platform, and route cases into the investigative pipelines that result in frozen scam proceeds and seized assets. You will hold the disposition pen: your call is what turns a complaint into a freeze, a takedown, a recovery handoff, a legal-process draft, a victim notification, or a close.

The impact you will have:

  • Validate and route hundreds of complaint dispositions per week, feeding a live asset-recovery pipeline.

  • Catch the AI errors that matter, such as false positives, merged syndicates, and misclassified scam patterns, before they propagate downstream.

  • Enrich complaint selectors using a stack of more than forty commercial data-source integrations.

  • Own clean shift handoffs so the around-the-clock operation never drops a lead, providing EMEA-hours coverage that keeps the queue moving while colleagues in other regions are offline.

What we’re looking for:

  • Investigative or analytical experience in the private or public sector. One to three years is fine: we want hungry people who want to grow into deep crypto expertise.

  • Strong AI fluency, meaning comfort using AI tools as a daily co-pilot, plus the judgment to know when they are wrong.

  • Excitement to deepen blockchain analysis skills.

  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced, fluid environment where the project's scope and emphasis may shift quarter to quarter.

  • Strong written and verbal communication.

About the Team:

  • The team is built around a mix of seasoned investigators and rising talent. Triage investigators sit alongside experienced crypto tracers and intelligence-trained individual contributors, and the seat is designed to accelerate your development.

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • Daily schedule: standard business hours in your local time zone.

  • Collaboration: coordinate with global teammates for handoffs on time-sensitive items, giving the wider operation near follow-the-sun coverage.

On-Call Responsibilities:

  • Formal on-call rotation for high-priority events, such as hacks, law-enforcement support, and other time-sensitive matters.

  • Weekly rotation, with occasional weekend coverage as needed.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • React quickly to incoming complaint surges and live takedown events.

  • Continuously learn new patterns in crypto-enabled crime.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

About the role:

In 2027, Upvest is launching the PEA (Plan d'Épargne en Actions) on the French market with several leading fintechs. Within the Settlements & Transfers team, you will work across the full post-trade chain of securities account and PEA transfers: from instruction processing to settlement at Euroclear France, including relations with account keepers, custodians and issuers.

This internship offers direct exposure to French and European post-trade operations during a product launch, with real responsibilities from your first weeks.

What you’ll do:

  • Incoming and outgoing transfers: Handle securities account (CTO) and PEA transfers with banks and brokers in France and across Europe, from receipt of the request to settlement of securities and cash.

  • Counterparty and client relations: Ensure smooth communication with counterparties (banks, brokers, custodians) and our clients, and drive the follow-up of requests and reminders.

  • Controls and reconciliation: Check securities and cash positions, reconcile movements with our custodian and analyse breaks.

  • Fails and exception management: Investigate unsettled or rejected instructions, identify the root cause and coordinate resolution with counterparties and internal teams.

  • PEA tax continuity: Review and record PEA tax statements (bordereaux d'information) to ensure the plan's tax history is fully preserved.

  • Registered shares: Process operations on French registered shares (conversions, de/registrations).

  • Reporting and continuous improvement: actively monitor SLAs and KPIs, write operating procedures and identify automation opportunities.

What you bring:

  • Experience: A first experience in banking, back office, middle office or securities operations is a strong plus, as is knowledge of the PEA, post-trade or Euroclear France.

  • Analytical mindset: Rigour, attention to detail and a taste for solving complex problems.

  • Tools: You're confident with spreadsheets ; knowledge SQL/Python is a plus.

How we Upvest in you:

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

  • Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

  • Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem Black at Upvest, Up&Out, and UpVergent.

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us:

DeepJudge is Switzerland’s leading AI and ICT scale-up, transforming how law firms and legal departments access and leverage their knowledge. Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, and backed by top-tier Silicon Valley investors, we are building the intelligence layer that powers the legal industry.

Every firm can license the same AI models, but no two firms share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often trapped across systems, underused and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure, enabling firms to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn experience into a lasting advantage.

Our technology is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms, including Freshfields, Gunderson Dettmer, Holland & Knight, Arent Fox, and Cozen O’Connor. Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America, we are expanding rapidly and shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move fast, think rigorously, and care deeply about what we build. We combine cutting-edge research with close collaboration with our clients to deliver solutions that truly make an impact. If you want to be part of a team defining how AI transforms high-stakes knowledge work, this is the place to do it.


About the role:

As a Site Reliability Engineer at DeepJudge, you own the reliability of the systems that leading law firms depend on every day. We run our AI search platform in dedicated production environments, each a large-scale search and retrieval system operating at very high data volumes, alongside our ingestion pipelines and data stores, on container-orchestrated infrastructure across multiple public and private clouds. Keeping those environments fast, available, and trustworthy is a genuine engineering challenge, and it's your mission.

This is a technical, infrastructure-focused role: you'll spend your time in systems, code, and telemetry. You'll harden the platform so that classes of failure can't recur, build observability and SLOs to let us see problems before they surface, plan capacity ahead of relentless data growth, and automate away the toil of safely operating many production environments. You'll work across our deployment and infrastructure-as-code and partner closely with product engineering to feed reliability learnings back into the platform. If you like operating serious distributed systems at scale and turning firefighting into engineered reliability, this role is for you.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Owning the availability, latency and performance of our production environments: large-scale search and retrieval services, ingestion and data stores on container-orchestrated infrastructure across multiple public and private clouds

  • Owning the cloud infrastructure across multiple public and private clouds, networking, identity and access, compute and storage, and managing cloud capacity, quotas and cost as the fleet grows

  • Improving deployment and infrastructure through code: GitOps-based configuration and deployment and infrastructure-as-code across our public and private clouds, with safe, previewed, recoverable production changes

  • Defining and instrumenting SLOs and error budgets and building the dashboards, metrics and alerting that make production observable and actionable

  • Reducing operational toil through automation and internal tooling written in Python and / or Go

  • Provisioning and standardizing new production environments to a defined reliability bar

You're a great fit if you:

  • Have 3+ years in SRE, production / platform engineering, or infrastructure-heavy software engineering, operating real production systems under reliability expectations

  • Are strong at container-orchestration operations in production and comfortable on at least one major public cloud

  • Have solid cloud infrastructure experience on a major public cloud and a working grasp of cloud capacity, quotas, and cost

  • Practice observability hands-on with metrics, logs and traces, and use it to root-cause live incidents

  • Work fluently with infrastructure-as-code and GitOps

  • Can code in Python and / or Go for automation, tooling, and reading and patching service code.

  • Bring sound production judgment and document your work clearly for other engineers

  • Bonus: experience operating a large-scale search or distributed data system, database operations, dedicated / enterprise-deployed software, or AI / enterprise-search infrastructure in regulated domains

What you can look forward to:

  • Owning the reliability of systems that the world's leading law firms rely on: real scale, real impact

  • Deep, hands-on work with modern infrastructure: distributed search at very large scale, container orchestration across multiple clouds, and a mature infrastructure-as-code and GitOps stack

  • A rigorous, high-urgency engineering culture founded by ex-Google search engineers and ETH Zurich AI PhDs

  • The chance to build the reliability discipline, SLOs, incident practice, automation, from a strong foundation, not inherit a rigid one

  • A collaborative team in Zurich shaping how AI transforms professional knowledge work

At DeepJudge, we believe great teams are built on diverse perspectives and experiences. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

 

If this role excites you, but you feel you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway and tell us why you’d be a great fit.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
Who we are

Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.

We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi. The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level.

We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter, Noah Hollmann, and Sauraj Gambhir, and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun.

In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years.

The role

You will be our first dedicated engineering leader, reporting to the CTO with a direct line to both founders - no layers in between.

Today, engineering at Prior Labs is a small, very senior team. We plan to grow it substantially over the next 18 months, and your job is to build and run that organization.

We want to be honest about what this job is. It is a hands-on operator role: managing engineers, building the hiring machine, setting standards, running compliance, and working closely with our partners at SAP. If you light up at making an organization fast rather than at owning the biggest possible headcount, this is your role.

What you'll do

  • Directly manage and grow the engineering team, including building out its management layer.

  • Build the hiring machine: run hiring operations across our hiring managers, design interview loops that hold up in the AI era, and keep a very high bar while the team grows.

  • Own engineering standards and velocity: how we review, test, and ship - and how the team gets real leverage from AI coding tools.

  • Own our security and compliance program - SOC 2, GDPR, ISO 27001 - right-sized, so the lab keeps its speed.

  • Own the engineering side of our collaboration with SAP.

  • Treat the deployment layer as a product surface: our models reach customers through a managed API, customer VPCs, and self-hosted open weights, and the engineering behind that needs customer empathy, not just platform craft.

  • Act as a sparring partner to the founders on org design and engineering direction - we're hiring someone who will argue with us.

What we're looking for

  • You have directly led an engineering organization of 10+ people, including through managers or leads, and you can talk concretely about how you built it.

  • You have owned platform or infrastructure scope at scale: serving, APIs, availability, cloud and vendor budgets.

  • You have worked in both startups and large organizations - you can create structure from scratch and hold your own with a very large partner.

  • You scaled an engineering org through a real growth phase (25 to 60+ or similar), building the management layer along the way.

  • You have led engineering in a research- or ML-heavy organization and know how research code and production code differ - and how to bridge them without slowing research down.

What sets you apart

  • You have led engineering through an acquisition, working directly with the parent company.

  • You have personally changed how your team works because of AI coding tools, and can show what it did to output.

  • You have operated under SOC 2 / ISO-style audit regimes; having built or run the function yourself is a plus.

Life at Prior Labs

You'll work alongside researchers and builders who hold themselves to a very high bar - in the quality of their work and in how they work with each other. We move fast and still take the time to do things right.

Our teams are based in Berlin, Freiburg, and New York - when you're working on something as hard as TabPFN, being in the same room matters. But great people come from everywhere, and in exceptional cases we're open to remote, which usually means frequent travel to one of our offices. Wherever you're based, the whole company comes together regularly for offsites to build and celebrate together.

Our Commitments

The best products and teams are built by people with a wide range of perspectives and backgrounds. We welcome applications from all identities and walks of life - especially if you've ever felt discouraged by "not checking every box" - and provide equal opportunities regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disability, or any other trait that makes you who you are.

We care about how your data is handled - see our Recruiting Data Privacy page

jobs.title: Knit - Research Manager
jobs.description:
Knit is the AI-native consumer research platform helping brands automate and accelerate primary research. With our Researcher-Driven AI, we’ve condensed the entire quant + qual research process from weeks into days (sometimes hours!) for 50+ enterprise brands — including Amazon, T-Mobile, Mars, NASCAR, and more. We’re on a mission to scale and democratize world-class research. From survey generation to stakeholder-ready reports, our platform is redefining how insights teams operate — and we need your help to push the limits of what’s possible.


Overview

The purpose of the Research Manager role is to ensure Knit customers successfully achieve their desired research outcomes through their partnerships with Knit. By owning and supporting customer relationships, getting deeply engrained in customer research needs, and driving high-quality project deliverables, the Research Manager’s impact is ultimately measured by positive customer retention.

Responsibilities:

The research function is a primary contributor to Knit’s shared business objectives of customer retention and upsells, ultimately measured by Net Revenue Retention (NRR) in addition to supporting successful Pilot to Subscription Conversions for acquiring new business.

The levers the Research Manager role owns to influence these key business objectives are:

  • Research Success → Ensuring Knit Customers successfully achieve their desired research outcomes through their projects with Knit, measured by successfully achieving Research Objectives and delivering on Knit’s Quality & Speed service-level agreements (SLA’s)

Primary responsibilities of this role:

  • Serving as the dedicated research lead for all customers’ projects (on assigned accounts) and serving as the ultimate accountable part for research project success

  • Driving and documenting in-depth project scoping to uncover a deep understanding of research objectives and project context to set up project success

  • Demonstrate a growth mindset as a solutions architect for customers, educating them on Knit’s research capabilities, consulting with them to adjust for fringe requirements, and proposing solutions to maximize project success - escalating to Research Directors when needs exceed capabilities

  • Escalating needs to Research Directors to support troubleshooting when increased risk for project viability or customer impact occurs

  • Driving, maintaining, and enriching all customer context to improve Knit’s ability to meet the customers’ custom research needs

  • Being the final, customer-ready check and approver on all Knit final topline delivery and presenting the key insights and recommendations directly to the customers

  • Participating in continuous innovation on Knit’s AI product to minimize the delta between Knit’s AI output and a human researcher output

  • Driving on feedback collection on “the last mile” - uncovering and documenting what happens after Knit delivers a project to when it’s “stakeholder ready,” supporting Knit’s product vision in getting to stakeholder ready reports

Required Skills & Experiences:

  • Must have 5+ years of market research experience, with the majority of the time spent on the supplier side in a market research agency environment.

  • Must have experience leading discovery and scoping calls, writing and editing quant and qual questionnaires from scratch, drafting analysis plans, and creating and presenting stakeholder-ready insights topline & reports.

  • Ability to drive initiatives and outcomes in ambiguous environments, both for navigating complex customer needs and Knit internal business changes. Proven track record successfully operating in an early stage startup (<50 employees) is a plus.

  • Proven track record of owning and supporting client relationships with customers at Enterprise, Fortune 500 US-based companies, specifically working with insights professionals to scope and achieve desired research outcomes, resulting in customer retention and growth.

  • Ability to drive initiatives and outcomes successfully in environments with competing priorities, multiple research projects on at a given time, and simultaneous internal business demands.

Benefits

Upon joining the Knit team, you will receive a competitive salary + commission plan if applicable to role, Equity Options, Healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), and Additional Coverage, a company laptop and one-time, onboarding Technology Stipend, a 401(k) with company match, flexible time-off, hybrid working, and more!

Salary

In accordance with New York pay transparency requirements, the salary range for this role is $115,000 - $130,000. Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate’s level, experience, and qualifications upon joining Knit.

Our Company Values

We are the Championship Team. This means we:

  • Are 1% better every day: We approach situations with a growth mindset and ask, “How can we make the business better?” and “What would it take?”

  • Play to win: We set audacious goals and push ourselves to achieve them with a bias towards action (When we see a need, we take initiative, and hold ourselves accountable to seeing it through).

  • Keep the main thing the main thing: Identify what has the biggest impact and prioritize to focus on it.

jobs.title: Lärare i fritidshem Sörgårdsskolan
jobs.description: Östersund är upplevelsemetropolen i hjärtat av naturen, med fjäll runt knuten och evenemang i världsklass. Här varvas aktivt friluftsliv med utvecklande arbetsliv, det är nära till jobb, vänner och skola. Östersund är också den expansiva universitetsstaden, där forskning och näringsliv utvecklas tillsammans, samtidigt som nya stadsdelar uppstår och utbuden breddas. Östersund är spännande nu, och du är välkommen att växa med oss.Sörgårdsskolan i Brunflo ligger cirka 1,5 mil utanför Östersund, fint belägen med idrottsanläggningar, badhus och fina skogsområden i skolans närhet. Skolan har för närvarande cirka 110 elever i åldershomogena klasser i årskurs F-3.  ArbetsuppgifterSom lärare i fritidshemmet på Sörgårdsskolan bedriver du undervisning i fritidshemmet tillsammans med andra pedagoger samt deltar som resurs i skolarbetet i någon/några klasser. Du arbetar i skolans arbetslag där du tillsammans med kollegorna bedriver verksamhet med aktiviteter som följer uppsatta mål.Fritidshemmet har två avdelningar. På fritids bedriver vi vårt huvudsakliga systematiska kvalitetsarbete och kompetensutveckling främst på ca 6-7 planeringsdagar, inbland delvis samtidigt med skola, arbetskvällar ca 5-6 gånger per år, ca kl.16-18, därutöver planeringar enskilt och avdelningsvis.Både skola och fritidshem är aktiva i värdegrundskonceptet PAX som syftar till att skapa lugn, trygghet, glädje och studiero. Vi arbetar ständigt med att utveckla lärandet för elever och personal i fritidshemmet genom planerad fri lek och styrda aktiviteter för att uppnå mål och centralt innehåll i Läroplanen.Stor vikt läggs på att utveckla elevernas sociala förmågor för att de ska kunna ta ansvar för sig själva och andra.KvalifikationerVi söker dig som är legitimerad lärare med behörighet fritidshem, men vi tar gärna emot obehörig personal med likvärdig utbildning och erfarenhet.Med ett tydligt pedagogiskt ledarskap skapar du en trygg, utvecklande och inspirerande lärmiljö. Du har god samarbetsförmåga, är flexibel och tar egna initiativ i det dagliga arbetet. Med gott omdöme bygger du positiva relationer med elever, vårdnadshavare och kollegor. Du ser möjligheter, är engagerad i elevernas utveckling och vill bidra till att utveckla verksamheten tillsammans med ditt arbetslag. Du utvecklingsbenägen och är i allmänhet en lugn och stabil person som sätter eleven i främsta rummetDu förstår att många barn är i behov av stöd i det sociala samspelet och att vi vuxna har en tydlig roll i att vara ett stöd i detta arbete.Tjänsten är krävande och vi lägger stor vikt på personlig lämplighet. Så går rekryteringen tillEftersom du kommer att arbeta inom skolväsendet krävs att du uppvisar ett registerutdrag från Polismyndigheten (belastnings- och misstankeregistret för arbete inom skola/förskola) innan en eventuell anställning. Du beställer detta på polisens hemsida. OBS! Detta ska inte bifogas i intresseanmälan, utan visas längre fram i rekryteringsprocessen. Intervjuer kan ske löpande. Vi vill att du bifogar CV och personligt brev i din ansökan. Betyg/intyg behöver inte skickas med. Det ber vi dig komplettera med om det blir aktuellt med en intervju.Östersunds kommun har före annonsering övervägt val av annonseringskanaler och undanber sig därför samtal från rekryteringsfirmor och annonsförsäljare.Vad erbjuder vi?Östersunds kommun erbjuder dig förmåner så som betald semester från första anställningsåret, semesterväxling, friskvårdsbidrag eller friskvårdstimme. Via vår förmånsportal får du ta del av oberoende pensionsrådgivning och en mängd rabatter och erbjudanden. Du kan dessutom få snabbt och professionellt stöd från olika specialister, som till exempel psykologer, jurister och ekonomer, genom tjänsten Personalstöd. Du kan läsa mer om våra förmåner på vår hemsida: https://www.ostersund.se/naringsliv-och-arbete/jobba-hos-oss/sa-har-jobbar-vi/lon-och-formaner.html  Om Barn- och utbildningsförvaltningenFörändra världen på riktigt! Att jobba med Östersunds alla barn och ungdomar är att vara med och bygga samhället och förändra vår värld, både globalt och lokalt. Det är viktigt. På riktigt. Här arbetar vi med förskola, grundskola och den anpassade grundskolan.

jobs.title: System Architect
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced System Architect with a passion for intelligent building management systems, industrial automation, and safety-critical applications? At Deerns, you will have the opportunity to work on innovative and challenging projects that contribute to a smarter, safer, and more sustainable future. Read on and discover how you can make an impact.

The challenge 

The System Architect for Intelligent Building Management Solutions and Industrial Automation plays a crucial role in designing integrated automation solutions for both buildings and industrial processes. This position involves developing safe, efficient, and future-ready systems that connect various installations, such as HVAC, lighting, access control, gas safety, and industrial process control. You will work closely with project teams, suppliers, and end-users to create innovative and sustainable solutions that meet the highest safety standards.

Your responsibilities include: 

  • Developing automation architectures: Design scalable solutions for intelligent building management and process automation, including gas detection systems, safety mechanisms, and process control.

  • System integration: Connect installations using protocols like BACnet, Modbus, KNX, and industrial standards such as OPC UA and PROFIBUS.

  • Gas safety and process safety: Develop solutions for gas detection, emergency shutdowns, ventilation integration, and fail-safe control systems for industrial environments.

  • Specification and standards management: Implement relevant standards for intelligent building management solutions, process automation, and safety systems, such as IEC 61511 (functional safety) and ATEX regulations.

  • Process optimization: Analyze and optimize industrial processes and systems to enhance efficiency, safety, and sustainability.

  • Stakeholder management: Collaborate effectively with various stakeholders, including clients, end-users, engineers, and project managers, ensuring solutions meet both functional and technical requirements.

  • Continuous learning and development: Stay updated on the latest innovations in smart technologies and automation, applying these to develop improved, future-proof solutions. • Technological consulting: Identify innovations to enhance performance and reliability in intelligent buildings and industrial environments.

jobs.title: Psykologer och psykoterapeuter för relationella behandlingar
jobs.description: Emotivum är en privat psykoterapimottagning på Kungsholmen i Stockholm, grundad år 2020. Vi är ett team av anställda psykologer och psykoterapeuter som vill göra oss tillgängliga för människor som önskar hjälp med att kunna ta bättre plats i sina egna liv och i sina relationer. Vi tror att det förändringsarbetet sker just i relationer, och betraktar oss därför som en relationsmottagning: både i rummet med patienten och i hur vi arbetar med varandra. Tillsammans bygger vi den mottagning vi själva vill arbeta på, och nu växer vi: inom kort öppnar vi ytterligare en mottagning i Stockholm.Nu söker vi fler kollegor som vill arbeta terapeutiskt och bygga mottagningen tillsammans med oss. Vi tar emot klienter i både långa och kortare behandlingar, individuellt och i par. Det är en fördel om du har intresse och erfarenhet av att arbeta uthålligt och relationellt i individuell terapi med mer komplexa kliniska relationer. Exempelvis personer med traumtisering, dissociation eller sköra personlighetsstrukturer. Det avgörande för oss är aldrig en viss metodbakgrund utan snarare en hållning: förmågan och viljan att gå in i det svåra och stanna kvar i det, ofta över långa behandlingar.Vårt fält är hur vi knyter an och hur vi älskar: de band som formar oss tidigt, och de vi själva söker och bygger som vuxna. Det handlar om kärlek, sexualitet och föräldraskap. Det är där vi kommer i kontakt med våra djupaste känslor, där vi kan skadas som mest, och där det som en gång gjort ont väcks till liv igen. Vi närmar oss trauma genom den inre upplevelsen: som det som inte har kunnat kännas, delas eller läka, och som därför fortsätter att upprepas. Hos den enskilde kan det visa sig som dissociation, som skörhet, eller som ett liv som på något annat sätt har blivit begränsat. Ofta upprepas det också i den terapeutiska relationen själv, och där kan förändring ske. Vi tror på den subjektiva upplevelsen. Med det menar vi att känslor och upplevelser i någon mening alltid är sanna. Inte nödvändigtvis som en beskrivning av vad som hände, men som ett uttryck för hur det var att vara med om det. Det är där arbetet börjar.Hos oss möts patienterna först av vår matchningsprocess, där vi som mottagning tillsammans tar ansvar för att hitta rätt terapi och rätt terapeut för den enskilda personen. Ofta pågår parterapi och individuell terapi samtidigt, med flera av oss kring samma par. Genom det vi skriver och delar på webben och i sociala medier kan patienterna också ha en relation till Emotivum som helhet, vid sidan av relationen till sin terapeut. Det gör dem till mottagningens gemensamma patienter snarare än någons egna, och det är det som ger dig klinisk frihet i hur du arbetar, och som gör att du aldrig står ensam med en svår kontakt. Vi strävar efter att varje behandlare ska ha en klientmix som passar både dennes intressen och förmågor. Det tunga bär vi tillsammans.Vårt arbete vilar på gemensamma perspektiv: psykodynamisk teori, anknytning, det relationella, common factors, sexualitet som perspektiv och det salutogena.Tjänsterna är på 80–100 %, och vi anpassar efter dig och uppdraget. jobs.title: Psykologer och psykoterapeuter med inriktning på parterapi
jobs.description: Emotivum är en privat psykoterapimottagning på Kungsholmen i Stockholm, grundad år 2020. Vi är ett team av anställda psykologer och psykoterapeuter som vill göra oss tillgängliga för människor som önskar hjälp med att kunna ta bättre plats i sina egna liv och i sina relationer. Vi tror att det förändringsarbetet sker just i relationer, och betraktar oss därför som en relationsmottagning: både i rummet med patienten och i hur vi arbetar med varandra. Tillsammans bygger vi den mottagning vi själva vill arbeta på, och nu växer vi: inom kort öppnar vi ytterligare en mottagning i Stockholm.Allt fler par söker sig till oss, och därför letar vi nu särskilt efter nya kollegor som har erfarenhet av att arbeta med just parterapi. Tjänsterna innebär arbete med både parterapi och individuell terapi, men med relationen i centrum i båda. Det avgörande för oss är inte en viss parterapeutisk metod utan en hållning: förmågan att hålla två människor och relationen mellan dem samtidigt, och att stanna kvar när två människor gör det svårt för varandra i rummet.I en parrelation kan människor komma i kontakt med känslor av ett djup de sällan möter någon annanstans i livet. Det är där vi kan skadas som mest, och där det som en gång gjort ont väcks till liv igen. Vi närmar oss trauma genom den inre upplevelsen: som det som inte har kunnat kännas, delas eller läka, och som därför fortsätter att upprepas. I ett par kan det ta formen av att parterna gör varandra illa om och om igen, utan att det uppstår utrymme för reparation. Det är där vi vill att parterapin ska göra skillnad. Sexualiteten är för oss inte ett separat fack, utan en arena där parets svårigheter och förmågor ofta tar form. Vi tror på den subjektiva upplevelsen. Med det menar vi att känslor och upplevelser i någon mening alltid är sanna. Inte nödvändigtvis som en beskrivning av vad som hände, men som ett uttryck för hur det var att vara med om det. I parterapin blir det särskilt tydligt: två människor kan uppleva samma stund helt olika, och båda har rätt. Det är där arbetet börjar.Hos oss möts patienterna först av vår matchningsprocess, där vi som mottagning tillsammans tar ansvar för att hitta rätt terapi och rätt terapeut för den enskilda personen. Ofta pågår parterapi och individuell terapi samtidigt, med flera av oss kring samma par. Genom det vi skriver och delar på webben och i sociala medier kan patienterna också ha en relation till Emotivum som helhet, vid sidan av relationen till sin terapeut. Det gör dem till mottagningens gemensamma patienter snarare än någons egna, och det är det som ger dig klinisk frihet i hur du arbetar, och som gör att du aldrig står ensam med en svår kontakt. Vi strävar efter att varje behandlare ska ha en klientmix som passar både dennes intressen och förmågor. Det tunga bär vi tillsammans. Vårt arbete vilar på gemensamma perspektiv: psykodynamisk teori, anknytning, det relationella, common factors, sexualitet som perspektiv och det salutogena.Tjänsterna är på 80–100 %, och vi anpassar efter dig och uppdraget. Vi vet att många har uppsägningstid och planerar för det. Vi rekryterar löpande och kan tillsätta innan annonseringsperioden är slut. Vi söker samtidigt psykologer och psykoterapeuter för långa individuella behandlingar med relationellt fokus. Du är välkommen att söka till båda.Varmt välkommen med din ansökan, eller dina frågor, till applications@emotivum.se.Krav: Legitimerad psykolog eller legitimerad psykoterapeut, med klinisk erfarenhet av parterapi.Meriterande: Vidareutbildning i parterapi, sexologi eller familjeterapi kan vara en del men är inte avgörande; vi läser hur du tänker om relationer, inte vilka kurser du gått.

jobs.title: Vil du bidra til at avanserte teknologiske systemer fungerer som de skal?
jobs.description:
Hvis du liker å forstå hvordan komplekse løsninger henger sammen, feilsøke og finne gode svar sammen med andre, kan dette være rollen for deg.

Vi søker en prosjektingeniør som vil få en sentral rolle i systemtesting av produktene våre. Hos oss får du kombinere praktisk laboratoriearbeid med analyse, problemløsning og dokumentasjon i et høyteknologisk fagmiljø.

Dette vil du jobbe med

  • Etablere, konfigurere og vedlikeholde testoppsett for systemene våre og grensesnittene mellom enhetene.
  • Bygge og vedlikeholde simuleringsutstyr for Open og Closed Loop-oppsett.
  • Forstå, teste og feilsøke elektriske komponenter, elektronikkbokser, kabler og komplette systemer.
  • Ta ansvar for praktisk laboratoriearbeid, fasiliteter og utstyr, og bidra med tydelig dokumentasjon.

 

Vi ser etter deg som

  • Har relevant høyere utdanning eller fagskole innen mekatronikk, elektronikk, kybernetikk eller automasjon. Relevant erfaring fra fagområdene våre kan kompensere for formell utdanning, og vi oppfordrer deg til å søke.
  • Trives med prosjektarbeid og samarbeid, samtidig som du arbeider grundig og analytisk med utfordringer.
  • Er praktisk anlagt, har interesse for elektronikk og kommuniserer godt på engelsk, som er språket i dokumentasjonen vår.

Du vil passe godt inn hos oss hvis du er en god lagspiller som beholder oversikten når flere aktiviteter pågår samtidig, og møter tekniske utfordringer med nysgjerrighet, struktur og gjennomføringsevne.

 

Vi tilbyr  

Hos KONGSBERG får du jobbe med produkter i verdensklasse i et høyteknologisk miljø, sammen med engasjerte og positive kolleger. Vi legger til rette for at du kan utvikle deg både faglig og personlig, blant annet gjennom varierte arbeidsmuligheter på tvers av bedriften. Du får konkurransedyktige betingelser, gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger og et fordelaktig aksjeprogram. I tillegg tilbyr vi treningssenter, innovasjonslab, firmahytter, rabatterte billetter til kultur- og sportsarrangementer og et eget fritidsprogram for unge medarbeidere.

 

Om oss

Missiles & Aerostructures (DMA) er en divisjon i KONGSBERG med ledende kompetanse innen utvikling, produksjon og leveranse av avanserte missilsystemer og høyteknologiske strukturer til forsvars- og aerospacekunder.

I divisjonen jobber vi med noen av verdens mest avanserte teknologier. Våre ansatte utvikler, sammenstiller, tester og leverer missiler til fartøy, kystartilleri, helikopter og kampfly, blant annet Naval Strike Missile (NSM) og Joint Strike Missile (JSM). Samtidig har divisjonen en teknologisk ledende produksjon av avanserte mekanikk- og komposittstrukturer med ekstremt høye krav til kvalitet og presisjon og pålitelighet. Vi har betydelige leveranser til F-35 kampfly og KONGSBERGs egenutviklede systemer og leverer også vedlikehold av kritiske, dynamiske komponenter til helikoptre, med en avansert testfasilitet som er kapabel til å teste dagens og fremtidige helikopterflåter.

Divisjonen har et høykompetent fagmiljø som leverer kritiske løsninger og teknologi i verdensklasse til forsvars- og aerospacekunder.

 

Er dette muligheten du har ventet på? Vi vurderer søknader fortløpende og gleder oss til å høre fra deg. Ta gjerne kontakt dersom du vil vite mer om stillingen.  

 

Kandidater som søker på stillingen, vil i forbindelse med rekrutteringsprosessen bli gjenstand for bakgrunnssjekk og vurdering av denne vil bli lagt til grunn ved valg av kandidat.For å være aktuell kandidat til stillingen må du være kvalifisert for å bli sikkerhetsklarert, jfr. Sikkerhetsloven.

Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

KONGSBERG beskytter mennesker og kritisk infrastruktur – fra havdypet til verdensrommet. Vi utvikler innovative teknologier for forsvars-, sikkerhets- og overvåkingsmarkedene, og kombinerer militær og sivil kompetanse. Våre løsninger innen forsvar og sikkerhet omfatter blant annet missiler, våpenstasjoner, luftvern, kommando- og kontrollsystemer og digitale tårn. KONGSBERG leverer også avansert teknologi for hav og rom – fra autonome maritime systemer til satellitter og datatjenester – som bidrar til bærekraft, klimaovervåking, beskyttelse av kritisk infrastruktur og økt sikkerhet. I dag er vi mer enn 7 500 ansatte i rundt 20 land. Selskapet er notert på Oslo Børs, og den norske staten kontrollerer om lag 50,01 prosent av aksjene.

jobs.title: Director Operations & Safety (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Als Leiter Betrieb und Sicherheit (m/w/d) verantwortest du das operative Herz von FlixTrain: von der Betriebs- und Produktionsplanung über die Leitstelle, die in Echtzeit den Betrieb steuert, bis hin zur Betriebssicherheit, der Flottendisposition sowie dem Partner- und Qualitätsmanagement. Du sorgst für einen sicheren, pünktlichen, zuverlässigen und kundenfreundlichen Zugbetrieb und baust das Führungsteam über alle operativen Funktionen hinweg auf – mit direkter Berichtslinie an den CEO.
Wir suchen eine Persönlichkeit, die unternehmerisch handelt und entscheidet, für die Sache brennt, mit anpackt und Lust am Aufbau von Strukturen, Prozessen und Optimierungen hat. Bei uns kannst du den Betrieb des größten privaten Fernverkehrsplayers in Deutschland aufbauen.

Über die Rolle

  • Du verantwortest Betriebsplanung, Produktionskonzepte sowie Schicht- und Personaleinsatzplanung für einen zuverlässigen und sicheren Betrieb.
  • Du führst die Leitstelle und steuerst damit den laufenden Betrieb, das Störungs- und Abweichungsmanagement sowie die Disposition des Personals – mit ruhigem Kopf in jeder betrieblichen Lage.
  • Du verantwortest gemeinsam mit dem Safety Manager die Eisenbahnsicherheit, die regulatorische Compliance und die Sicherheitskultur – inklusive der Safety-Teams und Betriebskontrolleure.
  • Du stellst die Flottenverfügbarkeit und Flottendisposition sicher – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Instandhaltungspartnern, die als zentrale Ressource gestellt werden.
  • Du definierst unsere Servicestandards und die operative Qualität und sorgst für deren kontinuierliche Optimierung – inklusive Sauberkeit, Reinigung sowie Ver- und Entsorgung.
  • Du steuerst operative Partner und Subunternehmer, entwickelst einheitliche Standards mit Partner-EVUs, optimierst Schnittstellen und treibst Prozessexzellenz voran.
  • Du definierst mit deinem Team die Anforderungen an unsere Software-Entwicklung, Automatisierung und Digitalisierung von Abläufen, harmonisierst die Software-Landschaft und sorgst für eine gute Anwendbarkeit über alle Funktionen hinweg.
  • Du verantwortest das operative Budget und die entscheidenden KPIs – etwa Zuverlässigkeit, Sicherheit, Pünktlichkeit, Sauberkeit, Schichtbesetzung und Flottenverfügbarkeit.

Über Dich

  • Du bringst ein unternehmerisches Mindset und echte Leidenschaft fürs Aufbauen mit – du brennst für das Ergebnis und packst mit an, um es Wirklichkeit werden zu lassen.
  • Du hast insgesamt rund zehn Jahre Berufserfahrung gesammelt und in dieser Zeit Verantwortung und Gestaltungskraft aufgebaut.
  • Erfahrung im Eisenbahnumfeld ist für uns gesetzt – idealerweise verbunden mit operativem Verständnis für Disposition und Planung.
  • Du bringst Führungserfahrung in operativen Funktionen sowie Erfahrung im Aufbau von Teams und Strukturen mit.
  • Du verfügst über verhandlungssicheres Deutsch.
  • Idealerweise hast du dein Handwerk bei der Eisenbahn von Grund auf gelernt und dich anschließend weiterentwickelt – zum Beispiel über eine Station in der Beratung hin zu einer Führungsrolle im operativen Umfeld.
  • Wünschenswert sind außerdem: Erfahrung im Skalieren von Betrieben in einem Wachstumsumfeld, ein Hintergrund in Eisenbahn-Sicherheitsmanagementsystemen (SMS) und Erfahrung im Flottenmanagement.

Bei uns zählt der Blick auf das Ganze – auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst, aber dennoch glaubst, etwas bewegen zu können, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! 

Was Wir Bieten

  • Gestaltungsspielraum mit Mandat: Eine Schlüsselrolle mit direkter Berichtslinie an den CEO und dem Auftrag, den Betrieb des größten privaten Fernverkehrsanbieters Deutschlands maßgeblich aufzubauen – dein Einfluss ist unmittelbar sichtbar.
  • Vertrauensarbeitszeit: Wir arbeiten ergebnisorientiert und messen an dem, was du bewegst – nicht an der Stechuhr.
  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Drei Tage Office und zwei Tage remote pro Woche – für die Nähe zum Team und die Flexibilität, die eine Führungsrolle braucht.
  • 30 Tage Urlaub: Zeit zum Abschalten und Auftanken
  • Arbeiten von Überall: Zusätzlich kannst du bis zu 60 Tage pro Jahr von einem anderen Standort aus arbeiten.
  • Reisevorteile: 12 kostenlose Flix-Gutscheine + 12 Rabattgutscheine für Freunde & Familie.
  • Lernen & Entwicklung: Sprachkurse, Schulungen, Experten-Sessions sowie ein Mentoring-Programm mit erfahrenen Kolleg:innen, um deine Wirkung weiter auszubauen.
  • Gesundheits- und Wohlfühlangebote: Zugang zu vertraulichen Einzelberatungen, Kursen und Stressbewältigungsmaßnahmen – für dich und bis zu vier Familienangehörige.

Warum Teil von Flix werden? 

Bei Flix konzentrieren wir uns darauf, Reisen einfach, sicher und erschwinglich zu gestalten – sowohl für unsere Passagiere als auch für unsere Mitarbeiter. Hier geht es schnell voran, und es gibt viel Raum, etwas zu bewegen. Wir wachsen und entwickeln uns täglich weiter und suchen Menschen, die bereit sind, sich einzubringen und die Art und Weise, wie wir arbeiten, mitzugestalten. 

Wenn du einen Job suchst, in dem du wachsen und etwas bewirken kannst, dann bist du bei FlixTrain genau richtig. Hier kannst du Teil eines Teams werden, in dem dein Beitrag zählt und du deine Reise selbst gestalten kannst!

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) - Bank Balance
jobs.description:
At SumUp, the Global Bank team builds the core infrastructure and services that give merchants a digital bank account, helping small businesses manage their money easily and reliably. 

The Balance Management Squad sits at the core of the Global Bank Platform. Right now, our team is completing a major milestone: consolidating and modernizing our balance management system in Europe. The next big step is creating a global transaction history service; a single, shared platform used by all regions to give merchants consistent and transparent views of their financial activity.

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll help modernize existing systems while balancing innovation with stability, collaborate with teams across regions, and build reliable services that manage diverse markets with different regulations.

If you enjoy solving complex problems on high-load systems, are curious about banking, and are looking for a team that tackles challenges head-on, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

  • Build and evolve the SumUp's core banking services that powers ledger operations and transactions, transforming our regional systems into a unified, scalable global platform.
  • Tackle complex distributed systems challenges, ensuring resilient services that continue to perform under high transaction volumes.
  • Support modernization initiatives by improving observability, adding test coverage, refactoring code for long-term maintainability, and gradually introducing new architectural patterns without disrupting live banking operations.
  • Contribute to key architectural decisions - build ledger and transaction history systems from the ground up, ensuring a globally scalable banking solution for our clients.
  • Collaborate with teams across Risk, Treasury, Finance, and Infrastructure to ensure smooth, compliant, and reliable global operations
  • Take ownership from design to production, running the services you build, monitoring their performance, and continuously improving how we deliver high-quality software at scale.

You'll be great for this role if

  • You have solid backend experience building reliable, high-volume services and you think carefully about system design, APIs, data modeling, and how services interact.
  • You are proficient in Golang and comfortable learning and working with other languages as needed, e.g. Kotlin or Elixir.
  • You write maintainable, well-tested code, follow CI/CD best practices, and take responsibility for the software you build from development to production.
  • You're comfortable building, deploying, and running services in cloud environments like AWS using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Are fluent in relational databases that perform well under load and maintain data consistency.
  • You are a collaborator who enjoys working across regions, communicating clearly, exchanging feedback effectively, and making thoughtful technical decisions together.
  • You have a curiosity for building reliable financial services and banking domain

It's a plus if you have

  • Deeper PostgreSQL experience - we rely heavily on Postgres, so if you've done performance tuning, complex queries, or schema design, that's a plus
  • Experience with event streaming platforms (Kafka preferred) and modern observability stacks (Grafana, Honeycomb, etc.)

Why you should join SumUp

  • Be part of a company that values diversity and celebrates unique perspectives.
  • Work with a global team of skilled professionals in an environment that fosters collaboration, learning, and growth.
  • Be part of a global tribe building a banking solution from the ground up and delivering impactful solutions to the real-life problems of millions of SumUp merchants all over the world
  • Career growth and learning opportunities: We invest in your development through regular training, mentorship programs, SumUp University leadership cohort and a yearly learning budget (2,000 EUR)
  • Sabbatical program for tenured SumUppers
  • Join a global team where you belong: Check out our D&I Initiatives and Employee Resource Groups such as Pride Club, SumAfro, Neurodiversity, Grupos Mais, Women in Tech, and more
  • Health & wellness benefits: in-house fitness classes, gym in the office, subsidized Urban Sports Club and available psychotherapy sessions
  • A lot of other benefits such as Subsidized Public Transport Card, Kita placement assistance, Pension Scheme, Language Learning platform/courses etc.
  • Enrollment onto our virtual stock ownership program - you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

About SumUp

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing a vast set of simple and affordable business tools to help them start, run, and grow their businesses. Today, over 4 million businesses in 36 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster an inclusivity and continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.

SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited.

Explore career opportunities with us and join a team driven by collaboration, innovation, and a shared vision of creating a world where everyone can build a thriving business. Discover more about our vibrant and inclusive work culture and how we work on our careers website, and follow our journey on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Operations Foundations
jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Wolt is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Front-end-leaning) to join our Operations Foundations team. The team sits within the DoorDash Client and AI Development group and is responsible for the foundation that hundreds of engineers across Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo rely on to build internal operations tools. Our platform hosts 250+ micro-frontends (MFEs) used to operate every part of the business.

Our team is focused on building a scalable, reliable, and high-quality internal tooling platform that supports Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo's operations and business.

The team plays an important role in improving how engineers build, test, and ship software across the organization, with a strong emphasis on reusable libraries, micro-frontend architecture, and agentic development: building the platform where AI agents can take changes from task to merged PR safely and reliably without lowering the quality bar.

Currently, we are focused on unifying our frontend platforms, evolving shared components and library development, improving developer productivity, and enabling teams to deliver more independently through better architecture and tooling.

It's an exciting time to join because the team has strong ownership and a broad technical impact.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who can take ownership of complex technical initiatives across both frontend and sometimes backend and infra domains. In this role, you'll work primarily with TypeScript, React, Node.js, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Buildkite), and MFE architecture to build scalable, maintainable solutions that support multiple product teams and business areas.

Success in this role means becoming a trusted technical owner who consistently delivers reliable solutions and helps the team execute more effectively. Six months into the role, we'd expect you to be independently leading technical initiatives and contributing meaningfully to architecture and delivery planning.

This role offers the opportunity to solve challenging engineering problems with visible impact across the business. It's especially exciting for someone who enjoys combining product engineering with platform thinking, improving developer workflows, and building systems that scale across teams and domains.

What you'll be doing

  • Owning the Foundation: the runtime, build, deployment, and developer experience that 250+ MFEs and hundreds of engineers depend on every day.
  • Evolving Our Micro-Frontend Architecture: improve composition, isolation, and shared dependency strategies so feature teams can move fast.
  • Product and Planning: Independently drive projects from idea to production: breaking down ambiguous problems into clear technical plans, estimating delivery, identifying risks early, and delivering high-quality solutions in a timely manner.
  • Supporting Engineering Excellence: Champion best practices, raise the bar for code quality, and turn lessons learned into platform improvements.
  • Long-Term Thinking: Balance short-term feature unblockers with the long-term health, security, and maintainability of the platform.
  • Agentic Development: Build the foundations that let AI agents work autonomously on our platform, including agent instructions, reusable skills, tool integrations, guardrails, and the automated checks that make agent-authored changes safe to ship.
  • AI Fluency: Work agent-first in your own day-to-day: delegate implementation to agents, and focus your judgment on direction, architecture, and verifying outcomes.

📍This role can be based in our Berlin tech hub. Read more about our hybrid setup here.

Feel free to check out the Wolt Tech Blog for more insight into our culture and technology.

Our humble expectations

  • Proven expertise in building production frontend applications using TypeScript and React.
  • Solid backend knowledge, comfortable owning and operating Node.js services that support frontend infrastructure.
  • Strong knowledge of frontend build tools, bundlers, and module systems, and the ability to evolve them as the platform grows.
  • Track record of diagnosing and resolving complex performance, reliability, or DX issues in large frontend codebases.
  • Experience driving technical initiatives across multiple engineering teams and stakeholders.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills: aligning priorities, managing expectations, and communicating trade-offs clearly with partner teams and leadership.
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative, platform-mindset approach to working with feature teams.
  • Strong documentation skills, including experience writing RFCs or ADRs.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with micro-frontend architecture.
  • Frontend platform engineering experience.
  • Experience building shared component libraries used by many product teams.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, deployment processes, and cloud infrastructure for frontend workloads.
  • Experience or interest in observability and reliability (SRE).
  • Experience building tooling or workflows for autonomous AI coding agents (e.g., agent instructions, skills, MCP servers, or evaluating agent-generated code).

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über Digital Loop

Digital Loop ist ein in Deutschland ansässiges Beratungs- und Lösungsunternehmen. Wir unterstützen Geschäftskunden bei der Identifizierung und Bewältigung von Herausforderungen in den Bereichen Marketingtechnologie, KI, SEO und Business Intelligence.

Wir sind davon überzeugt, dass die Schnittstelle zwischen Marketing und Technologie der Schlüssel ist, um in einem sich ständig verändernden Geschäftsumfeld innovativ zu sein und herausragende Leistungen zu erbringen.

Wir entwickeln maßgeschneiderte, datengesteuerte Produkte, die unmittelbare Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden adressieren und gleichzeitig zukünftige Herausforderungen antizipieren. So können sich unsere Kunden nahtlos an jede Situation anpassen und nachhaltig erfolgreich sein.

Ihre Aufgaben

IAls Senior Technical Product Manager:in (m/w/d) übernimmst du Verantwortung für die Umsetzung unserer bestehenden Digital-Product-Roadmap und stellst die erfolgreiche Bereitstellung wirkungsvoller digitaler Produkte sicher.

Darüber hinaus treibst du in der nächsten Phase der Produktentwicklung die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung des Produkts voran. Du identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale, gestaltest zukünftige Roadmap-Prioritäten und entwickelst das digitale Produkt im Einklang mit Kundenbedürfnissen, technischen Möglichkeiten und Geschäftszielen weiter.

Als strategischer und technischer Ansprechpartner für Kunden und interne Teams übersetzt du komplexe geschäftliche Anforderungen in praktische, wertvolle und skalierbare Lösungen. Du verbindest ausgeprägtes Produktverantwortungsbewusstsein mit der erforderlichen technischen Fachkompetenz, um eng mit den Engineering-, KI- und Datenteams zusammenzuarbeiten. Gleichzeitig übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die Budgetkalkulation und -überwachung über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus.

Diese Rolle befindet sich an der Schnittstelle zwischen Produktmanagement und der Bereitstellung von Kundenlösungen. Sie passt ideal zu dir, wenn du sicher mit Unklarheiten umgehst, selbstbewusst im Kundenkontakt auftrittst und die Dynamik eines Start-up-Umfelds verstehst. Du bist in der Lage, funktionsübergreifende und multikulturelle Teams zu leiten, um digitale Produkte erfolgreich bereitzustellen und auszubauen.

Hauptaufgaben

Umsetzung und Bereitstellung der Produkt-Roadmap:

  • Roadmap umsetzen: Übernimm die Verantwortung für die Umsetzung der bestehenden Roadmap für digitale Produkte und stelle die erfolgreiche Bereitstellung wirkungsvoller digitaler Produkte im Einklang mit vereinbarten Prioritäten, Zeitplänen und Qualitätserwartungen sicher.

  • Delivery-Prozess steuern: Steuern Sie den täglichen Produktmanagementprozess über den gesamten Lebenszyklus der Bereitstellung hinweg, von der Klärung der Anforderungen und der Planung bis hin zur Umsetzung, Markteinführung und Iteration.

  • Produkt-Backlog verwalten: Verwalte und priorisiere das Produkt-Backlog. Übersetze geschäftliche Anforderungen in klare Epics, User Stories, Akzeptanzkriterien und umsetzbare Lieferpläne.

  • Produktentscheidungen treffen: Treffe während der gesamten Umsetzung fundierte Produktentscheidungen und wäge dabei Kundenerwartungen, technische Machbarkeit, Geschäftsziele sowie Ressourcen- und Lieferbeschränkungen gegeneinander ab.

  • Ressourcen effektiv zuweisen: Sorge für eine effektive Ressourcenzuweisung über alle Produktinitiativen hinweg für eine termingerechte und qualitativ hochwertige Bereitstellung.

  • Budgetverantwortung übernehmen: Übernimm die Verantwortung für die Budgetkalkulation und -überwachung über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus.Sorge dabei für Transparenz sowie die Abstimmung zwischen Umfang, Aufwand und verfügbaren Ressourcen.

  • Nachhaltige Bereitstellung fördern: Trage zu einer nachhaltigen Produktbereitstellung bei, indem du den Fokus auf Mehrwert, Umsetzungsqualität und effiziente Ressourcennutzung legst.

Produktentwicklung und Roadmap-Erstellung:

  • Verbesserungschancen identifizieren: Identifiziere Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung und Weiterentwicklung des digitalen Produkts auf Grundlage von Kundenfeedback, Marktentwicklungen, geschäftlichen Prioritäten und technischen Möglichkeiten.

  • Produktvision verfeinern: Wirke an der kontinuierlichen Verfeinerung der Produktvision, des Wertversprechens und der Ausrichtung der Features mit, damit das Produkt nachhaltig messbaren Mehrwert liefert.

Funktionsübergreifende technische Zusammenarbeit:

  • Brücke zwischen Business und Technik: Agieren Sie als Schnittstelle zwischen den geschäftlichen Stakeholdern und den technischen Teams und sorgen Sie für eine starke Abstimmung zwischen den Produktzielen und der technischen Umsetzung.

  • Enge Team-Zusammenarbeit: Arbeite eng mit Engineering-, KI-, Data- und UX-Teams zusammen,um robuste und skalierbare digitale Produktlösungen zu liefern.

  • Technische Tiefe einbringen: Führen technischer Diskussionen mit ausreichender Tiefe, um fundierte Produktentscheidungen zu unterstützen, Optionen zu bewerten und die Machbarkeit sicherzustellen.

  • KI-Produkte unterstützen: Unterstütze die Bereitstellung KI-gestützter digitaler Produkte mit deinem soliden Verständnis von Themen wie Systemintegrationen, Architektur, Implementierungsbeschränkungen und datenbezogenen Abhängigkeiten.

Dein Profil

Must-Haves:

  • Dynamisches Umfeld: Erfahrung in schnelllebigen, sich ständig weiterentwickelnden und idealerweise Start-up-Umgebungen. Du kannst mit Unklarheiten umgehen, parallele Initiativen steuern und in dynamischen Umgebungen Fortschritte vorantreiben.

  • Berufserfahrung: Mindestens 7 Jahre nachweisbare Erfahrung als Product Manager oder Technical Product Manager mit starker Eigenverantwortung für digitale Produkte über Roadmap-Umsetzung, Delivery und kontinuierliche Produktentwicklung hinweg.

  • Komplexe Tech-Produkte: Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von KI-gestützten, datengesteuerten oder anderweitig technisch komplexen digitalen Produkten oder IT-Lösungen.

  • Technisches Verständnis: Fundiertes technisches Verständnis und die Fähigkeit, eng mit Softwareentwicklern und KI-/Datenspezialisten zusammenzuarbeiten – mit ausreichender Fachkenntnis, um wertvolle Beiträge zu technischen Diskussionen und Lösungsentscheidungen zu leisten.

  • Stakeholder-Management: Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten im Stakeholder-Management, um funktionsübergreifend abzustimmen, Kompromisse und gemeinsame Ressourcen zu verwalten sowie Entscheidungsträger zu überzeugen.

  • Budget & Ressourcen: Erfahrung mit Budgetkalkulation, Budgetüberwachung und Ressourcenplanung über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus hinweg.

  • Ausbildung: Abschluss in Informatik, Ingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten technischen Fachgebiet.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Verhandlungssicheres Englisch in Wort und Schrift ist erforderlich; sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind ein großes Plus.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Vorherige Erfahrung in einem Start-up- oder Scale-up-Umfeld.

  • Hintergrund in KI-Produkten, Lösungen auf Basis von maschinellem Lernen oder intelligenter Automatisierung.

  • Erfahrung in den Bereichen MarTech, digitale Plattformen, Unternehmenssoftware oder anderen technologieorientierten Beratungsumgebungen.

  • Erfahrung in der Produktbereitstellung im Bereich der Kunden- und Lösungsentwicklung.

  • Vertrautheit mit agilen Entwicklungsmethoden und der iterativen Produktentwicklung in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering-Teams.

  • Vertrautheit mit Plattformdenken, APIs, Datenökosystemen und skalierbaren, cloudbasierten Produktumgebungen.
