jobs.title: Opetushoitaja Ortopedian ja traumatologian yksikköön
jobs.description: Haluatko olla mukana varmistamassa, että koko hoitohenkilökunta ja opiskelijat onnistuvat työssään – ja kehittää samalla omaa osaamistasi vaativassa erikoissairaanhoidossa? Siltasairaalan ortopedis-traumatologinen osasto S5A etsii opetushoitajaa. Osastomme erikoisalana on vaativa selkä- ja luutuumorikirurgia sekä HUS-piirin akuuttivaiheen selkäydinvammautuneiden hoito. Potilaistamme noin puolet tulee päivystyksen kautta, mikä tekee työstä monipuolista ja merkityksellistä. Opetushoitajan työnkuvaOpetushoitajana suunnittelet, koordinoit ja kehität uusien työntekijöiden perehdytystä ja osaamisen varmistamista. Seuraat perehdytyksen etenemistä, tuet perehtyjiä ja perehdyttäjiä sekä osallistut osaamisen arviointiin. Varmistat yhdessä esihenkilön ja perehdyttäjien kanssa, että perehdyksessä huomiodaan yksilölliset osaamistarpeet. Perehdytät henkilöstöä yksikön toimintatapoihin ja tuet koulutus- ja osaamissuunnitelmien toteutumista. Lisäksi vastaat yhdessä esihenkilön kanssa yksikön vuosittaisen koulutussuunnitelman toimeenpanosta ja toteutumisen seurannasta. Odotamme sitoutumista HUSin yhteisiin toimintamalleihin ja arvoihin sekä kykyä toimia rakentavana suunnannäyttäjänä muutostilanteissa ja uusien toimintatapojen jalkauttamisessa. Opetushoitaja toimii tiiviissä yhteistyössä yksikön osastonhoitajan ja apulaisosastonhoitajan kanssa. Tässä tehtävässä yhdistyvät hoitotyön laatu, osaamisen kehittäminen ja pedagoginen tuki – pääset vaikuttamaan sekä potilaiden hoitoon että hoitohenkilökunnan ja tulevien hoitajien ammattitaidon kehittymiseen. Kliininen hoitotyö muodostaa puolet työajastasi ja on keskeinen osa opetushoitajan tehtävää: opetushoitajuus näkyy myös kliinisessä työssäsi ohjauksena, osaamisen tukemisena ja hyvän hoitotyön käytäntöjen vahvistamisena. Millaista osaamista toivommeTehtävässä tarvitset pedagogista ja vahvaa kliinistä osaamista, hyviä vuorovaikutus-, yhteistyö- ja digitaitoja sekä kykyä ohjata, antaa palautetta ja arvioida osaamista. Arvostamme joustavaa ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta. Kokemus kirurgisesta hoitotyöstä katsotaan eduksi. Tarjoamme sinulleTarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja merkityksellisen työn näyttöön perustuvan potilashoidon ja yksikön osaamisen kehittämisen parissa. Saat tehtävääsi perehdytystä ja tarpeisiisi räätälöityä täydennyskoulutusta sekä joustavan moniammatillisen työyhteisön kehittämismahdollisuuksineen. Saat myös sinua kannustavan esihenkilön, joka on helposti tavoitettavissa. Opetushoitajana saat tueksesi HUSin opetushoitajaverkoston, jossa voit jakaa kokemuksia, kehittää osaamistasi ja saada vertaistukea tehtävääsi.Lisäksi HUSin työntekijänä sinulla on laajat koulutusmahdollisuudet ja ammatillisen kehittymisen edellytykset. HUS tarjoaa työntekijöilleen monipuolisia työsuhde-etuja, kuten ePassin, mahdollisuuden hakea HUSin vuokra-asuntoja, vuokrattavia lomamökkejä, alennuksia liikunta- ja kulttuuriharrastusten parissa sekä monia muita etuja. Lisäksi HUS tarjoaa työntekijälle tuettua työpaikkaruokailua. HUSin työntekijöille poliklinikkamaksut ovat maksuttomia. Tehtäväkohtainen palkka on 3595,56 €/kk ja mahdolliset kokemus- ja muut lisät.Hae meille hakuajan loppuun mennessä. HUSissa olet osa vaikuttavinta hoitoa. Tehtävän kelpoisuusehdot Laillistettu terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilö. Soveltuva ylempi korkeakoulututkinto ja soveltuva kokemus tai alempi korkeakoulututkinto täydennettynä opetushoitajan tehtävään soveltuvilla opinnoilla ja soveltuva kokemus tai alan opistoasteen tutkinto täydennettynä opetushoitajan tehtävään soveltuvilla opinnoilla ja soveltuva kokemus. Kielitaitovaatimuksena on suomen kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito ja ruotsin kielen tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito taikka ruotsin kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito ja suomen kielen tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito. Edellytämme asiakas- ja potilastiloissa työskentelevältä tartuntatautilain mukaista rokotussuojaa, ja terveydenhuollon toimintayksiköissä työskentelevältä terveydentilan selvitystä keuhkotuberkuloosista.Yhteystiedot Osastonhoitaja Krista Poikajärvi p. 040 619 6492 Ylihoitaja Susanna Virrankoski p. 050 427 4450 Rekrytointisuunnittelija Katja Kiviranta p. 040 705 0490

jobs.title: Research assistants in VaccAI and CuratedAI at MediaFutures
jobs.employer: UNIVERSITETET I BERGEN FAKULTETET FOR NATURVITENSKAP OG TEKNOLOGI
jobs.description:
UiB Knowledge that shapes society

UiB shall be among Europe’s leading universities, internationally recognized for high quality in research and education. As a societal institution, we shall contribute to sustainable and democratic development and be an attractive and inclusive place to study and work.

Video: https://youtu.be/M5n6RnScNgAResearch assistants 

There are two research assistant vacancies linked to VaccAI and CuratedAI at the Department of Information Science and Media Studies, University of Bergen, in the MediaFutures research environment. The positions will support research led by Professor Christoph Trattner.

  • VaccAI: one 40% position starting as soon as possible after the application deadline of 15 November 2026, by agreement, and ending on 30 September 2028.
  • CuratedAI: one 30% position starting as soon as possible after the application deadline of 15 November 2026, by agreement, and ending on 30 September 2028.

Research assistant is a recruitment position supporting academic staff in their teaching and research. The positions provide an opportunity to gain insight into scientific work and methodology. Total employment as a research assistant cannot exceed two years.

About the projects

VaccAI is a Research Council of Norway funded project examining vaccine related claims in the news and the information environment surrounding vaccination. The project combines analysis of news content with research on how people encounter and evaluate health information. Research assistants will help prepare and analyse research material and support empirical studies of vaccine communication and AI assisted approaches to assessing claims.

CuratedAI is a Research Council of Norway funded project examining artificial intelligence and transparency in journalism. It investigates how the use of AI in producing and verifying news can be communicated to audiences, and how transparency measures affect their understanding and evaluation of news. The research includes AI disclosure, provenance and watermarking approaches, and the needs of journalists and the public.

About MediaFutures

MediaFutures is a Centre for Research based Innovation hosted by the Department of Information Science and Media Studies at the University of Bergen, with its primary workplace at Media City Bergen. In collaboration with news media and technology partners, the centre develops responsible media technology and investigates media experiences, recommender systems, content production and analysis, and audience interaction. Read more at www.mediafutures.no.

Work tasks

The research assistants will formally report to the PI of the two projects Professor Christoph Trattner and support the relevant project teams in scientific, technical and project related administrative tasks. Tasks may include:

  • Preparing, collecting, cleaning and documenting research data, including news content, survey responses and experimental data.
  • Programming research tools, setting up study infrastructure and supporting online surveys and experiments.
  • Reviewing literature, annotating research material and assisting with quantitative or qualitative analyses.
  • Contributing to research documentation, reports, publications and dissemination activities.
  • Providing practical and administrative support directly related to the assigned project.

In VaccAI, the work will focus on vaccine related news and health claims. In CuratedAI, it will focus on AI use in journalism, transparency and audience responses. Specific tasks will be agreed according to project needs and the successful candidates’ qualifications.

Qualifications and personal qualities
  • Applicants should, as a minimum, be bachelor’s students in information science, media studies, computer science or another relevant discipline.
  • ICT competence and programming skills are required.
  • Proficiency in written and spoken English and Norwegian is required.
  • Applicants should be structured, solution oriented and able to work both independently and collaboratively.
  • Experience with data collection, data analysis, surveys or experiments is an advantage.
  • An interest in health communication and vaccine information is relevant to VaccAI; an interest in journalism, AI transparency and audience research is relevant to CuratedAI.
  • Knowledge of the MediaFutures research environment and the media or technology sector is an advantage.
We can offer
  • A good and professionally challenging working environment, with opportunities to gain practical research experience.
  • Salary according to the applicable research assistant category: Gross annual salary as research assistant for bachelor students (code 1018) NOK 455 000, -. For candidates with a bachelor’s degree (code 1019), the gross annual salary will be NOK 470 200.-. For candidates with a master’s degree (code 1020), the annual salary will be NOK 519 400,-. The salary mentioned is for a 100% position. 
  • Enrolment in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund and good welfare benefits.
  • Primary workplace at Media City Bergen.
Your application must include
  • An application letter describing your motivation and relevant experience. Please indicate whether you are applying for VaccAI, CuratedAI or both positions.
  • A CV, copies of diplomas, certificates of education and other relevant documents, with certified translations into English or a Scandinavian language where required.

Applications and attachments must be uploaded through Jobbnorge using the “Apply for this job” link. Application deadline: 15 November 2026. Potential candidates will be invited for an interview.

Generell informasjon:

For further information about the positions, please contact PI Professor Christoph Trattner at christoph.trattner@uib.no.

Practical questions about the application process should be directed to HR at personal.svfa@uib.no.

Diversity is a strength that enables us to solve our tasks even better. UiB therefore needs qualified employees regardless of gender, ethnicity, religion, worldview, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression and age.

The University of Bergen applies the principle of public access to information when recruiting staff for academic positions. Information about applicants may be made public even if an applicant has asked not to be named on the list of applicants. Applicants will be notified if their request to be omitted is not granted.

We encourage applicants with disabilities, immigrant backgrounds or gaps in their CV to apply. By indicating such circumstances in your application, you may receive favourable consideration. At least one qualified applicant from each of these groups will be invited for an interview as part of our commitment to inclusivity and equal opportunity.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Bergen is a renowned educational and research institution, organised into seven faculties and approximately 54 institutes and academic centres. Campus is located in the centre of Bergen with university areas at Nygårdshøyden, Haukeland, Marineholmen, Møllendalsveien and Årstad. 

There are seven departments at Faculty of Social Sciences. Read more about the faculty and departments.

jobs.title: Teknisk supportmedarbeider
jobs.description:
Om stillingen

Liker du en hektisk og utfordrende hverdag, er løsningsorientert og har lyst til å bidra til at IT er en god støttefunksjon for politiets arbeid og beredskap, oppfordres du til å søke. Vi trenger ny Teknisk Supportmedarbeider som vil ha arbeidssted i Kristiansund, men flere av oppgavene krever reisevirksomhet og også fysisk oppmøte ved andre lokasjoner i politidistriktet. 

Vårt team bistår etaten i Møre og Romsdal politidistrikt slik at de har rett utstyr og systemer tilgjengelig til enhver tid. Vi har et hyggelig og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med folk som er opptatt av å skape noe sammen. Som teknisk supportmedarbeider blir du en del av seksjon Brukerservice og regional IT i Politiets IT-enhet (PIT). Seksjonen består av 130 medarbeidere som jobber i politidistrikter over hele Norge. 

I Politiets IT-enhet er vi over 850 ansatte. Vi skaper verdi for innbyggerne, samarbeidspartnere og kollegaer i Politiet. Som en del av politiets viktige samfunnsoppdrag, skal vi forebygge og bekjempe kriminalitet, skape trygghet og ivareta rettssikkerheten. Vi er på jobb for et trygt Norge.

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Teknisk IT-support i regionen 
  • Drifte og administrere klienter lokalt / Asset Management (leasing utstyr) 
  • Implementering og daglig drift av distriktets tekniske IT-løsninger, nettverk og telefoni inkludert fysisk patching og kabelstrekking
  • Teknisk og funksjonell support AV-utstyr, blant annet avhørsrom både remote og onsite
  • Teknisk support samband
  • Rådgiving, bestilling, installasjon og vedlikehold av datateknisk utstyr både remote og onsite
  • Rådgiving og deltagelse i utviklingsarbeid inkludert reisevirksomhet i politidistriktet 
  • Andre ansvars- og arbeidsoppgaver innen fagfeltet

Fast arbeidssted for stillingen er Kristiansund.

Kvalifikasjoner
  • Utdanning fra høyskole eller universitet på bachelornivå, innen IT. Relevant supporterfaring på klientutstyr og mobile enheter i løpet av de 3 siste årene kan kompensere for manglende formell utdanning
  • Teknisk erfaring innen flere av fagområdene klientutstyr, mobile enheter, AV-løsninger, nettverk og samband og kan vise til gode resultater i tidligere roller
  • Erfaring fra samhandling med leverandører/utviklere og testing av IT-løsninger
  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Du kan kommunisere godt på både norsk og engelsk. Arbeidsspråket er norsk. 

For å bli vurdert som en aktuell søker til stillingen, må du oppfylle alle kravene over. Vitnemål fra høyere utdanning, fagbrev og relevante attester skal legges ved søknaden.

Du må ha plettfri vandel og være skikket for tjeneste i Politiet, og politiattest (uttømmende og utvidet) må innhentes ved ev. ansettelse jfr. politiloven § 18 og politiregisterloven § 41. I tillegg samtykker du til at det gjøres en skikkethetsvurdering av deg. Les mer på politiet.no/jobbipit 

Stillingen forutsetter sikkerhetsklarering på nivå HEMMELIG/Nato Confidential (NC) og autorisasjon. Du må kunne sikkerhetsklareres på nivå HEMMELIG/NC og autoriseres før tiltredelse. Les mer her: https://nsm.no/fagomrader/personellsikkerhet/sikkerhetsklarering/slik-blir-du-sikkerhetsklarert/

I tillegg er det ønskelig om du har:

  • erfaring med kartleggings- og implementeringsarbeid
  • gjennomføringsevne og resultater fra tidligere stillinger
Personlige egenskaper

Vi tror du vil ha det fint hos oss om du er:

  • service- og løsningsorientert med god gjennomføringsevne
  • strukturert, effektiv og kvalitetsbevisst
  • initiativrik og nysgjerrig
  • god til å samarbeide på tvers, men også være selvstendig

Vi legger vekt på personlige egenskaper i rekrutteringen av vår nye medarbeider

Som medarbeider i Politiet har du høy etisk bevissthet, du kjennetegnes av å være modig og helhetsorientert, du viser respekt og er tett på. Du kan lese mer om våre etiske retningslinjer og medarbeiderplattform her.

Dette kan vi tilby om du velger oss
  • Stillingen lønnes som rådgiver (stillingskode 1434) årslønn fra på kr. 555 000 – 705 000 per år, avhengig av kvalifikasjoner. For særling kvalifiserte søkere kan høyere avlønning vurderes. 
  • Medlemskap i Statens pensjonskasse, med blant annet gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger. Les mer her. 
  • Gode arbeidsbetingelser (fast avsatt tid til kompetanseheving, fleksibel arbeidstid, mulighet for hjemmekontor, mulighet for trening i arbeidstiden)

Les mer om godene du får som ansatt på politiet.no: https://politiet.no/jobbipit/goder

Mangfold i Politiet

Vi tror at mangfold bidrar til bedre oppgaveløsning, og søker derfor medarbeidere med ulik bakgrunn, erfaring, perspektiv og kompetanse. Dersom du har behov for tilrettelegging i rekrutteringsprosessen eller arbeidshverdagen, vil vi gjøre vårt beste for å gi deg det du trenger.Har du funksjonsnedsettelse, innvandrerbakgrunn eller hull i CV-en, kan du krysse av for dette i søknaden. Er du kvalifisert for stillingen, vil du bli vurdert for positiv særbehandling. Det betyr at minst én søker fra hver av disse gruppene blir innkalt til intervju.

Les mer om positiv særbehandling når du søker jobb i staten på arbeidsgiver.dfo.no.

Opplysningene du gir brukes til å utarbeide anonymisert statistikk som alle statlige virksomheter rapporterer i sine årsrapporter.

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uUTjHmSB_WcSlik søker du

Du søker ved å fylle ut CV i Jobbnorges CV-skjema og skrive en kort søknad. I tillegg må du legge ved relevante vitnemål og attester. Kvalifiserte kandidater vil bli kalt inn til intervju. 

Sett deg raskt inn i hva som skjer når du søker jobb hos oss. Rekrutteringsprosessen finner du på politiet.no/jobbipit.

I søknadsportalen Jobbnorge kan du krysse av for å ikke komme på den offentlige søkerlisten. Vi vil ta kontakt med deg hvis vi ikke godkjenner ønsket ditt. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Et kriminalitetsbilde i endring, den sikkerhetspolitiske situasjonen og den raske digitaliseringen gjør at Politiet må rigge seg bedre. Vi må endre oss for å stå i kontinuerlig utvikling og for å opprettholde et trygt Norge. 

I fremtiden må Politiet levere tjenester på andre måter, derfor må vi tenke nytt om hvordan fag og teknologi virker sammen. Politiets IT-enhet har det helhetlige ansvaret for teknologiutviklingen i Politiet.

Produktene vi lager skal gi verdi for innbyggerne, samarbeidspartnere og kollegaene våre i Politiet. Vi lærer underveis, videreutvikler og måler at vi er på rett vei. Verdien skaper vi skritt for skritt. 

Vi jobber i tverrfaglige team og tett med brukerne våre. Sammen skaper vi et mer digitalt og tilgjengelig politi. 

Vi jobber for å se hverandres perspektiver og dele kunnskap med hverandre. Ikke minst eier vi helheten sammen.

Les mer om hvordan vi jobber på politiet.no/jobbipit.

Bli bedre kjent med retningene våre på politiet.github.io.

jobs.title: Graphiste social media (CDD / CDI)
jobs.description:
Le ou la graphiste social media accompagne les équipes créatives et account dans la conception des contenus visuels de nos clients. Il ou elle imagine et réalise des carrousels, des visuels et des déclinaisons adaptés aux réseaux sociaux, avec un sens esthétique affirmé et une attention particulière aux détails. Il ou elle contribue à définir des directions artistiques et sait respecter précisément celles des marques accompagnées.

Vos missions

  • Concevoir des carrousels et des visuels pour les réseaux sociaux ;

  • Proposer des pistes créatives et des directions artistiques adaptées aux briefs ;

  • Décliner les contenus dans le respect précis des chartes graphiques et des directions artistiques définies ;

  • Mettre en page des contenus en soignant la typographie, la composition et la hiérarchie de l’information ;

  • Adapter les créations aux différents formats et usages des plateformes ;

  • Collaborer avec les équipes account, éditoriales et de production ;

  • Intégrer les retours et vérifier la qualité des fichiers avant livraison ;

  • Participer à la veille graphique et proposer de nouvelles idées visuelles.

Vos compétences

  • Une expérience professionnelle en graphisme, en agence, chez l’annonceur ou en freelance, avec une réelle autonomie dans la conception et la réalisation de contenus ;

  • Un portfolio présentant des réalisations soignées, notamment des carrousels et des contenus social media ;

  • Un sens esthétique affirmé et une bonne maîtrise de la typographie, des couleurs et de la composition ;

  • Capacité à proposer une direction artistique et à décliner fidèlement une direction existante ;

  • Maîtrise des outils de création graphique, notamment Photoshop, Illustrator et Canva ;

  • Des compétences en motion design léger, notamment sur After Effects, sont un plus ;

  • Rigueur, sens du détail et capacité à gérer plusieurs projets en parallèle ;

  • Aisance relationnelle, proactivité et goût pour le travail en équipe ;

  • Français courant ; anglais professionnel apprécié.

Avantages

🌈 Ce qui vous attend

  • Une entreprise en croissance depuis sa création ;

  • Une équipe compétente et ambitieuse ;

  • Un écosystème de clients et de partenaires prestigieux, dont le groupe Lagardère, Renault, Universal Music, HBO Max, LVMH et bien d'autres ;

  • Des bureaux de standing ;

  • Mutuelle couverte à 100%, tickets restaurant & frais de déplacement.


Date de début visée : octobre 2026, dès que possible.

jobs.title: Child and adolescent psychiatrist – Work on a Nordic Island
jobs.description: Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!Are you looking for a meaningful specialist position where you can combine professional development with a high quality of life?This is an opportunity to work within child and adolescent psychiatry in a close-knit Nordic healthcare environment, while living in a peaceful island community surrounded by nature and the sea.About the IslandThis Nordic island is home to approximately 30,000 residents and offers a safe, peaceful and family-friendly environment. With its beautiful archipelago, clean air and easy access to outdoor activities such as hiking, sailing and cycling, the island provides excellent opportunities for an active lifestyle outside of work.For professionals considering relocation with their families, the island offers schools, daycare services and a welcoming community within a compact geographical area.About the psychiatric serviceThe child and adolescent psychiatric service covers the entire island and serves approximately 5,900 children and adolescents aged 0–17.The service is primarily outpatient-based and currently has around 140 active patients, with approximately 210 referrals per year. About 50% of referrals relate to neurodevelopmental conditions, making ADHD and autism an important part of the clinical work.Common psychiatric conditions include:    Depression    Anxiety disorders    Obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD)    ADHD    Autism    Other child and adolescent psychiatric conditionsTreatment includes psychological and psychotherapeutic interventions, pharmacological treatment, psychoeducation and support for both patients and their families.When needed, the team also collaborates with schools, social services and other healthcare providers.About the RoleAs a specialist in child and adolescent psychiatry, you will have a broad and varied clinical role with the opportunity to follow patients throughout their assessment and treatment.Your responsibilities will include:    Assessing, diagnosing and treating children and adolescents with a broad range of psychiatric conditions    Working with both general psychiatric and neurodevelopmental conditions, including ADHD and autism    Developing and following up individualized treatment plans    Providing pharmacological treatment when appropriate    Working closely with psychologists, nurses, social workers and other healthcare professionals    Collaborating with families, schools, social services and other healthcare providers when needed    Participating in clinical discussions and contributing your specialist expertise to the multidisciplinary team    Supporting and mentoring residents and junior doctors    Contributing to the continued development of the psychiatric servicePhysicians typically see approximately 4–5 patients per day, alongside clinical rounds, acute assessments and other outpatient responsibilities.There may also be opportunities for further professional development and increased responsibility within the organization.Outpatient Work and Acute PsychiatryThe work is predominantly outpatient-based. The child and adolescent psychiatric service does not have its own inpatient ward or separate on-call service.Acute cases are primarily handled through a reserved acute appointment at the outpatient clinic each week. Other urgent cases may present through the emergency department or psychiatric inpatient services.When required, the initial assessment can be carried out by the on-call physician within adult psychiatry, in consultation with the child and adolescent psychiatric team.If a patient requires inpatient care, this is arranged in cooperation with adult psychiatry or the paediatric department, depending on the patient's age, clinical needs and availability.This structure allows you to focus primarily on planned outpatient psychiatric care while still being involved in acute assessments when required.RequirementsWe are looking for a specialist who:    Holds an EU-recognized specialist qualification in child and adolescent psychiatry    Has broad clinical experience in assessing and treating psychiatric conditions in children and adolescents    Is comfortable working with neurodevelopmental conditions such as ADHD and autism    Can work independently while also enjoying close multidisciplinary collaboration    Has strong communication skills and a patient- and family-centered approach    Is interested in contributing to the professional development of colleagues and junior doctors    Communicates well in English and is motivated to learn SwedishWhy consider this opportunity?    Work-life balance: Outpatient-based work with no dedicated on-call duties within the child and adolescent psychiatric service.    Broad clinical role: Work across child and adolescent psychiatry, with significant exposure to ADHD, autism and other psychiatric conditions.    Collaborative environment: Join a close multidisciplinary team and contribute with your specialist expertise.    Nordic island lifestyle: Enjoy a safe, family-friendly community surrounded by nature and the sea.What Dignus Medical Offers YouRelocating to another country is a major decision. We will support you throughout the process, from first contact until you are established in your new position.We offer:    Personal and ongoing support from your dedicated recruiter    Assistance with authorization and specialist recognition when required    Support throughout the relocation process    Assistance related to accommodation and practical relocation matters    Support for accompanying family members    Access to language training with a private tutor via Teams or SkypeTake the Next Step in Your CareerIf you are a specialist in child and adolescent psychiatry looking for an opportunity to combine meaningful clinical work with a different way of life, this could be the right next step for you.Apply today or contact us to learn more about the position and life on this unique Nordic island.You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.title: Lärare i fritidshem till Långedragsskolans anpassad grundskola
jobs.description: BeskrivningNu söker vi på Långedragsskolan anpassad grundskola en legitimerad lärare i fritidshem!Långedragsskolan ligger i en havsnära miljö med stora möjligheter till rika naturupplevelser. Skolan är enparallellig och har cirka 200 elever från förskoleklass till årskurs 6. All personal arbetar i nära samverkan för att utveckla och stödja eleverna i deras lärprocess. Personalen arbetar i lag som tillsammans verkar för att utveckla elevernas självkänsla, kreativitet, nyfikenhet och lust att lära.Långedragsskolan ingår i ett skolområde med Hagenskolan och Nya Varvets skola. Vårt skolområde består av tre F-6-skolor, flexverksamhet, anpassad grundskola samt en verksamhet med Hästunderstödda Insatser för elever med lång problematisk skolfrånvaro. Vi har totalt 900 elever och 90 personal. Skolorna har likvärdigt elevunderlag och eleverna har god måluppfyllelse. Det finns en övergripande rektor för skolområdet samt fyra biträdande rektorer fördelade på skolområdet.ArbetsuppgifterDu kommer att arbeta på fritidshemmet där du leder och stimulerar eleverna i deras lärande och personliga utveckling på ett konstruktivt och inspirerande sätt utifrån elevernas egna förutsättningar.  Du planerar, genomför och följer upp fritidsverksamheten tillsammans med dina kollegor i arbetslaget. Du stöttar även undervisningen under skoldagen tillsammans med lärare och elevstöd.Alla skolorna arbetar med PALS-modellen, som handlar om att främja och förebygga trygghet och studiero på skolorna. Detta för att få en samsyn, som gynnar positivt beteende i en skolmiljö med fokus på relation/samspel mellan skolpersonal och elever.För att du som är nyexaminerad skall få bästa tänkbara start i yrket kommer du att ingå i grundskoleförvaltningens Lärarakademis introduktion för nyexaminerade lärare. Introduktionen ger dig som nyexaminerad ett nätverk med andra nyexaminerade och riktade aktiviteter under ditt första år som lärare.KvalifikationerVi söker dig som är legitimerad lärare i fritidshem. Du har tidigare arbetat i anpassad grundskola och har erfarenhet av arbete med barn som har NPF och intellektuella funktionsnedsättningar. Det är meriterande med dokumenterad specialpedagogisk kompetens men vi välkomnar också dig som nyexaminerad att söka tjänsten.För att passa i rollen har du en god förmåga att arbeta målinriktat och att utveckla kvalitén på verksamheten. Du bidrar med nya idéer och perspektiv i arbetsrelaterade frågor samt i situationer som behöver lösas. Du tar initiativ och ansvar för att arbetet går framåt, oavsett om du arbetar ensam eller tillsammans med andra. Du är en tydlig och god kommunikatör som får gehör för tankar och idéer samt kan påverka beslut i en viss riktning. Samtidigt ser du möjligheter och finner glädje i att arbeta tillsammans med andra för att skapa en så utvecklande, inspirerande och utmanande fritidshemsverksamhet som möjligt. Du är nyfiken, initiativrik, nytänkande och vill utvecklas i ditt arbete. Du skapar goda relationer till elever, vårdnadshavare och t kollegor.Du arbetar lågaffektivt och är lyhörd för elevernas olika behov. Du ger eleverna trygghet genom tydliga ramar samtidigt som du inbjuder till inflytande. Du har förmåga att sätta tydliga gränser och vara en god ledare för våra elever.Välkommen med din ansökan!ÖvrigtGöteborgs Stad tillämpar individuell och differentierad lönesättning. Här kan du få mer information om bland annat lönestatistik: Lön, ersättningar och förmåner - Göteborgs StadSom anställd i vår förvaltning erbjuds du bland annat friskvårdsbidrag, cykelförmån och medarbetarstöd.Enligt Skollagen ska utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister uppvisas av personer innan de anställs inom förskoleverksamhet, skola och skolbarnomsorg. Detta beställer du på Polisens hemsida.Inför denna rekrytering har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och därför undanber vi oss ytterligare erbjudanden om kompetensförmedling, annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp.Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via vårt rekryteringssystem i enlighet med GDPR.Om ossVi skapar framtiden i Göteborg – en lektion i tagetVarje vardag möts tusentals barn och unga i våra skolor – med dem formar vi framtidens Göteborg. I grundskoleförvaltningen är vi 10 000 engagerade medarbetare som jobbar tillsammans för att alla elever ska få lyckas och växa, oavsett bakgrund eller förutsättningar. Du har en viktig roll i att skapa en likvärdig skola med hög kvalitet, där du både får utvecklas och utveckla verksamheten. Du bygger kunskap, gemenskap och framtidstro tillsammans med dina kollegor. Hos oss får du vara med och göra skillnad – på riktigt.Göteborgs grundskoleförvaltning ansvarar för stadens närmare 140 kommunala skolor, från förskoleklass till årskurs 9, anpassad grundskola, fritidshem och kulturskola. Välkommen att arbeta nära skogen, staden eller havet. Vi är Göteborg.

jobs.title: Science Hub Denmark Student Assistant
jobs.employer: COPENHAGEN CAPACITY, FONDEN TIL MARKEDSFØRING OG ERHVERVSFREMME
jobs.description:
The Science Hub Denmark initiative is expanding. Join us and help us tell the world why Denmark is a fantastic place to pursue a career in research!

We are looking for a promising Student Assistant with a passion for science to join our growing team that aims to brand Denmark internationally as an attractive career destination for elite researchers within Biosolutions, Biomedicine, Neuroscience, Sustainable Energy Tech, Quantum and AI.

We are still looking for a new setup for the team and are therefore open to profiles within all our focus areas.

Your tasks and responsibilities

  • Assist the Science Hub team in running the project and developing and executing the various activities and events. Both online and in-person. This could imply some international travel.

  • Conduct market research.

  • Candidate and university outreach.

  • Provide administrative support to the team.

  • Work with our CRM system, HubSpot.

Your profileYou are currently studying a master’s degree and are excited about the opportunity to share with the world why Denmark is a great place to live and work. You are a motivated, creative and a structured team player. It would be good if you have some of the skills and competencies listed below but don’t worry if you don’t have them all. If you have the right mindset, everything is possible!

  • A passion for science and an interest and firsthand knowledge of one of our research areas at Danish universities.

  • Proficient in English both verbally and in writing.

  • Outgoing with good communication and public speaking skills

  • Good organisational and time management skills.

  • Ability to work effectively within a team and independently.

Our offices are in the city center of Copenhagen, Denmark. You’ll work here part-time: 15-20 hours per week. We’ll agree on a work schedule that fits with your studies.Copenhagen Capacity Copenhagen Capacity is Greater Copenhagen’s organization for investment promotion and regionaleconomic development. We work to make the region even more attractive to foreign investment andmarket it internationally to attract companies, investors, and highly educated workers.

The goal is to create jobs, growth, and development in Greater Copenhagen. In addition to that, we are a close-knit, passionate organization with a multinational work environment where English is our shared office language. We value collaboration and connection, whether over lunch in the company canteen with colleagues across departments or at social events.

Science Hub Denmark Science Hub Denmark is an initiative dedicated to enhancing the international visibility of Danish research and career opportunities in Denmark. With funding from Villum Fonden, Novo Nordisk Fonden, and Lundbeck Fonden, the initiative will continue for three more years with the aim of significantly increasing the interest in Danish research worldwide, while also exploring innovative strategies for promoting career opportunities in Denmark. 

Emphasizing research excellence, societal impact, and quality of life, the initiative will utilize digital channels to engage researchers abroad and facilitate recruitment for research positions at Danish universities. The project focuses on key areas: Biosolutions, Biomedicine, Neuroscience, Sustainable Energy Tech, Quantum and AI; research strongholds where Denmark excels internationally. 

How to apply If you think you’re the right profile for this position and our team, please apply before the 8th of November 2026 by sending your CV and cover letter job@copcap.com with "Student Assistant – Science Hub" in the subject line.  Interviews are expected to be held in the week of 9-13 November.

If you have any questions regarding the role, please reach out to Head of Science Hub Denmark – Alexander Watts, by email: alw@copcap.com

Vi kombinerar beprövade metoder med ett individanpassat arbetssätt där varje persons behov, resurser och mål står i centrum.Vi är en arbetsplats som präglas av engagemang, samarbete och delaktighet. Du har ett professionellt bemötande, god samarbetsförmåga och förmåga att skapa förtroendefulla relationer.Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av arbete inom missbruksvård, psykiatri, HVB-verksamhet, socialt arbete eller liknande verksamheter. Du är flexibel, ansvarstagande och kan hantera utmanande situationer på ett lugnt och respektfullt sätt.Arbetstiderna är förlagda dagtid.Krav:- B-körkort är ett krav.- Utdrag ur belastning- och misstankeregister är ett krav.- Legitimerad sjuksköterska.Meriterande- Erfarenhet av målgruppen.- Vidareutbildad sjuksköterska inom psykiatri.- Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.Vad säger våra medarbetare?"Nya Tag är en arbetsplats där vi arbetar tillsammans mot samma mål – att skapa möjligheter till förändring för de människor vi möter. Det bästa med arbetet är att få följa människors utveckling och se hur små steg framåt kan göra stor skillnad i deras liv."Vi ser fram emot din ansökan.Varmt välkommen!

jobs.title: Special Engineer
jobs.description:
A research engineer (spesialingeniør) position in molecular and cell biology is available in the research group targeted therapies and immunomodulation headed by Prof. Mouldy Sioud, Department of Cancer Immunology, Institute of Cancer Research, Oslo University Hospital-Radiumhospitalet.

The research group focuses on the development of new cancer therapeutics such as antibodies, antibody derivatives, and modified mRNA cancer vaccines using in vitro screening platforms and cell and molecular techniques. The position will provide a unique opportunity to pursue basic and translational research with the aim to identify novel targets and strategies for cancer immunotherapy.

Further information on the activity of the research group can be accessed at http://ous-research.no/sioud/. To date, the group has published 220 scientific papers, all of which are indexed in PubMed.

Oslo University Hospital is a workplace with great diversity. We believe this is crucial for solving our tasks in the best possible way. We want this diversity to be reflected among the applicants for our positions, and we encourage all qualified candidates, regardless of background, to apply!

Position Description

The successful candidate will work closely with the group leader and other team members to design and conduct a range of in vitro and in vivo experiments, analyse experimental data, and contribute to scientific publications. The main aim is to identify cell-surface receptors involved in antibody binding to cancer cells and enhance the efficacy of mRNA-based cancer vaccines through mRNA modifications

The position is available for one year with the possibility for extension based on the candidate performance. 

Requirements
  • Master's degree in molecular biology, cell biology, biotechnology, immunology, or a related field
  • Practical experience in molecular and cellular biology, including cell culture, transfection, cloning, and protein analysis
  • Experience with flow cytometry, immunoprecipitation, tagged protein purification, and/ or immunological techniques is highly desirable
  • Good communication skills in English and the ability to work independently and collaboratively
How to apply

Only applications received through webcruiter will be considered and should include

  • A brief cover letter describing your research experience, relevant technical expertise, and motivation for applying
  • A CV outlining relevant education, research experience, and technical skills
  • Contact details for two references
We offer
  • A varied and exciting work in an environment in the intersection between research and industry, developing novel cancer treatments
  • A productive and motivating research environment
  • Attractive welfare benefits
  • Salary according to the OUS salary scale
KontaktinformasjonMouldi Sioud, Enhetsleder, mouldi.sioud@ous-research.no ArbeidsstedUllernchausseen 70 0310 Oslo Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Oslo universitetssykehus HF Referansenr.: 5195633177 Stillingsprosent: 100% Contract Startdato: 15.01.2027 Sluttdato: 14.01.2028 Søknadsfrist: 15.11.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Oslo University Hospital is a highly specialized hospital in charge of extensive regional and local hospital assignments. As Scandinavia’s largest hospital, we carry out more than 1.2 million patient treatments each year. The hospital has a nationwide responsibility for a number of national and multi-regional assignments, and has several national centers of competence. Oslo University Hospital is responsible for approximately 50 percent of all medical and health care research conducted at Norwegian hospitals, and is a significant role player within the education of a large variety of health care personnel.

jobs.title: GM / VP Sales, France
jobs.description:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The role in one line

Come build our France territory. You'll own the market, lead from the front in every deal, and build the team as the market earns it.

Why now

Omnea is the UK's number one startup for 2026 and the 11th fastest-growing tech company in Europe. We're in the middle of a major global expansion, and France is a market we're committing to. The product, customers and sales motion are proven. What we need now is the leader who turns that into a real business on the ground.

  • We win 86% of live RFPs against our biggest competitor

  • More than 3x ARR growth in the last 12 months, with 40% in Q3 alone

  • Under 20% of enterprises use modern procurement software today. Gartner expects that to reach 50% by 2027

  • Global enterprises including Spotify, Wise, Adecco and McAfee already run on Omnea

What you'll do

  • Own the France number: set the territory plan, choose the target accounts and build pipeline from day one

  • Be in the deals: run and close our biggest France opportunities yourself, with CFOs, CPOs and procurement leaders

  • Lead from the front as Omnea's face in France: customer meetings, CFO dinners, industry events and partner conversations

  • Build the team as the market earns it: hire and coach the AEs who follow you, and set the standard they sell to

  • Take what you hear from buyers straight to product and marketing, so we win more in France

Who this is for

  • 8+ years in B2B SaaS, with a strong record of closing complex enterprise new business yourself

  • Experience leading or building a sales team, ideally in a new market or a fast-growing business

  • Fluent French and English

  • A player-coach who would rather be in the deal than in a dashboard

  • Credible with C-suite buyers, especially Finance, Procurement and Legal

  • Comfortable building from zero: no local team and no playbook handed to you, just a proven product and a market to win

  • Bonus: you've opened a new market or been an early leader at a scale-up

Where this goes

You'll build and lead Omnea's France business. As the market grows, so do your team and your remit. We run as a meritocracy, and we've signed the Future Founder Promise, so if you want to start your own company one day, we'll back that too.

How you'll work

This role is remote while we build our presence in France.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

jobs.title: Scientific Account Executive
jobs.description:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

Finance is one of the most automatable functions in any company and almost nobody has actually done it. We intend to.

That is the job: build an AI-powered finance stack. Our ledger, billing, cards and payroll all expose APIs, and we already close the books against them programmatically rather than by hand. You would take that much further, to where the model, the close, the cash view and the margin analysis largely run themselves, and your week goes on the decisions instead of the reconciliation.

You would be our first finance hire, and it is hands-on. You will build the forecast, run the close across two entities, own cash, and be the person who can say what a protein actually costs us to make.

What You'll Do

  • Own the forecast. Both directions: bottom-up from lab capacity, throughput and price per protein, and top-down P&L, burn and runway.

  • Own gross margin. What does an experiment actually cost us — DNA, reagents, consumables, instrument time, labour? Which products and which customers lose us money?

  • Own pricing, with commercial. What we charge, why, and where the floor is. Pricing at a lab company is a finance question wearing a sales hat.

  • Own the close. Group consolidation and intercompany management. Make it fast, make it correct, make it boring.

  • Own cash. Bank and card accounts across Switzerland and the US, AP runs, AR collection, payment timing. Know where the money is and where it is going before anyone asks.

  • Keep us compliant. Tax, VAT, audit, payroll, and the external firms we work with. You are not a lawyer or an accountant, but you know when to call one.

  • Investor reporting, fundraising support, and treasury management.

  • Equipment leasing and asset management. The lab runs on millions of francs of instruments. Lease or buy, how we finance it, what it does to the balance sheet, and keeping the asset register honest as we expand.

  • Automate all of the above.

What We're Looking For

  • You have built a finance function, not just worked in one. Several years in finance at a startup that actually scaled, and ideally you were early enough to have set things up rather than inherited them.

  • You can build a real model. Not a template. A model that ties operational reality — throughput, yield, capacity, headcount — to cash, and that survives someone pulling on it.

  • You write code, or you are visibly about to. SQL at minimum, Python ideally. This is the hard requirement most finance candidates will fail, and we mean it. We run on Claude Code across the company, and every system finance touches has an API behind it. The best version of this person automates their own function, writes their own tooling, and finds leverage the rest of us have not thought of. If your instinct is that finance is a spreadsheet-and-portal job, we will frustrate each other.

  • You understand the cost structure of a physical business. Reagents, instruments, consumables, capex versus COGS, yield loss. Lab, hardware, or manufacturing backgrounds all translate. Pure SaaS finance does not, on its own.

About the Role

Our lab is a factory. DNA goes in, characterized proteins come out, and a customer gets results in days rather than the months a CRO would take. Everything that machine consumes — synthesized genes, reagents, consumables, biosensors, catalog proteins — is something we buy, on lead times we do not control. It is also most of what a protein costs to make, which makes procurement one of the biggest levers on gross margin in the business.

So far scientists have bought what they need, decisions get made in hours, and nothing blocks an experiment. That was the right trade while we were proving the thing works. But we are multiplying lab throughput several times over, and at that volume procurement becomes a discipline: real terms with the suppliers we already buy from heavily, qualified second sources where we currently have one, inventory that is planned rather than remembered. Nobody has taken that on yet.

You would be our first dedicated supply chain hire, and it is hands-on — you do the sourcing and the negotiating yourself. One thing makes it harder than a typical procurement job: our assay portfolio keeps expanding, and every new assay brings new reagents. You are not optimizing a static supply chain, you are building one that flexes with the science. How far the role goes from there is up to you.

What You'll Do

  • Own procurement end to end. Every input to the lab, from gene synthesis down to gloves. Requests, POs, receiving, vendor onboarding, the lot.

  • De-risk the supply chain. Too much of what we depend on has exactly one supplier. Find second sources, qualify them properly with the science team, and keep them warm, so that switching is a decision we make rather than an emergency we react to.

  • Negotiate. Build the supplier relationships across our DNA, reagent, biosensor and catalog-protein vendors, put volume commitments and pricing agreements in place, and go get the margin back.

  • Drive down the cost of a protein. Go category by category and take cost out of each. A few francs per protein, multiplied across the volumes we are heading toward, is a seven-figure line.

  • Stay ahead of the science. When R&D says they are adding a new assay next quarter, you should already be sourcing the reagents for it.

  • Set inventory policy, and make the numbers true. Reorder points and safety stock, so we never stall a customer experiment on a stockout and never have six figures of reagents quietly expiring in a freezer. You decide what should be on the shelves and how much of it.

  • Plan supply for the lab expansion. Model what several-fold throughput actually needs — volumes, lead times, storage, cash tied up in stock — and have it in place before the capacity comes online, not after.

  • Own landed cost. Shipping, customs, import duties, VAT recoverability, cold chain. We import a lot of biology into Switzerland and both the cost and the failure modes matter.

  • Own COGS with Finance. Procurement and finance are the two halves of gross margin, and you are the procurement half.

  • Automate the whole thing. Ordering, tracking, and reconciliation should mostly run themselves.

What We're Looking For

  • You have worked in supply chain or procurement in a physical, technical business. Biotech, a CRO, or another life science company is ideal, and you understand reagent categories — enzymes, antibodies, media, resins, plasticware — and how they are actually sourced. Hardware manufacturing or another high-mix production setting translates well. Buying software licences does not. You do not need to have run a supply chain organization before; you do need to be ready to own one.

  • You think in margins. Saving a few francs per protein across tens of thousands of proteins a month is a number that should make you sit up.

  • You are technical enough to talk to scientists. You do not need a degree in biology, but you will be qualifying an alternative supplier for a reagent that a protein biochemist depends on, and you need to be able to have that conversation properly rather than forwarding it.

  • You can negotiate. Comfortable sitting across from vendors who have been selling into labs for thirty years, and comfortable walking away.

  • You automate. We run on Claude Code across the company and our lab system has an API. Some of our largest suppliers still require a human to upload a spreadsheet to a portal, and we consider that a bug rather than a fact of life. The best version of this person is writing scripts against our systems and our vendors' systems, not clicking through them. If your instinct is that procurement is a portal-and-email job, we will frustrate each other.

  • Obsessive about the details that bite. Lead times, expiry dates, lot numbers, minimum order quantities. Nothing falls through.

  • You want to grow fast. We are going from roughly 25 people to roughly 50 in the next year, and the lab spend grows faster than the headcount does.

  • Swiss or EU import/export experience is a strong plus.

Scope

We are a small company and nobody here has clean edges around their job. You will end up in the lab, in a spreadsheet with Finance, on the phone with a courier, and every so often doing something that is nobody's job simply because it needs doing. That is the deal, and if it sounds unappealing then we are probably not the right place.

What we do want to be clear about is where the centre of gravity is. This role is about what we buy, who we buy it from, what we pay, and how reliably it turns up. Sourcing, negotiation, supplier relationships, inventory, resilience, cost. Plenty of other things will land on your desk and you should take them, but that is the part that is yours and the part we will judge the role on.

One thing it is not: an order-taking job. You are not a mailbox between scientists and vendors. You decide what we source and from whom, and we expect you to argue with us about it.

Why This Role Is Interesting

Most supply chain jobs are about keeping a stable system stable. This one is about building the supply chain for a lab that is about to grow several-fold, at a company where the cost and reliability of an experiment more or less is the product. Every franc you take out of the cost of a protein, and every week you take out of a lead time, shows up directly in what we can offer customers and in whether AI-designed biology is cheap enough to be worth doing at scale. There are not many procurement jobs where the leverage is that direct, or that visible to the people running the company.

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the Role

Adaptyv is growing fast. We are significantly expanding our lab this year, onboarding more and more customers every week, and building the systems needed to keep the company running smoothly as we scale.

We are looking for a Founders Associate to own and build the operational backbone of the company as we scale. This is a high-ownership generalist role: you'll take entire problems and run them end-to-end, from messy first draft to a process that runs cleanly without you.

You'll move between finance, customer operations, hiring, supplier relationships, and lab logistics — owning whatever is most important that week, not just supporting it. Most of what you'll work on is still manual, ad hoc, or held together by hand; your job is to turn it into systems and automations that scale, then move on to the next hardest thing.

This role requires exceptional agency and an entrepreneurial mindset. You should be comfortable being handed an ambiguous goal with no playbook and coming back with it solved.

 

What You'll Do

  • Own complete operational workstreams end-to-end — you're accountable for outcomes, not tasks

  • Use AI tools to rebuild workflows that are still too manual, messy, or slow, and turn them into systems that run without you

  • Own customer onboarding and help keep our growing customer base happy as we scale

  • Run finance and administrative operations, working closely with our accountants and service providers

  • Manage supplier and service-provider relationships, including negotiation and follow-through

  • Drive lab expansion logistics for our new lab in Lausanne

  • Own internal company coordination: events, customer visits, team operations, and the day-to-day rhythm of the company

  • Build lightweight tools and automations using Claude Code, Python, Notion, no-code tools, or whatever gets the job done

  • Design the processes and systems the company doesn't have yet — and make them happen

 

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of getting things done: you've started something, run something, or owned something meaningful, whether at a startup, a side project, a club, or your studies. A background in biology is not a hard requirement. If you're coming from a different field, a genuine interest in the life sciences is important to us.

  • Exceptional agency and ownership. You spot problems before anyone asks, take action, and don't stop until they're solved

  • Entrepreneurial and self-directed — you're comfortable with ambiguity and no playbook, and you'd rather build the system than just run the task

  • Strong with AI tools, especially Claude Code or Codex. You use them to build real workflows and tools, not just draft emails

  • You thrive in a dynamic role where priorities change quickly, and you're comfortable jumping between projects, responsibilities, and urgent operational needs

But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

About the Role

We're looking for a hands-on scientist-engineer to help build our next-generation DNA synthesis platform, enabling high-throughput, cost-effective production of large and diverse DNA libraries. You'll work at the intersection of chemistry, materials science, bioengineering, and hardware development, designing and building prototypes, running experiments, and optimizing processes to turn new synthesis technologies into reliable, scalable production systems.

DNA synthesis is a fundamental part of our protein engineering platform. We're developing new approaches to dramatically increase synthesis throughput while reducing cost and turnaround time.

You'll work closely with our scientific and engineering teams to develop and prototype new DNA synthesis technologies. Your focus will be on translating scientific concepts into working hardware and experimental systems, designing and building prototypes, testing different approaches, and continuously improving their performance.

This is a highly hands-on, interdisciplinary role combining experimental science with practical engineering. You'll take ownership of prototype development, experimental validation, and process optimization, helping move promising technologies from early concepts to reliable, scalable systems.

We're looking for someone who enjoys building things, solving technical problems, and working across disciplines. You don't need to be an expert in DNA synthesis, but you should have strong scientific fundamentals, an engineering mindset, and experience turning ideas into working prototypes.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and test prototypes for next-generation DNA synthesis technologies.

  • Translate scientific and technical requirements into practical engineering designs and experimental setups.

  • Scope and evaluate different technical approaches, components, materials, and equipment for prototype development.

  • Develop and optimize the chemistry, materials, and processes underlying the synthesis platform.

  • Design and execute experiments to characterize performance, identify limitations, and improve reliability.

  • Work closely with mechanical, electronics, software, and automation engineers to develop integrated experimental systems.

  • Troubleshoot complex technical problems across chemistry, hardware, and process engineering.

  • Develop analytical methods and quality control strategies to measure performance and guide optimization.

  • Help scale successful prototypes into robust, reproducible systems suitable for routine production.

  • Work with external suppliers and engineering partners to source components, evaluate technologies, and accelerate development.

What We're Looking For

  • A strong background in chemical engineering, chemistry, materials science, bioengineering, mechanical engineering, or a related field.

  • Hands-on experience designing, building, and testing experimental setups, prototypes, or laboratory equipment.

  • Strong understanding of chemistry, materials, or process engineering, with the ability to apply these fundamentals to practical engineering challenges.

  • Experience developing and optimizing experimental processes, including systematic troubleshooting and performance characterization.

  • Comfortable working across hardware and experimental science, translating scientific requirements into practical engineering solutions.

  • Experience selecting components, evaluating technical trade-offs, and iterating on prototype designs.

  • Strong experimental skills, including designing experiments, analyzing data, and making decisions based on results.

  • Independent, resourceful, and comfortable working on open-ended technical problems.

  • A practical, hands-on approach to engineering, with a focus on building, testing, and improving systems rather than purely theoretical development.

  • Experience with DNA or oligonucleotide synthesis, including chemical or enzymatic approaches, is a plus.

  • Experience with solid-phase synthesis, surface chemistry, or chemical process development is a plus.

  • Familiarity with microfluidics, high-throughput dispensing, or array-based technologies is a plus.

  • Experience with laboratory automation, instrumentation, or custom hardware development is a plus.

  • Experience with CAD, electronics, fluidics, or mechanical prototyping is a plus.

  • Experience scaling experimental technologies from proof of concept to production is a plus.

The Role

A very strong senior software engineer with deep, hands-on experience building and operating production systems. We hire for engineering strength first: people who write good software, reason about failure, and own what they ship.

You will work in a team of 2 to 6 engineers on a client project. Clients come to us because we work at the forefront of AI in the enterprise; you help implement our AI strategy.

AI experience is required. Much of our work involves LLM-powered and agentic systems, and while you may not be working directly on LLMs, you will be working on LLM based systems.

  • Lead architecture discussions for your part of the system, with the support of the wider team

  • Take ownership: pick up the ambiguous problem, chase down the answer, and say so when something is going wrong

  • Work in a "normal" team rhythm — daily standups, planning, retrospectives, code and design review

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years designing, building and maintaining production systems that real users depend on — clean testable code, sound API and data modelling, and the judgement to know which abstractions are worth it

  • Production AI experience: You have built and operated GenAI systens in production with real users

  • Has owned code in production — deployment, monitoring, on-call or equivalent — and can debug hard problems in live systems: concurrency, performance, data correctness

  • Distributed systems fundamentals: services, queues, retries, idempotency, failure modes, and integrating third-party APIs that are not reliable

  • Databases: schema design, query performance, migrations

  • Operational rigour: meaningful automated testing, useful instrumentation, CI/CD and shipping incrementally

  • Client-facing ability: has delivered against real business requirements and can hold a technical conversation with non-engineers

  • Languages: Python (primary), TypeScript/JavaScript. Strong engineers coming from Go, Java, C#, Rust or similar who are willing to work in Python are in scope

  • Infrastructure: cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure), containerisation

Desired qualities

  • Depth — you can explain the systems you built and the trade-offs you chose

  • Balances speed of iteration with production reliability

  • Clear communicator, in writing as well as in conversation

  • Learns new domains quickly and deliberately

Interview Process

  1. Introductory call - 30 minutes

  2. Behavioural/Management interview - 60 minutes

  3. Technical interview (choice of walking through own code, live coding, or take home exercise) - 60 minutes

jobs.title: AI Engineering Lead
jobs.description:
EggAI · Full-time · Remote (EU only)

The Role

You will lead a small, highly-skilled remote team of engineers designing and shipping production-grade agentic AI systems. Working directly with enterprise clients, you will validate where AI can create value, redesign business processes, and own the resulting system from early experiments through adoption and measurable results.

Across these environments, you will learn from recurring production failure modes and have the latitude to choose the models, tools, and architecture to solve the business problem.

Alongside client delivery, you will turn successful approaches into shared assets that strengthen future engagements. Those contributions will shape EggAI's engineering culture and give you broad influence over how we work.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will write production code, set technical direction, develop engineers through example, review, feedback, and coaching, and guide senior client stakeholders through difficult decisions.

This is a remote position. We only accept candidates located in the EU.

What You'll Own

Act as a trusted technical counterpart to client teams throughout the engagement, helping them make sound decisions and create lasting capability as you:

  • Discover: Validate business opportunities against AI capabilities and constraints, and identify new opportunities enabled by the technology.

  • Design: Own solution design and system architecture across agents, tools, data, evaluations, controls, human oversight, and deterministic boundaries.

  • Build: Personally implement the system's critical agents, integrations, evaluation infrastructure, permissions, observability, controls, and feedback loops.

  • Deliver: Lead the team and client from implementation through adoption, owning engineering quality and production readiness while establishing a clear delivery rhythm and engineering accountability across the project team.

  • Compound: Package successful work as tools, datasets, evaluations, patterns, and engineering methods.

What We're Looking For

  • A sustained record of exceptional technical leadership that generated real business impact, including experience leading small engineering teams.

  • Experience designing, shipping, and operating production-grade AI systems, with practical judgment across architecture, context, tools, evaluation, observability, production controls, reliability, and cost.

  • A demonstrated ability to keep pace with advances in AI, test what matters, and change working methods when new capabilities prove substantive, evidenced by advanced use of agentic AI in day-to-day work.

  • Repeated ownership of difficult stakeholder environments and the judgment to connect technical decisions to business value, user needs, risk, and organizational change.

  • Excellent communication skills across engineering, product, and business stakeholders.

  • Strong coding skills and the ability to write and review production-grade code in languages such as Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or similar.

  • A strong engineering foundation and the first-principles judgment to understand what established practices protect and how those protections should be implemented in AI-native systems.

  • Strong statistical and experimental judgment, including the ability to create the instrumentation, annotation, review, and feedback loops needed to learn from uncertain AI behaviour and improve systems over time.

Additional strengths

  • Experience operating AI systems in security-sensitive or regulated environments.

  • Experience creating AI tooling, evaluation infrastructure, data assets, or engineering platforms that serve multiple projects.

  • A track record of hiring, onboarding, and developing engineering talent.

  • Meaningful open-source work, public technical contributions, or active participation in the AI-engineering community

  • På samme lokasjon finner du 25 omsorgsboliger og hjemmesykepleien, som følger opp rundt 130 hjemmeboende pasienter.
  • I PLO har vi et bredt fagmiljø med fagutviklingssykepleier, kreftsykepleier og velferdsteknologikoordinator, som bidrar til faglig utvikling og kvalitet i tjenestene våre.

Et team som jobber sammen – hele natten

Natt-teamet består av 3 team, hvor hvert team settes sammen av 2 sykepleiere og 2 helsefagarbeidere. Hos oss er samarbeid ikke bare en forventning, det er selve nøkkelen til at natten fungerer.

Man fordeles på 4 lister, ingen står alene. Vi jobber på tvers av ansvarsområder, og teamene har gode muligheter for å møtes i løpet av natten. Dette skaper trygghet, deling av kompetanse og en solid følelse av fellesskap.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter en sykepleier som trives med å jobbe tett sammen med kollegaer, men samtidig mestrer å jobbe selvstendig. En som vet at gode netter skapes av et godt og sammensveiset team. Du er en person som bidrar aktivt inn i fellesskapet, som tilbyr hjelp før noen rekker å spørre, og som møter utfordringer med handlekraft og løsningsorientert ro. Du er trygg, stabil og til å stole på, en kollega som skaper sikkerhet både for teamet og pasientene våre. Samtidig setter du kvalitet og pasientsikkerhet høyt, og du evner å omstille deg når situasjonen krever det. Hos oss legger vi stor vekt på personlig egnethet, fordi vi vet at den rette personen gjør hele forskjellen i et lite natt-team.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

-          Sykepleie til pasienter i institusjon og hjemmeboende

-          Samarbeid med pårørende

-          Dokumentasjon i Gerica pasientjournal

-          Tverrfaglig samarbeid internt og eksternt

-          Ha en veiledende og støttende rolle for kollegaer, pasienter og pårørende  

-          Jobbe med egen og avdelingens kompetanseutvikling

Vi søker deg som:

-          Har norsk autorisasjon som sykepleier

-          Har god norsk skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne, på nivå med B2

-          Ser muligheter fremfor begrensninger og møter endringer med positivitet

-          Er faglig sterk og tydelig på faglig og etisk standard i tjenesten

-          Mestrer å jobbe nattarbeid

-          Bidrar positivt i arbeidsmiljøet

-          Har førerkort klasse B

Vi kan tilby:

-          En spennende arbeidshverdag i utvikling

-          Et trivelig og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte kollegaer

-          En turnus med lange friperioder

-          For tiden bonus for ferie utenfor hovedferieperioden

-          Fagdager, medisin- og HLR-kurs i turnus

-          Mulighet for faglig utvikling

-          Tilgang til treningsrom på helse- og sosialsenteret.

Våler kommune ønsker at de ansatte skal representere mangfoldet i befolkningen og vil derfor oppfordre alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke hos oss uansett alder, kjønn, seksuell orientering, funksjonshemming og nasjonal eller etnisk bakgrunn.  

Våler kommune benytter elektronisk søknadsprosess og søknaden må derfor sendes elektronisk via stillingsutlysningen på Våler kommunes hjemmeside.  

 

Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Våler kommune ligger attraktivt til i Mosseregionen i Østfold fylke, med kort vei til Oslo. Vi er en landbrukskommune med en usedvanlig kombinasjon av sentral beliggenhet og landlig naturskjønt landskap. Våler kommune har om lag 6500 innbyggere, og er en kommune i stor vekst. Kommunen har et rikt forenings- og organisasjonsliv, og leverer gode tjenester gjennom 650 kompetente og engasjerte medarbeidere. Våler kommune satser sterkt på digitalisering og brukermedvirkning og vår visjon er "vi dyrker nærhet for å skape fremtidens muligheter". Mer om oss på www.valer.kommune.no.
