jobs.title: Technical Sales Manager, Finland / Nordic region
jobs.description:
Are you ready to grow a business and make a difference in plant health?

Lallemand Plant Care is looking for a commercially driven and technically skilled Technical Sales Manager to lead business development across Sweden, Denmark and Norway.

This is an exciting opportunity for a professional who combines a passion for agriculture and plant health with strong sales capabilities and a strategic business mindset. You will play a key role in expanding Lallemands market presence and bringing innovative microorganism-based plant protection and biofertilizer products to distributors, growers and industry partners.

Your role and key responsibilities

 * Principle contact to sales for Lallemand Plant Care customers in assigned territory.
 * Take ownership of the annual sales budget and maximize sales growth.
 * Build and strengthen long-term relationships with existing and new customers.
 * Lead commercial negotiations with distributors, strategic partners and key accounts.
 * Identify new business opportunities, monitor market trends and translate customer needs into growth opportunities.
 * Collaborate with sales, marketing, regulatory and field solutions teams to ensure consistent market offering and high customer satisfaction.
 * Report on business development and sales performance regularly to the Commercial Director.

Be a trusted technical partner

 * Manage and provide technical support to customers, including support for product demonstrations and field trials.
 * Deliver customer training and technical presentations, helping customers understand product performance and best practices.
 * Represent Lallemand Plant Care at industry events, trade shows and professional forums.

What will help you succeed?

We are looking for an experienced professional who understands the micro-organism-based solutions market and knows how to turn technical expertise into commercial success.

You will ideally bring:

 * A bachelors or masters degree in agricultural sciences or a related field. Additional qualifications in business, management or plant protection are an advantage.
 * At least 10 years of relevant professional experience, including proven success in technical sales and business development within the agricultural input sector.
 * A strong understanding of agricultural markets, distribution channels and commercial business practices.
 * Excellent sales, negotiation and business development skills.
 * An established network within the agricultural input industry is an advantage.
 * Fluency in English and Swedish – Finnish and other Scandinavian language skills are a bonus.
 * Proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools.

In addition

You are likely to thrive in this role if you are:

 * Entrepreneurial and self-motivated, with a strong drive to achieve results.
 * Adaptable and curious, willing to learn quickly and embrace new challenges.
 * Collaborative and communicative, able to build trust with customers and colleagues.
 * Reliable and honest, with a strong work ethic and a commitment to delivering on promises.

What to expect

 * A regional role with responsibility for business growth across Sweden, Denmark and Norway.
 * The opportunity to combine commercial leadership with technical expertise in plant care.
 * Close collaboration with customers, distributors and cross-functional teams.
 * A hybrid working arrangement.
 * Travel of up to approximately 50% of working time, mainly within Nordic territory, with occasional international travel for training and meetings.

A valid passport and driving license are required. The role also involves occasional visits to agricultural, field and factory environments.

How to get more information about the position 

For further information about the position, please email professional@visiohr.fi  or contact Visio Professionals Talent Managers Sanna Majava, tel. +358 45 860 7556 or Tarja Laakso, tel. +358 45 858 8441.

About Lallemand Plant Care

Lallemand is a privately held Canadian company founded in the late 19th century, which develops, produces, and markets microorganisms for various markets. jobs.title: Vi söker stödassistent till Korttid vuxen och Boendestöd inom OFN
jobs.description: Om arbetsplatsenI Borgholms kommun arbetar vi med människan i centrum – med värme, respekt och en stark tro på att alla individer ska få möjlighet att växa, utvecklas och vara delaktiga i vardagen. Vår verksamhet inom OFN – Omsorgen om funktionsnedsatta, erbjuder stöd, trygghet och stöd till meningsfulla aktiviteter för vuxna med funktionsnedsättning, där varje dag präglas av omtanke och en strävan efter att skapa meningsfullhet och sammanhang. Verksamheten bygger på att möta varje individs unika behov med trygghet, professionalism, engagemang och ett positivt förhållningssätt. I vår verksamhet för vuxna ingår följande verksamheter:  • Ledsagning • Kontaktperson  • Daglig verksamhet • Boendestöd  • Korttidsvistelse •  Bostad med särskild service   • Personlig assistans   Som arbetsplats genomsyras vi av Borgholms kommuns kärnvärden – vi är välkomnande, utvecklande och gör saker tillsammans. Tillsammans skapar vi en trygg och inkluderande miljö där både personer med funktionsnedsättning och medarbetare får möjlighet att trivas och utvecklas.Vi söker en stödassistent till vårt team som arbetar vid Vuxenkorttiden och boendestödet som är en del av socialpsykiatri. Är du den vi söker?Arbetsplatsen kommer att vara kombinerad mellan vuxenkorttiden och boendestödet. Vid korttidsboendet bor vuxna personer växelvis utifrån biståndsbedömda beslut. Tjänstgöring sker företrädesvis dag, kväll och helg men det kan också förekomma pass dygnets alla timmar, på ett rullande schema (dag, kväll, journatt och helg) Boendestödet arbetar utifrån biståndsbedömda beslut enl SoL företrädesvis och arbetar enl schema dag, kväll och helg och utgår i arbetet med klient från klientens hemmiljö.1 plats(er). ARBETSUPPGIFTERVid vuxenkorttiden kommer du att vara kontaktman för de brukare som är beviljade insatsen samt ha ett administrativt och praktiskt ansvar för verksamheten. Insatsen korttidsboende är avsedd för miljöombyte, rehabilitering eller avlastning för anhöriga för brukare. Insatsen kan ges enl SoLeller LSS. Insatsen boendestöd är en beviljad insats enl SoL för personer med psykisk, neuropsykiatrisk eller begåvningsmässig funktionsnedsättning som behöver hjälp i vardagen för att leva ett självständigt liv. Stödet är individanpassat och syftar till att träna färdigheter, skapa struktur i hemmet, hantera ekonomi och främja sociala kontakter.  I rollen som stödassistent upprättar du och följer genomförandeplaner och stöttar individen i sin vardag utifrån behov, självbestämmande, delaktighet och styrande dokument. Du genomför uppföljningar tillsammans med individen för att förmågor ska utvecklas eller bibehållas. Du samverkar med övriga stödassistenter, enhetschef, sjuksköterska, fysio- och arbetsterapeut, anhöriga och andra i individens nätverk för att utveckla och stötta individen, verksamheten och arbetet kring individen. För att trivas i rollen som stödassistent hos oss ska du vara självständig, driven, flexibel och ha god förmåga till samarbete.  Tjänsten kräver god självkännedom och att du är lugn och trygg i dig själv samt innehar god empatisk förmåga. Vi vill att du har ett genuint intresse för människor och att du tycker om att arbeta med människor som har olika förmågor och behov. Du ska utifrån individens dagsform kunna anpassa stödet utifrån det. Du behöver vara flexibel gällande schema och tycka att förändringsarbete är roligt.KVALIFIKATIONERDu är utbildad undersköterska, stödassistent med inriktning pedagogik eller social/behandlingspedagog. Vi ser gärna att du är utbildad i metoden Ett självständigt liv (ESL) och motiverande samtal (MI). Du har erfarenhet av att ha arbetat och mött människor i olika utsatta situationer. Du har kunskap om / kännedom om olika psykiatriska och neuropsykiatriska diagnoser, psykisk ohälsa, våld i nära relation samt skadligt bruk och beroende. Du är bekväm med att använda digitala verktyg som dator och smartphone. Du ska kunna hantera det svenska språket på ett nyanserat sätt, i tal och skrift samt inneha B-körkort och körvana.Löneform: Månadslön.Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.Varaktighet: Tillsvidare.Arbetstid: Schema.Vi strävar efter en jämn könsfördelning och ser mångfald som en styrka och välkomnar därför sökande med olika bakgrund.Vi använder e-rekrytering för att effektivisera och kvalitetssäkra rekryteringsarbetet. Alla dina uppgifter sparas på ditt CV-konto och du kan enkelt logga in och uppdatera dina uppgifter när du vill. Fyll därför i dina uppgifter så omsorgsfullt som möjligt för att ge en rättvisande bild av dig själv. Uppgifterna behandlas och sparas enligt personuppgiftslagen.Inför anställningen kommer du att behöva uppvisa utdrag ur belastningsregistret. OBS: Skicka INTE din ansökan via E-post eller brev.Inför rekryteringsarbetet har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanbeder oss därför bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer, Lund
jobs.description: Mechanical Engineer with passion for product development!At Axis, our passion is to create a smarter and safer world! We have delivered several groundbreaking products and look forward to paving the way for many more. Come join our team and help us in finding smart solutions for fantastic products!We are now seeking a mechanical engineer to join our mechanics team within System Products at Axis HQ in Lund.System Products is responsible for developing a wide and exciting product portfolio, which includes body-worn cameras, video recorders, microphone products, video decoders, sirens, and other system accessories. Your future teamWe who work in your future team are passionate engineers who love technology and tough technical challenges. We highly value creativity, collaboration, and openness. You will be overwhelmed by your colleagues' helpfulness and their willingness to help you develop.We are multiple functions working together to develop, improve, and deliver world-class products! What you'll do here as a mechanical engineerAs a mechanical engineer on System products, you will work on product development in areas such as body-worn cameras, recorders, microphone products, and other system devices. Much of your daily work is in projects where the project team consists of different functions and competencies. The length of a project typically ranges from 6 months to 2 years. In the project, you work closely with electronics, firmware, and many other internal functions such as quality, testing, production, and purchasing. In the projects, you drive the mechanical development together with a few colleagues from concept study to mass production. These tasks include designing the product, creating prototypes, communicating with suppliers, verifying the product, and preparing the product for mass production. To optimize the production of the design, you also have close contact with our suppliers around the world. The portfolio includes both large and small projects, and several of the product types we develop are new to us, so unknown challenges and opportunities for variation are promised. In your work, you will also meet and work together with product managers, project leaders, line managers, and engineers from other departments and competencies. Who are you?We are looking for a team-oriented colleague with a positive mindset. You love challenges and working together with others. You are passionate about product development from the first idea to holding the product in your hand. You like to challenge old truths and develop new innovative products. You are considerate and value good communication. Finally, and most importantly, you love being part of a creative and happy team that delivers outstanding products!In our department, we work with both mechanical designs, electromechanics, and several different types of manufacturing methods. We would like you to have experience or a strong interest in some of these areas (new graduates are welcome to apply):     Knowledge of at least one 3D CAD system, preferably Creo.    Prototype creation    Mechanical engineering background    Windchill/Creo knowledge    Injection molding/diecast/sheet metal    Design for production    Product development in telecommunications (4G, 5G), Wi-Fi, or GPS    Fluent in Swedish and English, both spoken and written. What can Axis offer you?A fantastic team with colleagues who want to succeed together with you. We learn and develop through our work with product development, and we are not afraid to try new things. Internal courses and external education are part of your work life here. From your first day, you will have a mentor colleague who helps you and teaches you how we work at Axis. Axis also has an excellent introduction program for new employees. We strive to give each individual great personal responsibility and opportunity to grow both as a person and professionally. You become part of a well-functioning team with engaged people who like going to work in the morning. We want you to thrive with us. Therefore, we offer fantastic benefits such as flexible working hours, morning coffee every day, Friday coffee, company bonus, health insurance, paid vacation, generous parental leave, generous sick/accident insurance, and your very own Axis bike - just to mention a few. What Axis has to offerWe are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact. Here, you'll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance - developing solutions used worldwide.As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You'll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance - and even your own Axis bicycle. To learn more about Axis, our innovative products, solutions, and vibrant company culture, explore: Life at Axis blog Engineering at Axis blog Innovation at Axis  Ready to act?If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact Engineering Manager Maiko Karlsson at phone number 046-272 1800.We review applications continuously, so don't wait to send in your application!

jobs.title: Kok søges
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Butikssäljare till OKQ8 Sörböle, behovsanställning
jobs.description: OK Västerbotten är en lokal förening som underlättar för människor i rörelse och verkar för ett hållbart och levande län. Vi ägs av våra västerbottniska medlemmar och drivs på demokratisk grund. Vi är idag över 90 000 medlemmar och driver 34 drivmedelsstationer runt om i Västerbotten, där 21 är bemannade. Samtliga stationer arbetar under varumärket OKQ8. Vi är ett lokalt, nytänkande och hållbart alternativ – för dig och oss, för samhället och miljön. Vi vill att hela vårt län ska leva – för då kan vi fortsätta spela viktig roll för Västerbotten, för orterna där vi finns och för människorna som bor och färdas här. Som medarbetare hos oss spelar du en viktig roll i vår folkrörelse för ett levande län.Är du en serviceinriktad lagspelare? I så fall kan vi erbjuda dig ett roligt arbete i en spännande miljö där ingen dag är den andra lik, med stor variation på arbetsuppgifterna. Ena sekunden hyr du ut ett släp för att snabbt skifta till att servera mat. På våra stationer är det ofta ett högt tempo där du och dina kollegor tar hand om våra kunder och deras önskemål.Vi sökerDu är en positiv person som gillar att träffa nya människor. Du tycker om att arbeta i högt tempo och ser fram emot att vara en del av ett sammansvetsat team som tillsammans löser det arbetsdagen har att bjuda på. Som säljare på en OKQ8-station är du företagets yttersta representant och vi förväntar oss att du ser varje kundmöte som början på en långvarig relation. Det är meriterande om du tidigare har jobbat med service eller försäljning. B-körkort är ett formellt krav.Vi erbjuderPå våra stationer erbjuder vi en spännande arbetsplats, med rolig atmosfär och härliga kollegor. Här arbetar människor i alla åldrar med olika bakgrund. Vi tror på utveckling av oss själva och jobbar tillsammans som ett team för att nå uppsatta mål. Hos oss har du möjlighet att bli en framgångsrik säljare som har roligt på arbetet.Som Butikssäljare arbetar du skifttjänstgöring. Denna tjänst är en behovsanställning. Stationen har öppet vardagar mellan klockan 06:00 - 00:00 och helger mellan klockan 08:00 - 00:00.Kan du göra oss ännu bättre? Sök då tjänsten redan idag!OK Västerbotten arbetar för att vara en jämställd arbetsplats med medarbetare som trivs och utvecklas och där olikheter uppmuntras. Vi vill vara ett företag som speglar samhället, med en inkluderande kultur som hjälper till att minska utanförskap och bidrar till mångfald.Våra medarbetare är vår viktigaste tillgång och en förutsättning för att vi ska nå framgång som företag. Här kan du ta del av vad vi erbjuder som arbetsgivare, både för att attrahera och behålla medarbetare.    Varierande arbete som gör skillnad - Varje dag på din station bjuder på omväxlande arbetsuppgifter och erfarenheter. Du är inte bara proffs på service och en problemlösare, du förbereder och serverar mat och hjälper till med enklare bilvård vilket ger dig en bredd av kompetenser. Under arbetsdagarna varvas högt tempo med lugnare stunder. Att jobba på en station i Västerbotten innebär att du är med och underlättar för människor i rörelse och verkar för ett hållbart och levande län.    Spännande möten med människor - Stationsmedarbetare är ett socialt yrke där du träffar nya människor varje dag. Och genom vänlig service och professionell attityd gör du stor skillnad för våra kunders upplevelse av OKQ8.    Team som skapar framgång - Tillsammans med dina kollegor är du en del av det kompetenta team som möter våra kunder varje dag. Med hög arbetsmoral som innebär att vara proaktiv, hugga i där det behövs och göra det lilla extra skapar ni gemensamt stationens framgång – och har roligt under tiden. Hos oss är det inte ovanligt att medarbetare blir vänner för livet.    Utveckling och karriär - När vi anställer medarbetare investerar vi även i dig som person. Din bakgrund är inte det viktigaste – däremot din inställning och vilja att göra ett bra arbete. För dig som vill ta ytterligare ett steg i karriären erbjuder vi fina möjligheter, flera av våra stationschefer började som stationsmedarbetare. Genom arbetets alla utmaningar utvecklas du inte bara i ditt arbete – utan även som människa.

jobs.title: Palvelupäällikkö pääkaupunkiseudun puhtauspalvelutiimiin
jobs.description: Tule palvelupäälliköksi SOLin auringon alle Haluatko johtaa monipuolista palveluliiketoimintaa, kehittää asiakkuuksia ja rakentaa yhdessä tiimisi kanssa entistä parempaa työarkea?Etsimme puhtaanapidon liiketoimintaamme palvelupäällikköä Vantaan sekä Keski- ja Itä-Uudenmaan alueelle vakituiseen ja kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen.Tässä tehtävässä pääset vaikuttamaanPalvelupäällikkönä vastaat oman alueesi palveluliiketoiminnan tuloksellisesta kehittämisestä sekä asiakassuhteista, laadusta ja sujuvasta arjesta. Johdat toimintaa yhdessä alueen palveluesihenkilöiden kanssa ja toimit tiiviissä yhteistyössä palvelujohtajan sekä asiakkaidemme kanssa.Saat käyttää osaamistasi ja näkemyksiäsi monipuolisesti. Pääset kehittämään niin liiketoimintaa, asiakkuuksia kuin henkilöstöäkin.Työhösi kuuluu muun muassa:- alueen liiketoiminnan ja kannattavuuden kehittäminen- asiakassuhteiden hoitaminen ja kehittäminen- palvelun laadun varmistaminen- palveluesihenkilöiden tukeminen ja johtaminen- henkilöstön osaamisen ja toiminnan kehittäminen- osallistuminen erilaisiin kehitysprojekteihin- myynnin tukeminen uusasiakashankinnassa ja käynnistyksissä.Asiakkuutesi muodostuvat eri toimialojen yritys- ja yhteisöasiakkaista, kuten terveydenhuollon yksiköistä, palvelutaloista, logistiikkakeskuksista, oppilaitoksista ja muista toimitiloista.Meille onnistumisen tärkeimpiä mittareita ovat tyytyväiset asiakkaat, hyvinvoiva henkilöstö ja kannattava liiketoiminta.Mitä tarjoamme sinulle? Saat vastuullisen tehtävän, jossa pääset aidosti vaikuttamaan oman alueesi toimintaan ja sen kehittämiseen. Tukenasi on osaava ja hyvähenkinen työyhteisö.Tarjoamme sinulle:- monipuolisen ja itsenäisen johtamistehtävän- osaavan tiimin ja kollegoiden tuen- mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamistasi ja oppia uutta- työsuhdeauton- kilpailukykyisen palkan (*)- kattavat henkilöstöedut, kuten laajan työterveyshuollon sekä liikunta- ja hierontaedun- joustoa työaikoihin- mahdollisuuden osittaiseen etätyöhön.*Palkka sovitaan osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi perusteella. Voit ilmoittaa palkkatoiveesi hakemuksessasi.Mitä toivomme sinulta?Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää ennen kaikkea kokemusta palveluliiketoiminnan ja ihmisten johtamisesta sekä kykyä rakentaa pitkäjänteisiä asiakassuhteita.Edellytämme sinulta:- vähintään kahden vuoden kokemusta puhtauspalvelutuotannon operatiivisesta johtamisesta- kokemusta puhtauspalveluiden johtamisesta erilaisissa toimintaympäristöissä, kuten terveydenhuollossa, logistiikassa, oppilaitoksissa tai muissa toimitiloissa- tehtävään soveltuvaa koulutusta, esimerkiksi restonomin AMK-tutkintoa puhtauspalveluiden alalta, siivousteknikon tutkintoa tai puhtaus- ja kiinteistöpalvelualan erikoisammattitutkintoa- hyvää suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa. Muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi- B-ajokorttia- hyviä tietoteknisiä perustaitoja.JYET-erikoisammattitutkinto katsotaan eduksi.Lisäksi arvostamme vahvoja vuorovaikutus- ja neuvottelutaitoja, asiakasymmärrystä sekä ratkaisukeskeistä ja uudistavaa työotetta. Etsimme henkilöä, joka tarttuu asioihin, saa ihmiset mukaansa ja haluaa kehittää toimintaa yhdessä muiden kanssa.Kiinnostuitko?Työsuhteen aloitusajankohta on neuvoteltavissa. Toivomme, että voisit aloittaa viimeistään tammikuun alussa.Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa palvelujohtaja Sigrid Rääk, etunimi.sukunimi(at)sol.fi.Hae tehtävää täyttämällä sähköinen hakulomakkeemme ja kerro meille itsestäsi, kokemuksestasi ja siitä, mitä osaamista juuri sinä toisit tiimiimme.Olemme yhteydessä kaikkiin hakijoihin viimeistään hakuajan päätyttyä.Haastattelut aloitetaan jo hakuaikana.Tervetuloa rakentamaan kanssamme parempaa palvelua, työarkea ja liiketoimintaa SOLin auringon alle! Tarjoamme- Liikunta- ja hierontaetu- Lakisääteistä laajempi työterveyshuolto- Edut voimassa koeajan jälkeenSOL Palvelut OySOL on osaava, monipuolinen ja kansainvälisesti toimiva suomalainen palvelualan perheyritys, jonka keskiössä on aurinkoisen tyytyväinen asiakas ja iloinen työn tekeminen.SOL Palvelut Oy:n palveluihin kuuluu siivous- ja toimitilapalvelut. Tarjoamme asiakkaillemme puhtauden ja korkean hygienian ratkaisuja, joilla vaikutamme työympäristöjen viihtyvyyteen ja turvallisuuteen.SOL Palvelut Oy on osa SOL-konsernia, joka työllistää noin 13 000 aurinkoista SOLilaista.SOL KONSERNIIloisiin SOLilaisiin kuuluu [turvallisuusalan, kiinteistönhuollon, talotekniikan, puhtaanapidon ja tekstiilihuollon ammattilaisia](https://www.sol.fi/). Lisäksi tarjoamme [henkilöstövuokrauspalveluja](https://www.sol.fi/palvelut/henkilostopalvelut/) joustavasti eri toimialoille.Arvostamme osaamista ja ammattitaitoa. Vahva osaaminen taataan räätälöidyillä perehdytyksillä, sisäisillä koulutuksilla sekä oppilaitosyhteistyöllä. Myös eteneminen on mahdollista erilaisten urapolkujen avulla. Työssäsi sinua kannustaa ja tukee oma esihenkilösi sekä koko tiimi.Iloinen työn tekeminen ja kannustava ilmapiiri ovat meille SOLissa tärkeitä. SOL Life-ohjelman avulla kehitämme työhyvinvointia sekä panostamme työntekijöidemme työturvallisuuteen.Arvostamme monimuotoisuutta työyhteisössä. Toivomme hakijoiksi eri ikäisiä ja eri sukupuolia olevia henkilöitä sekä kieli-, kulttuuri- tai muihin vähemmistöihin kuuluvia henkilöitä.[Lue lisää toimintamme vastuullisuudesta ja tarinastamme.](https://www.sol.fi/vastuullisuus/)[Ohjeet turvalliseen työhön](https://www.esitteemme.fi/SOL/MailView/)Meille on tärkeää työssä viihtyminen ja kannustava ilmapiiri – toimintaamme ohjaavat SOL arvot: aurinkoisen tyytyväinen asiakas, arkiluovuus, yrittäjyys, luotettavuus ja iloinen työn tekeminen.Jos nämä arvot resonoivat kanssasi, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö!Arvostamiamme ominaisuuksia ovat myös oma-aloitteisuus, vastuullisuus ja täsmällisyys.Sähköposti: etunimi.sukunimi@sol.fi Sijainti: Vantaa ja lähialueet

jobs.title: Myynnillinen asiakasyhteyshenkilö ja tuleva telineosaamisen asiantuntija, SRKV Oy, RekryKoulutus
jobs.description: Tehtävässä toimit myyntipäällikön ja yrittäjien työparina ammattiasiakkaiden, kuten rakennusliikkeiden, pk-yritysten ja teollisuuden, kalustoratkaisuista ja asiakaspalvelussa. Tärkeintä on kuitenkin kaupallinen asenne ja se, että olet ihmisten kanssa pärjäävä hyvä tyyppi. Tarjoamme monipuolisen työnkuvan ja mahdollisuuden kasvaa alan erikoisosaajaksi tiiviissä tiimissämme.**Korkeakoulutettu – löydä itsesi näköinen työpaikka RekryKoulutuksen kautta!**Korkeakoulutettujen RekryKoulutus on suunnattu eri ikäisille ja eri alojen korkeakoulutetuille työnhakijoille, jotka haluavat työllistyä alueen yrityksiin. jobs.title: Lähihoitaja, Elontien ryhmäkoti (ruotsinkielinen)
jobs.description: Etsimme lähihoitajaa Elontien ruotsinkieliseen ryhmäkotiin Helsinkiin vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Työsuhde alkaa sopimuksen mukaan. Työ on jaksotyötä.Elontie on ryhmäkoti aikuisille vammaisille henkilöille, joiden palveluntarpeet vaihtelevat. Useat asiakkaistamme osallistuvat päivätoimintaan arkipäivisin. Ryhmäkodissa on kahdeksan asuntoa sekä yhteisiä tiloja, kuten keittiö, olohuone ja pyykkitupa. Yksikkö sijaitsee Länsi-Pakilassa rauhallisella pientaloalueella hyvien kulkuyhteyksien varrella.Tarjoamme kodinomaista ja asiakaslähtöistä asumispalvelua, joka perustuu jokaisen asiakkaan omiin toiveisiin ja tarpeisiin. Rakennamme yhdessä turvallista ja virikkeellistä kotiympäristöä, jossa asiakkailla on mahdollisuus mielekkääseen tekemiseen.Lähihoitajana olet tärkeä osa asiakkaidemme arkea. Työ on monipuolista ja sisältää hoitoa ja huolenpitoa, kodinhoidollisia tehtäviä, ulkoilua, retkiä ja yhteisiä hetkiä asiakkaiden kanssa. Teet myös yhteistyötä asiakkaiden läheisten kanssa ja kirjaat asiakastyötä.Työskentelymme lähtökohtana ovat asiakkaan osallisuus, itsemääräämisoikeus ja valinnanvapaus. Arvostamme henkilökohtaista soveltuvuutta ja etsimme sinua, joka olet kiinnostunut työskentelemään vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa ja nautit ihmisten parissa työskentelystä. Olet empaattinen, kohtaat ihmiset arvostavasti ja sinulla on avoin asenne. Arvostamme myös myönteistä työotetta ja herkkyyttä asiakkaiden yksilöllisille tarpeille. Tarjoamme sinulle kattavan perehdytyksen työhön.Saat yhteensä 1 000 euron rekrytointilisän: 500 euroa työsuhteen alussa ja toiset 500 euroa, kun työsuhteesi on jatkunut kuusi kuukautta.Mielenkiintoisen ja monipuolisen työn lisäksi tarjoamme sinulle kattavat koulutus- ja kehittymismahdollisuudet. Kaupungin työntekijänä voit hakea Auroranlinnan vuokra-asuntoa, jossa vuokrataso on markkinahintoja edullisempi ja kaupungin työntekijöiden hakemukset ovat etusijalla.Koska elämä on muutakin kuin työtä, haluamme tukea työn ja vapaa-ajan tasapainoa. Saat käyttöösi Epassi Flex -kokonaisuuden, joka sisältää liikunta-, kulttuuri-, työmatka- ja hyvinvointiedut. Edun arvo voi olla enintään 550 euroa kalenterivuodessa, ja käytettävissä olevan saldon määrä riippuu työsuhteesi kestosta. Lisäksi saat lounasedun. Henkilöstöetuna käytössäsi on myös kaupunkipyöräetu, ja halutessasi voit viettää vapaa-aikaa kaupungin henkilöstön omalla virkistyssaarella.KelpoisuusehdotTehtävän kelpoisuusehtona on lähihoitajan ammatillinen tutkinto. Edellytämme rekisteröitymistä Lupa- ja valvontaviraston (entinen Valvira) terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöiden keskusrekisteriin.Kielitaitovaatimuksena on hyvä ruotsin kielen suullinen ja kirjallinen taito sekä tyydyttävä suomen kielen taito.Valittavan henkilön tulee ennen valintapäätöstä esittää työterveyshuollon arvio edellytyksistään hoitaa tehtävää. Lisäksi edellytetään huumausainetestiä koskevaa todistusta, joka tulee esittää työnantajalle ennen työsuhteen alkamista.Tehtävässä edellytetään tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa.Edellytämme LOVE/LOP-lääkehoitoluvan suorittamista hyväksytysti viimeistään koeajan aikana.Tehtävään valittavan, vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa työskentelevän henkilön on esitettävä rikosrekisteriote (laki sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta 741/2023, 28 §).

jobs.title: Restaurant Manager
jobs.description:
About the position

Crispy Corner ApS is seeking an experienced and responsible Restaurant Manager to manage the daily operations of our restaurant.

The Restaurant Manager will be responsible for ensuring efficient restaurant operations, good customer service, staff coordination, food quality and compliance with applicable Danish food safety and workplace regulations.

Main duties
  • Manage and coordinate the daily operation of the restaurant.
  • Plan and coordinate staff shifts and daily work activities.
  • Supervise and support restaurant employees.
  • Train and introduce new employees. 
  • Handle customer enquiries and complaints professionally.
  • Monitor food quality, hygiene and food safety.
  • Monitor stock levels and coordinate orders with suppliers.
  • Ensure that company procedures and Danish regulations are followed.
  • Assist with planning and improving restaurant operations. 
Qualifications and experience
  • Relevant experience in restaurant management or a similar supervisory position.
  • Experience with staff coordination and daily restaurant operations.
  • Good organisational and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and take responsibility.
  • Ability to work in a busy restaurant environment.
  • Knowledge of food hygiene and safety procedures.
  • Good English communication skills.
  • Danish language skills are an advantage.
We offer
  • Full-time employment of 37 hours per week.
  • A professional working environment.
  • Responsibility for daily restaurant operations. 

 

 

Contact person: Shammi Sarker 

Tlf:  71865334

jobs.title: Danish speaking Customer Service Representative for SAS!
jobs.description: Concentrix is a global company specializing in technology and services, supporting the brands of the future in more than 70 countries. With some of the world’s largest and most well-known brands in our client portfolio, there is a high chance that you have already interacted with one of our 440,000 Concentrix employees. Our game-changers deliver world-class customer service for our clients’ customers, helping businesses grow and build strong relationships.If you want to be inspired and grow in your career, we encourage you to apply for the role of Travel Agent for our brand-new client SAS and become part of our global network of employees. You will be part of the team creating outstanding customer service experiences for SAS’ private customers. In this role, you will work from our office in Helsingborg, Sweden.About the RoleYour daily work will involve providing world-class support via phone and chat to SAS’ Danish private customers. This may include inquiries regarding flight reservations, payments, refunds, and online services, to mention just a few. You will also be responsible for providing information about flight schedules, available destinations, and special requirements (wheelchair passengers, traveling with pets, etc.). In addition, you will be an expert in planning and proposing smart solutions for customers in difficult situations such as canceled flights, delays, or schedule changes.To Thrive in This RoleWe are looking for someone who is an excellent listener, proactive, and always strives to create an outstanding customer experience. You are naturally positive and energetic and balance professionalism with personality and engagement. You are good at expressing and explaining yourself both verbally and in writing. You enjoy working independently and are flexible when it comes to changes in your work. Stress tolerance is an important quality to succeed in this role.    You speak and write Danish fluently (C1) and English (B2).    You can work within the opening hours Monday–Friday 07:00–19:15 and weekends 09:00–18:15.    You can work from our office in Helsingborg.    You are at least 18 years old.    You have good computer skills.    6 months of customer contact experience.What We OfferWe will ensure you have the best opportunities to succeed in this role by offering a 7-week training program combining practical training and hands-on experience. You will work with modern equipment and support staff who will help you develop into an excellent customer representative. In addition, you will receive regular feedback to support your development. At Concentrix, there is always a career path for those who want it—nearly 80% of our team leaders have been promoted internally.    A total of 7 weeks of training.    The opportunity to start something completely new together with dedicated colleagues.    25 paid vacation days per year as well as other benefits.    Internal career programs.Job DetailsStart date: 2027-01-04Employment type: Full-time with a 6-month probation periodWorking hours: Monday–Friday 07:00–19:15 and weekends 09:00–18:15 (your shifts will be scheduled within these hours, 40 hours/week)Location: Concentrix office in Helsingborg, Rönnowsgatan 8cHas this caught your interest? Don’t hesitate to send us your application right away!

jobs.title: Design Engineer Accessories  Husqvarna Group
jobs.description: We’re one of the world’s oldest start-ups — and we’re just getting started.CE&ACC R&D consists of approximately 30 colleagues across three teams: two development teams and one test and verification team. We are now looking for an engaged mechanical engineer to join our Accessories team. Accessories develops a broad range of products, including carrying systems, personal protective equipment such as helmets and hearing protection, tools and equipment for forestry work and arborists, as well as several other product areas. The Accessories team consists of five mechanical engineers and a Group Manager. It is a experienced team where colleagues work closely together, exchange knowledge and use each other’s experience even when working in different projects and initiatives. The team values openness, humility, shared learning and individual ownership. Role DescriptionAs a Design Engineer Accessories, you will work with both new product development and product maintenance, taking ideas from early concepts through to industrialized products. You will be part of cross-functional development projects and collaborate with R&D, Global Design, Purchasing, Product Management, test laboratories, factories and external suppliers. Your responsibilities will include:    Developing concepts and prototypes and following up samples and test results together with test engineers.    Taking technical responsibility for the approval of parts and products within your scope.    Creating 3D models in Catia V5, drawings and technical documentation.    Building and maintaining BOM structures in Teamcenter.    Ensuring technical documentation meets requirements through internal and external reviews.    Independently planning and driving your work across both development and maintenance activities.The role involves close collaboration with functions such as testing, calculation, quality, manufacturing and external partners. Occasional travel may be required, mainly within Sweden and only exceptionally internationally.Your profileYou are analytical, structured and able to independently plan and drive your work. At the same time, you are creative and take initiative, turning ideas into practical results. You enjoy working collaboratively, sharing knowledge and contributing with an open and humble approach. We believe you have:    A Bachelor’s degree or higher in Engineering, preferably within product development or mechanical engineering.    3-5 years of mechanical design experience, including injection-moulded plastic components.    Good knowledge of Catia V5 and experience working in a PDM/PLM system.    Knowledge of polymer materials, measurement technology and geometric assurance.    Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.Experience with Teamcenter, Catia V5 surface modelling, injection-moulding tools and polymer manufacturing processes, GD&T, cost calculations, technical project management, time estimation or verification and validation testing is considered an advantage.Location This position will be placed in one of our main sites in Huskvarna. We believe the best ideas happen when we're connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive. Your Application: Apply as soon as possible. We are screening on an ongoing basis and will fill this position as soon as we have found the right person. We do not accept application via e-mail due to GDPR. For more information about the position, contact hiring manager Robert Persson on Robert.persson@husqvarnagrpup.com. For questions regarding the process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Gorjana Dubovina on Gorjana.dubovina@husqvarnagroup.comProcessing of personal data When you send in your application we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer. For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and your rights, please see our privacy notice. Winning Through Culture We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters. Our culture is built on three core themes:     Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities.     Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.     Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference. Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future!

jobs.title: HR-Rådgiver
jobs.description:
Som HR-rådgiver vil du være en viktig støtte for ledere i både daglige og komplekse HR-spørsmål. Du vil bidra til gode rekrutteringsprosesser, sikre etterlevelse av lov- og avtaleverk, bistå i arbeidsrettslige spørsmål og være en sentral aktør i utviklings- og omstillingsarbeid. Rollen innebærer også ansvar for sentrale samarbeidsarenaer som medbestemmelse og arbeidsmiljøutvalg, samt arbeid innen HMS, analyse og organisasjonsutvikling.  

Dette er en nøkkelrolle for deg som ønsker å kombinere HR-faglig dybde med reell påvirkningskraft. Som HR-rådgiver får du arbeide tett på ledelsen og bidra til viktige beslutninger som påvirker både medarbeidere, arbeidsmiljø og virksomhetens utvikling. Rollen spenner fra operative HR-prosesser til strategisk rådgivning, og gir en unik mulighet til å jobbe bredt innen rekruttering, arbeidsrett, organisasjonsutvikling, medbestemmelse, HMS og lederstøtte. Du vil være en sentral sparringspartner i komplekse HR-saker, samtidig som du får bidra til å utvikle en profesjonell, helhetlig og fremtidsrettet arbeidsgiverpraksis. For deg som motiveres av samfunnsoppdraget, samarbeid og muligheten til å skape varige forbedringer, er dette en rolle med både faglig bredde, ansvar og utviklingsmuligheter. 

Halden kommune ligger 90 minutters kjøring fra Oslo, 20 minutter fra vår naboby Strømstad og 2 timer fra Gøteborg. Kommunen ligger idyllisk ved sjøen og har et ypperlig turterreng. Arbeidsmarkedet finner vi på begge sider av landegrensen, og kommunen har et aktivt og rikt kultur- og organisasjonsliv. 

Nav Halden – Aremark består av ca. 90 medarbeidere, fordelt på fire avdelinger og en stabsfunksjon med dyktige ansatte som leverer gode tjenester til innbyggerne i begge kommunene. Våre tjenester skal i størst mulig grad være tilpasset hver enkelt innbyggers behov, der veiledernes kompetanse matches med det behovet innbyggeren har. 

Arbeidsoppgaver

Rådgivning og støtte til ledere: 

  • innen HR, personalforvaltning og arbeidsrett 
  • ved ansettelser, herunder skriving av behovsanalyser, annonsering, intervjureferater og innstillinger 
  • ved behov i personalsaker, sykefraværsoppfølging og nærværsarbeid 
  • ved planlegging og koordinering av medbestemmelsesprosesser og arbeidsmiljøutvalg 
  • utviklings- og omstillingsprosesser 
  • oppfølging av lønnsprosesser og rådgivning i lønnspolitiske spørsmål 
  • utarbeidelse av analyser og beslutningsgrunnlag knyttet til blant annet sykefravær, bemanning og organisasjonsutvikling 
  • utvikling og kvalitetssikring av HR-rutiner, rollebeskrivelser o.l. 
  • oppfølging av HMS-arbeid og utvikling av arbeidsmiljø  
  • samarbeid med tillitsvalgte, vernetjeneste, bedriftshelsetjeneste og andre samarbeidspartnere  
Kvalifikasjoner

Dersom du vil bli HR-Rådgiver hos oss må du ha: 

  • Relevant høyere utdanning på minimum bachelornivå innen HR, organisasjon, ledelse, arbeidsrett, statsvitenskap eller tilsvarende. Relevant erfaring kan veie opp for utdanningskravet
  • God kunnskap om arbeidsrettslig lovgivning og sentrale deler av statlig avtaleverk 
  • Erfaring fra HR-arbeid, personalforvaltning og/eller arbeidsgiverstøtte 
  • Erfaring med rådgivning til ledere 
  • Erfaring med rekruttering og ansettelsesprosesser, fortrinnsvis i offentlig sektor 
  • God skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne på norsk 
  • God digital kompetanse og erfaring med bruk av HR- og saksbehandlingssystemer 

Kravene må kunne dokumenteres og all utenlandsk utdanning må være Hk.dir/Nokut godkjent.

Det er en fordel om du også har: 

  • Erfaring fra offentlig sektor, gjerne statlig virksomhet 
  • Erfaring med arbeidsmiljøarbeid, sykefraværsoppfølging og HMS 
  • Erfaring med medbestemmelse, partsamarbeid eller arbeid i AMU 
  • Kunnskap om lønnsdannelse og lokale lønnsforhandlinger 
  • Erfaring med organisasjonsutvikling, endringsarbeid eller omstillingsprosesser 
  • Erfaring med HR-analyser, rapportering og bruk av styringsdata 
Personlige egenskaper

Vi ser etter deg som: 

  • Har høy faglig integritet og rolleforståelse 
  • Evner å bygge gode relasjoner og skape tillit 
  • Er strukturert, selvstendig og leverer med høy kvalitet 
  • Har gode samarbeidsevner og trives i samspill med ledere, ansatte og tillitsvalgte 
  • Kan håndtere komplekse problemstillinger og gjøre gode faglige vurderinger 
  • Evner å kombinere strategisk tenkning med operativ gjennomføring.  

Personlig egnethet vil bli særlig vektlagt. 

Vi tilbyr

Vi ønsker å gjøre jobbsøkerprosessen så enkel som mulig. Derfor trenger du ikke å skrive jobbsøknad til denne stillingen.En oppdatert og utfyllende CV, sammen med svar på screeningspørsmål er derfor mer enn nok.

  • Spennende og meningsfylte arbeidsoppgaver innenfor et viktig samfunnsområde i et utviklingsorientert og passe stort Nav-kontor med et godt fagmiljø 
  • Gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling i et godt arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte og inkluderende kollegaer 
  • En arbeidsplass med myndiggjorte medarbeidere og aktiv medbestemmelse 
  • Stilling som 1434 rådgiver i lønnsspenn kr 639.000 - 729.000 per år. Høyere lønn og evt. seniorrådgiverkode 1364 kan vurderes for særlig godt kvalifiserte søkere. Kompetanse og erfaring legges til grunn ved vurdering av stillingskode og lønn. 
  • God pensjons-, og forsikringsordning i Statens pensjonskasse (fra lønnen trekkes 2 %) 
KontaktinformasjonNadine Deidok, enhetsleder, 908 97 986 ArbeidsstedStorgata 8 1771 Halden Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Nav Referansenr.: 5190760910 Stillingsprosent: 100% Fast Søknadsfrist: 25.10.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Nav søker ansatte med hjerte for mennesker og våre fagområder. Vår visjon er å gi mennesker muligheter, og dette gjør vi ved å utvikle Norges beste arbeids- og velferdstjenester.

Nav består av 22 000 kompetente og engasjerte medarbeidere. Vi jobber tverrfaglig i sterke fagmiljøer. Hos oss skal arbeidsmiljøet preges av involvering, åpenhet og tillit.

Mangfold er viktig i Nav. Mangfold bidrar til bedre problemløsing, økt kreativitet, større fleksibilitet og styrker kulturen og arbeidsmiljøet på arbeidsplassen. Vi oppfordrer derfor kandidater med ulik bakgrunn til å søke på stillinger hos oss, spesielt om du har hull i CV-en, innvandrerbakgrunn eller nedsatt funksjonsevne.

Når du søker jobb hos oss, vil navnet ditt stå på en offentlig søkerliste. Ønsker du å bli unntatt fra offentlig søkerliste må du begrunne dette. Del gjerne ditt vitnemål eller karakterutskrift via vitnemålsportalen.no.

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Why Doktor.seDoktor.se is Sweden's largest digital healthcare provider. We combine physical clinics with a digital platform serving millions of consultations per year across Sweden, Germany, and Norway. Our 25-person engineering team has startup autonomy inside a profitable, international organization with 1,000+ employees and over 1B SEK in revenue.We run OpenAI and Anthropic models in production across patient and clinician workflows, and that footprint is growing fast.What you'll doOur infrastructure works, but it was built to solve yesterday's problems. We need someone who can help us get to where we want to be — not maintain what we have, but reshape it. If you want a place where everything is already figured out, this isn't it. If you want to build something better, here's what you'd own:    Build a deployment platform where teams ship their own services without asking you for permission.    Design infrastructure that is secure by default, so teams don't have to think about encryption, network isolation, or data residency. It just works.    Create deployment pipelines where security scanning, policy checks, and compliance happen automatically, invisible when everything is fine, loud when something needs attention.    Support and scale infrastructure for AI workloads, we run models in production across our platform, and that footprint is growing.    Set up observability that gives teams real insight into their own services, useful dashboards, alerts that mean something, not noise that everyone ignores.    Work closely with developers to understand what slows them down, and then fix it. Not by doing it for them, but by making it easy for them to do it themselves.    Maintain and evolve our cloud account structure, networking, and identity management across multiple regions and products.    You will report to to, and work close with, our Head of Product and Technology. You will be the go to person in technical strategical questions and the technical sounding board — advising on complex technical decisions and translating product/business direction into what's actually feasible.Some weeks you'll write infrastructure code. Some weeks you'll pair with a developer to debug a slow service. Some weeks you'll design how a new product gets its own isolated infrastructure. The common thread: you make the teams around you better.Make developers faster, not more dependent on you.What we're looking for    You've built and operated Kubernetes in production. Not just deployed a Helm chart once, you've debugged networking issues, designed RBAC policies, and thought about how multiple teams share a cluster without stepping on each other.    You know AWS well. Accounts, networking, IAM, KMS. You have opinions about what should live in Kubernetes and what genuinely needs to be an AWS managed service, and you lean toward keeping things in Kubernetes where possible.    You've worked with GitOps and infrastructure as code. Flux, ArgoCD, Terrafor, specific tools matter less than the principle: infrastructure changes go through pull requests, are reviewed, and are auditable.    You understand developers because you are one. You can read their code, understand their pipelines, and have meaningful conversations about architecture.    You think about security as something you design into systems, not something you review at the end.    You have opinions, and you can change them when someone makes a better argument.    University degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent experience.Tech stackCloud - AWS (multi-account, multi-region)Orchestration - Kubernetes / EKSIaC - TerraformCI/CD - GitHub ActionsLanguages - Python, TypeScriptAI - OpenAI, Anthropic (in production and tooling)Observability - Datadog / Grafana (you'll shape this)What we offer    Real influence. You'll shape how our platform works, not just operate what someone else designed.    Healthcare context. Patient data, regulatory compliance, and real consequences for getting it wrong. What you build actually matters.    Small team, direct impact. 25 engineers, your work is visible, not lost in a machine.    Autonomy. No micromanagement, no endless approval chains.    AI in production. We're running LLMs in patient and clinician workflows today, the infrastructure needs to grow with that.    Collective agreement, 30 days vacation, wellness allowance, personal development budget.Practical details    Start: As soon as we find the right person. jobs.title: Natteravn med truckcertifikat? Så har vi jobbet til dig!
jobs.description:
Vi søger 3 operatører til natholdet

Medarbejderne ApS søger på vegne af en mellemstor produktionsvirksomhed beliggende mellem Viborg og Silkeborg 3 operatører til nathold.

Virksomheden producerer mineralblandinger til landbruget og lægger stor vægt på kvalitet, præcision og et godt arbejdsmiljø, hvor samarbejde og en positiv omgangstone er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du bliver en del af produktionen, hvor dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil være:

  • Udtapning og påfyldning af produkter i bigbags.

  • Truckkørsel i forbindelse med håndtering og flytning af produkter.

  • Aflæsning og efterfølgelse af produktionsopskrifter.

  • Korrekt dosering af de forskellige ingredienser og mineralblandinger.

  • Korrekt mærkning af de færdige produkter.

  • Oprydning og rengøring af arbejdsområdet efter endt skift, så produktionen er klar til dagholdet.

Det er vigtigt, at du arbejder struktureret og omhyggeligt, da korrekt dosering og mærkning har stor betydning for produktets kvalitet.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Har et gyldigt truckcertifikat – det er et krav.

  • Taler, læser og forstår dansk, så du kan læse, forstå og følge produktionsopskrifter og arbejdsinstruktioner.

  • Er ansvarsbevidst, kvalitetsbevidst og omhyggelig i dit arbejde.

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig trives med at være en del af et team.

  • Har en positiv indstilling og bidrager til et godt samarbejde og en god omgangstone.

  • Er indstillet på fysisk arbejde og på at holde orden omkring dig.

Erfaring fra produktion er en fordel, men det vigtigste er, at du har den rette indstilling og lyst til at gøre en god indsats.

Hvad kan du se frem til?

Du bliver en del af en mellemstor virksomhed med en god arbejdskultur, hvor man hjælper hinanden, tager ansvar og bidrager til et godt fællesskab. Her er det vigtigt, at alle gør deres bedste, passer ind i teamet og er med til at sikre en god tone i hverdagen.

Arbejdstid

Du arbejder på nathold fra søndag nat til fredag nat.

Opstart

Vi ønsker opstart snarest muligt.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Har du truckcertifikat, trives du med natarbejde, og er du klar til at blive en del af et godt team? Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig!

Medarbejderne ApS håndterer ansættelsen for virksomheden. Bemærk at ansøgninger og CV via mail bliver IKKE behandlet! Du kan ansøge om stillingen via dette link; https://medarbejderne.peopletrust.dk/candidate/?module=candidateweb&page=Job&action=readMore&jobId=1020177

Medarbejderne ApS er et veldrevet rekruttering og vikarbureau med over 20 års erfaring. Vi har kontorer 9 forskellige i landet. Vi er medlem af VikarBranchen i DI, hvilket forpligtiger os til at overheolde et sæt regler. Du er i gode hænder hos os.

jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja, PÄIVÄ/ILTAVUOROJA, Raisio/keskusta

Samtidigt har du ett starkt affärstänk och förstår hur försäljning, service och kundupplevelse tillsammans skapar en framgångsrik verksamhet. jobs.title: Vil du jobbe i et nyetablert BPA tiltak?
jobs.employer: SANDEFJORD KOMMUNE PRAKTISK BISTAND - YTRE SONE
jobs.description:
Om tjenestested

En BPA ordning skal bidra til å gi mennesker med assistansebehov muligheten til å leve et aktivt og mest mulig uavhengig liv. Med en BPA ordning er det brukeren selv, eventuelt med bistand, som organiserer og leder arbeidet med assistentene. Det kreves ingen formell kompetanse for arbeidet, personlig egnethet vil vektlegges. Arbeidet består i å være tilgjengelig for brukeren i deres hjem og bistå i daglige aktiviteter.  

 

Jeg er en blid, livlig og sosial jente på 19 år som bor sammen med foreldrene mine. Jeg sitter i rullestol, men med ortoser kan jeg gå korte avstander. Jeg har ikke talespråk, men kommuniserer godt ved å skrive på telefonen min. Jeg bruker også lyder og kroppsspråk for å gjøre meg forstått. Jeg har epilepsi og PEG, og får sondemat gjennom PEG-en.

Jeg liker å smake på most mat og synes det er spennende å prøve nye smaker, så lenge maten har riktig konsistens. Jeg liker også å prøve ulike drikker og brus.

Ved forflytning samarbeider jeg godt og bidrar med det jeg kan, så arbeidet innebærer ikke tunge løft. Jeg liker å være velstelt og personlig hygiene er viktig for meg. Derfor trenger jeg bistand til blant annet stell, dusj, påkledning og andre daglige rutiner.

Jeg liker å ha det gøy, være sosial og finne på ulike aktiviteter. For meg er det viktig å komme meg ut, oppleve ting og være sammen med andre. Jeg trenger derfor en assistent som kan hjelpe og støtte meg i hverdagen, slik at jeg kan være så aktiv og selvstendig som mulig.

Du vil få god opplæring av både meg og familien min. Jeg har to søstre som vil fungere som arbeidsledere i tiltaket, mye av dialogen og samarbeidet vil gå gjennom dem, i tillegg til meg.

På dagtid er jeg opptatt, samt noen ettermiddager i uken. Derfor ser jeg etter BPA assistenter som kan være hos meg de ettermiddagene jeg er hjemme, og noen helger i måneden. Det er viktig for meg å få en god relasjon til menneskene jeg har rundt meg.

 På grunn av arbeidets art, som blant annet innebærer personlig stell og ivaretakelse av privatliv, oppfordres kvinner til å søke.

Stillingstype: Ringevikar, med mulighet for fast etter hvert

Stilling ledig fra: Snarest

 

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Personlig stell og dusj
  • Tilberedning og hjelp med sondemat via PEG
  • Medisiner
  • Bistand ved forflytning og bruk av ortoser
  • Følge til og bistå på aktiviteter
  • Kommunikasjon og støtte i hverdagen
  • Praktisk hjelp i hjemmet

 

Kvalifikasjoner

  • At du er trygg, omsorgsfull og ansvarsbevisst
  • At du behersker arbeidsoppgavene godt og er villig til å lære
  • At du er tålmodig og tar deg tid til å forstå min måte å kommunisere på
  • At du er positiv, sosial og liker å være med på aktiviteter
  • At du samarbeider godt med meg, familien min og andre rundt meg
  • At du er pålitelig og bidrar til trygghet og gode rutiner i hverdagen
  • Personlig egnethet og god kjemi vil bli tillagt stor vekt
  • Sertifikat for manuelt gir

 

Vi tilbyr

Lønn og pensjon

Stillingen er plassert i kommunens lønnsregulativ i henhold til gjeldende tariffavtale og i stillingskode 6583.

Årslønn i stillingen vil ligge i spennet fra 0 til 16 års ansienniet, kr 418 600 - 515 800.

Som ansatt er du medlem av Sandefjord kommunale pensjonskasse/KLP/Statens pensjonskasse.

 

 

Andre opplysninger

Gjensidig prøvetid er 6 måneder. Kommunen følger offentlighetsloven § 25 ved eventuell offentliggjøring av søkerliste.Du skal ikke sende inn vitnemål og attester. Ta med kopier av disse til et eventuelt intervju.

For stillinger der det er krav om politiattest, må godkjent attest fremvises før ansettelse.

Vi er en arbeidsgiver som verdsetter likestilling og inkludering. Vi oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke, uavhengig av kjønn, etnisitet, religion, funksjonsevne eller seksuell orientering, da vi ønsker personer med ulik bakgrunn og erfaring i våre tjenester.

jobs.title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
UpSlide is the document production layer for financial services. We orchestrate LLMs, machine learning, and workflow agents within Microsoft 365 to deliver reliable, quality outputs in the most efficient and cost-effective way.

As a Microsoft Solutions Partner, with 14+ years supporting financial services teams, we bring together expertise from the tech, finance and design fields to help clients like KPMG, BNP Paribas, Rothschild & Co. boost productivity while improving brand consistency across their corporate documents. 

We are a certified B Corporation, upholding the belief that businesses should have a positive impact on society.

✨ Our values

Our values guide our approach to work and are at the heart of our recruitment process. To join our team, we look for individuals who value:

  • Excellence: We think that every detail counts, and we place great importance on the quality of our deliverables.

  • Trust: We are passionate, committed, and free to act with autonomy.

  • Happiness at work: We enjoy looking on the bright side and we share our enthusiasm with our colleagues and clients.

🤝 The team

You will join our Enterprise Customer Success team for the EMEA, APAC, and NA regions, a group of Customer Success Managers, each responsible for a focused portfolio of our largest and most strategic accounts.

You will join a team of 6, including 5 CSMs and Majhon, Head of Customer Success Enterprise, who will support you in achieving your goals. You will also be part of a global Customer Success community across our five offices.

Here is what the Go-To-Market organization looks like at UpSlide:

  • Account Executives: Prospect, acquire new business acquisition and expand existing accounts

  • Consultants: Lead implementation projects, deliver client training, and ensure successful deployment

  • Customer Success Managers: Own a portfolio of accounts end-to-end, driving retention, renewal signing, expansion within existing entities, value realization, and long-term account growth

  • Support Engineers: Resolve day-to-day technical questions and issues, and ensure a smooth customer experience

🖋️ Your responsibilities

As an Enterprise Customer Success Manager, you will own the end-to-end relationship with a portfolio of our largest, most strategic accounts. You will build deep, multi-threaded relationships with key stakeholders, lead high-impact business reviews, and act as a trusted advisor, proactively protecting and growing revenue across your book through both retention and expansion.

This is a role for someone who thrives on depth: fewer accounts, higher stakes, and the ability to build genuine, senior-level relationships that compound into long-term growth, while knowing how to sync with regional counterparts on accounts that span multiple geographies, keeping a global view of the relationship without owning every part of it directly.

Account Ownership & Revenue Growth (50%)

Own the business performance, strategy, and health of your portfolio of strategic accounts:

  • Take full ownership of your portfolio (ARR, NRR, renewal, risk level)

  • Build and execute structured, tailored account plans for 100% of your accounts, with clear growth and retention objectives

  • Proactively identify both expansion opportunities and churn risk through data analysis and direct relationship insight, and own them through to resolution or close

  • Monitor account health through usage data, adoption metrics, contact network and mapping, and stakeholder engagement

  • Maintain accurate forecasting (renewals, churn, upsell potential) and rigorous CRM discipline (Salesforce accuracy and completeness)

Customer Value & Expertise (40%)

Drive measurable value and position UpSlide as a strategic partner:

  • Lead high-impact Business Reviews focused on ROI and value realization

  • Lead complex or sensitive conversations (renegotiation, escalations, dissatisfaction) with confidence and clarity

  • Secure executive sponsors and build multi-threaded relationships within each account

  • Develop and maintain strong product expertise and a deep understanding of client industries and use cases

  • Craft value-driven narratives tailored to each stakeholder's priorities

Cross-functional Collaboration (10%)

Align with internal teams to maximize customer outcomes and business impact:

  • Partner with Sales on the account expansion strategy and account mapping

  • Collaborate with Professional Services when deeper deployment or training support is needed

  • Work closely with Product and Support to relay structured feedback and improve the customer experience

  • Coordinate with CSMs in other regions on shared or global accounts

  • Contribute to Customer Success best practices and performance improvement initiatives

To work on these tasks, you will mainly use the following tools: Microsoft Office, UpSlide, Salesforce, Gong, PowerBI, and Notion (or local equivalents).

⚡Your goals

You will be assessed on:

  • Net Revenue Retention (NRR)

  • Churn

  • Expansion / upsell contribution

  • Depth and health of executive relationships across your portfolio

  • Ability to maintain full ownership and visibility on shared accounts


You are a great fit if you have:

  • 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a related client-facing/revenue role, including managing enterprise or large, multi-entity accounts in a B2B environment

  • Proven experience managing renewals and churn on strategic / enterprise accounts, with meaningful revenue responsibility

  • A proven track record of generating expansion (upsell/cross-sell) within an enterprise account base

  • Experience in autonomously managing a portfolio of large or multi-entity accounts with significant revenue responsibility

  • Confidence leading executive-level conversations, including complex or difficult ones (renegotiation, dissatisfaction, escalations)

  • Advanced negotiation skills

  • A structured, strategic approach to account planning (objectives, stakeholders, action plans)

  • A value- and ROI-oriented mindset, able to build and defend a business case with senior stakeholders

  • Operational rigor: accurate CRM data, reliable follow-up, dependable forecasting

  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English and French

  • Comfortable working in an international environment, engaging with senior and executive stakeholders

We’d love it if you have:

  • Experience with a CRM / Customer Success platform (Salesforce, Planhat, or equivalent) and analytics / BI tools (PowerBI or equivalent)

  • Knowledge of the financial services/consulting sector

  • Experience managing group or multi-entity account structures

  • Familiarity with SaaS metrics (ARR, NRR, churn, forecasting) and reporting to leadership

  • Fluency in another language (e.g. German)

✨ If you don’t tick all the boxes but you think you’d be a great fit, please apply and tell us why.

Recruitment process

  1. Screening call with Talent Acquisition: A conversation to walk through your experience, motivation, and fit for the role.

  2. Interview with your future manager and a team-meet: A deeper dive into your Customer Success experience and approach to account management. This also includes a live exercise reflecting real challenges of the role, followed by a conversation with members of the wider team.

  3. Final conversation with leadership: A closing discussion to align on ambition, expectations, and next steps.

🚀 We'll conduct a reference check to learn how to help you thrive. On average, our process lasts 3 weeks.

What we offer

🌍 International environment: Start-up with five offices (Paris, London, Berlin, New York, Singapore) and users in more than 60 countries

🌱 Training & professional development: Collaboration with our sister company, IPH, which provides UpSliders with training on key soft skills and management

🎉 Company events: Office socials and international company events (e.g. annual company seminar, team seminar, and sustainability actions taken throughout the year)

🏠 Beautiful office: Office near Opéra (1er arrondissement) – a vibrant space with beautiful common areas and meeting rooms, a nap room, bike storage and showers, tea/coffee, etc.

💻 Hybrid work: A policy adapted to each team’s rhythm

🧑‍💻 Work-from-home budget: €500 WFH equipment budget

💆‍♀️ Wellness package: 50€ per month for physical and mental wellness activities

👶 Family support:

  • Paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents

  • 4 days fully paid leave for sick children up to 6 years old or up to €1,800 for childcare reimbursement

  • Flexible return to work options

  • An additional 5 days are fully paid within 6 months after becoming a parent

✈️ Holidays: 25 vacation days and 9 RTT (with one taken for Solidarity Day)

✅ General:

  • Meal vouchers (Tickets resto): €11 per day on your Swile card (210 tickets per year)

  • Healthcare insurance (Mutuelle): Covered by Alan. You can extend cover to your partner and children

  • Commute (Transports): Metro, RER, bike, or e-scooter - These options are reimbursed 50% by UpSlide

jobs.title: PLC Software Engineer - The Netherlands
jobs.description:
Ready to build the software behind real-world renewable energy installations?

At Bright Renewables, your PLC software doesn’t stay behind a desk. You’ll see it come to life in complex industrial installations for renewable gas and CO₂ technologies.

As a PLC Software Engineer, you’ll be involved in the complete automation lifecycle - from software design and programming to testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and optimization.

You’ll have the opportunity to contribute to technical decisions, help shape our automation standards, and work alongside experienced colleagues as part of an international software engineering team of around 10 engineers. Together, you’ll collaborate across the Netherlands, Latvia, and Poland to develop and deliver reliable, innovative automation solutions.


Why this role?

You’ll get the opportunity to:

  • Own your solutions - contribute to software solutions throughout the project lifecycle, from design and programming to testing and commissioning;

  • Work on real installations - solve automation challenges in complex renewable energy plants;

  • Have technical influence - contribute to software standards, templates, concepts, and ways of working, within a team that values collaboration and embraces innovative ideas from everyone;

  • Keep developing - work alongside experienced Electrical and Software Engineers and continue building your technical expertise;

  • Work internationally - collaborate with colleagues and project teams in the Netherlands, Poland, Latvia and beyond, including regular international travel to visit our offices and project sites;

  • Choose what works for you - work 32 or 40 hours per week, with flexible starting times and opportunities to work from home;

  • Make an impact - use your automation expertise in technologies that contribute directly to the energy transition.

What will you do?

As a PLC Software Engineer, you design, develop, test, and commission PLC and SCADA control systems for technologies such as gas upgrading and CO₂ liquefaction.

You report directly to the Manager E&I and Software and work closely with Electrical Engineers, Process Engineers and fellow Software Engineers.

Depending on your experience, you’ll also have the opportunity to take more technical ownership, contribute to software concepts and standards, and support colleagues with complex automation challenges.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Designing, programming, testing, and commissioning PLC and SCADA systems;

  • Developing control software for gas upgrading, CO₂ liquefaction, and other renewable energy technologies;

  • Taking ownership of your software from engineering through commissioning;

  • Testing and troubleshooting software during commissioning and operation;

  • Analyzing and resolving software and control-related issues in existing installations;

  • Implementing software updates and optimizations;

  • Supporting Service Engineers with more complex automation and software questions;

  • Contributing to software standards, templates, and automation concepts;

  • Working closely with Electrical Engineers, Software Engineers, and other technical disciplines;

  • Sharing knowledge and supporting colleagues within the engineering team.


What do you bring?

We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving technical challenges and wants to take responsibility for their own engineering work.

Ideally, you have:

  • A completed technical education in automation, mechatronics, electrical engineering, computer science, or a related field;

  • Several years of experience in PLC/SCADA engineering within an industrial environment;

  • Hands-on experience in PLC programming, ideally with Siemens S7 and TIA Portal, combined with knowledge of WinCC SCADA, industrial communication networks, and remote access solutions.

  • Experience with commissioning and troubleshooting industrial installations;

  • A good understanding of automation architectures and industrial control systems;

  • Good command of English, both spoken and written;

  • Knowledge of OT security is a plus.

What’s in it for you?

We want to give you the technical freedom and working environment to do your best engineering work.

You can expect:

  • A competitive salary based on your experience and technical background;

  • The option to work 32 or 40 hours per week;

  • Flexible starting times between 7:00 and 9:00 a.m. ;

  • Ample opportunities to work from home, including a one-time €250 allowance to set up your home office;

  • An attractive annual profit-sharing scheme for employees with at least 12 months of service;

  • An excellent pension scheme;

  • 8% annual holiday allowance;

  • A commuting allowance of €0.23 per kilometer, in accordance with our employment conditions;

  • A high level of autonomy and responsibility;

  • Plenty of opportunities for technical and professional development;

  • An international engineering environment with both experienced professionals and engineers earlier in their careers;

  • The opportunity to work with renewable energy technologies and contribute directly to the energy transition;

  • A bike lease program and rewards for cycling to work;

  • A modern, sustainably built working environment in Hengelo.

About Bright Renewables

Bright Renewables develops and delivers technologies for renewable gas and CO₂ capture, providing solutions from engineering and realization through to service and maintenance. Our installations convert biogas into renewable natural gas and capture, purify, and liquefy CO₂ for industrial reuse.

We are part of HoSt Group, a family-owned Dutch company operating internationally in renewable energy technology.

For you, that means working on international projects with the opportunities of a global organization, while keeping the short communication lines, technical freedom, and personal approach of a family-owned company.

Interested?

We’d like to get to know you.

Apply by submitting your CV and motivation through the application button. Within 14 days, we’ll let you know whether we’d like to invite you for an interview.

Would you first like to know more about the technology, team, or day-to-day work?

Contact Wybren Broersma, Manager E&I and Software, or Natalia Wisniewska, Corporate Recruiter, at +31 88 460 90 80.

Build software. See it running. Make an impact on renewable energy.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Who are we?

Gain is the Private Markets Super App, a connected global platform transforming how leading investors, advisors, and corporates source, evaluate, and execute deals. By combining investment-grade intelligence, AI-powered workflows, and proprietary data in one unified platform, Gain enables top deal teams to move faster, reduce risk, and build conviction with confidence.

Gain is trusted across more than $1 trillion of private capital, used by 100% of MBB and Big Four firms, and by 80% of the world’s top 20 M&A advisory houses.

Recognized for fast innovation and impact, Gain has been named both US and EU Data Provider of the Year by PE Wire, awarded Global Financial Market Review’s Best Use of AI in Finance, and ranked in Sifted’s Top 100 Fastest-Growing Companies, the Forbes 1000, and the Deloitte Technology Fast 50. Gain operates globally with offices in New York, London, Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Warsaw, and Bangalore.


How we work

  • Predicting what isn't published. Many private companies publish little or no financial detail. Across a database of more than 5 million companies, we predict revenue and EBITDA from sparse labels, and we predict whether and when a company will be bought or sold, which is a time-to-event problem with censored data.

  • Agents on a messy web. Our agents search, navigate and extract company data points from sources that contradict each other, then decide which source to trust before committing to an answer.

  • Quality that holds while everything underneath moves. We're provider-agnostic. Model choices follow the evals, and we switch LLMs when the numbers say so. That only works if the evals are trusted.

What will you do?

The work is roughly half LLM agents and half custom ML, leaning slightly toward agents.

  • The design of our agent pipelines: architecture, tools, and which model for which task. You'll shape the technical direction with our AI Lead.

  • The evaluation behind agents and models: offline reference sets, live production evals, and the call on whether an improvement is real.

  • Our prediction models for financials and deals: features, validation, retraining, and knowing when a simpler model wins.

  • Getting work into production: trace where pipelines fail and fix the weakest links first, with compute, memory and model cost in view.

  • Raising the bar in the team through design reviews, pairing, and an eval-first habit that sticks.

In your first six months you'll own the evals for our agent pipelines, propose where we invest next, and ship measurable improvements to both the agents and the prediction models.

Who are you?

  • You've built and owned ML systems in production for years, typically 6+ in ML or software engineering.

  • In the last 1–2 years you've shipped LLM agents or pipelines that real users depend on, not demos.

  • You have modelling judgement. You've dealt with leakage, distribution shift and calibration on real data.

  • You measure before you claim. You can build an evaluation set and tell an honest improvement from a lucky one.

  • You care about the user outcome more than the technique. Ideas without a clear customer benefit don't get built here, however interesting.

  • Nice to have: time-to-event modelling, noisy or conflicting data sources, financial or private-company data. No finance background needed.

The team

You'll join our Data & AI team of six and report to Renan, our AI Lead who's been building production models for >10 years. Our engineering team runs the infrastructure, and you shape what runs on it.

The stack

  • Core: Python (async, fully typed with Pydantic) and FastAPI

  • LLMs: multiple providers behind our own provider-agnostic layer, with Pydantic AI for typed agents.

  • Evals and observability: Pydantic Evals and Logfire
