jobs.title: Associate Professor in Public Health: Children and Young People
jobs.description:
At the National Institute of Public Health (NIPH), University of Southern Denmark (SDU), a position as Associate Professor in Public Health is hereby advertised with a focus on interdisciplinary, qualitative studies of children’s and young people’s health and well-being, commencing on 15 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.About your future research environment  

The National Institute of Public Health (NIPH) is part of the University of Southern Denmark and is located in Copenhagen. As a national public health institute, we conduct research to improve public health in Denmark and Greenland. At the same time, we contribute internationally to the development of knowledge, theories and methods in the field of public health.

We offer an inspiring research environment in the heart of Copenhagen with skilled and dedicated colleagues from diverse research and educational backgrounds. Here, you will have the opportunity for academic exchange and further development of your own research areas, as well as participation in national and international networks. The position is anchored in the research group Health Promotion and Interventions, which conducts research on interventions addressing public health issues and works with methodological and theoretical challenges related to the design and evaluation of intervention and implementation studies. Our research concerns children, young people and families, as well as vulnerable and disadvantaged groups, and takes place in a range of settings, including daycare institutions, primary and lower secondary schools, upper secondary education, the healthcare system, municipal services, supermarkets and local communities.  You will actively participate in the daily activities of the research group and work closely with other researchers at NIPH.  

The duties include research, teaching and dissemination within the institute’s areas of expertise, including:  - Children’s and young people’s health, well-being and everyday life- The significance of digital media for children’s and young people’s lives and health- Health promotion and implementation research in daycare institutions, schools and upper secondary education- Interdisciplinary, practice-oriented research and development projects, including process evaluation- Advanced qualitative methods, including ethnography, interviews, focus groups and child-centred approaches- Teaching and supervision at bachelor’s and master’s level, including qualitative methods, children’s and young people’s health, and implementation- Preparation of applications for external funding as well as project management and coordination- Contributions to the further development of the research environment, including method development and research group activities The following qualifications are highly valued:  You have established yourself as a qualified researcher within qualitative methods, children’s and young people’s health, and intervention and implementation research, and you possess strong research and teaching qualifications at a high level. You have a relevant publication profile and extensive experience in disseminating research to researchers, practitioners, and other target groups. You have broad collaborative networks and experience in research collaboration with practitioners. As a person, you are dedicated and possess strong communication skills. You are able to build trusting relationships with students, colleagues, and external partners alike. As a teacher, you communicate up-to-date, relevant knowledge in an engaging, clear and understandable way, and as a supervisor you are skilled, inspiring, and supportive.  Qualifications  - A PhD degree in Public Health, Education, Sociology, Anthropology or a related field- Experience with intervention and implementation research- Documented experience in research on children’s and young people’s health- A strong profile within qualitative research- Experience in collaborating with practitioners, exchanging knowledge and disseminating research- Experience in national and international research collaboration- Documented teaching experience at university level and experience supervising students (e.g. bachelor’s or master's students)- Proficiency in Danish and English at a high level, both orally and in writing- Documented experience with scientific publications within relevant research areas 

Further information regarding the position can be obtained from:  Research Leader Susan Andersen,  mailto:suan@sdu.dk

Terms and conditions of employment  Appointment as an Associate Professor is for a fixed term of three years, commencing on 15 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.Appointment to the position will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state with the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for associate professor as described herein. Please check links for more information on salary (only available in Danish) and taxation.

The person employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a self-organiser.

The assessment and evaluation processShortlisting may be used in the assessment process. Please note that only shortlisted applicants will receive an assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee and the shortlisted applicants will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns them. The committee may request additional information, and if so, it is the responsibility of the applicants to provide the necessary material. Interviews and tests may form part of the overall assessment carried out by the appointment committee.  Based on information from the entire recruitment process, the Head of Institute will decide which applicant is offered the position. 

The application

Applicants are encouraged to read the information "How to apply" before applying. 

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

  • Motivated application

  • Curriculum vitae

  • Master’s degree and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (copy of original + verified English translation)

  • Teaching portfolio

  • Research plan, including an account of your own research and preferably a vision for future research 

  • A complete list of publications

  • Up to six of the most relevant publications. Please attach one PDF file per publication. In cases of co-authorship, a co-author declaration must be submitted as part of the PDF file.

  • Reference letters/references may also be included

  • A statement of other qualifications relevant to the position.

We request files in pdf-format no more than 5 MB per file. All pdf-files must be unlocked and allow merging and may not be password protected. Documents should not contain a CPR number (civil registration number) – in this case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

UPLOAD GUIDE: Motivated application shall be uploaded as ‘Cover letter’, Curriculum Vitae shall be uploaded as ‘CV’. All other documents shall be uploaded as ‘Miscellaneous documents’.

If the application does not meet the requirements mentioned above, the faculty may reject your application without further notice. Applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated.

If you experience technical problems, please contact mailto:hcm-support@sdu.dkApplication deadline 18 November 2026 at 23.59 (CET) 

We recommend that as an international applicant, you take the time to visit Work in Denmark where you will find information and facts about moving to, working and living in Denmark, as well as the International Staff Office at SDU.  The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding society and therefore encourages all qualified candidates, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.  

About SDU  The University of Southern Denmark was founded to create value for and together with society. Whether our contribution comes in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education, or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by nurturing talent and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops, and recruits talented individuals. At the same time, we must ensure consistently high quality in all our activities, which can only be achieved with the right people.  The university’s researchers, teachers, students, managers, and technical-administrative staff constitute the foundation of our success.

jobs.title: Are you a Flight Instructor? Explore Multiple Career Paths at Greybird, no matter your level.
jobs.description:
GreyBird Pilot Academy is expanding and is looking for Flight Instructors to join our team fulltime or parttime in Denmark.

Are you passionate about training and developing the next generation of commercial pilots? Do you thrive in a professional aviation environment where you can combine flight instruction with classroom and simulator-based teaching?

Three profile opportunities

Whether you are a newly graduated or an experienced Flight Instructor, already hold CRI/SPA privileges, or are ready to take the next step through our sponsored development program, we offer exciting opportunities to build your aviation career while helping future pilots achieve their goals:

Career Path 1: Flight Instructor DK summer / Spain winther

About the Role

As a Flight Instructor, your primary responsibility will be delivering flight training onboard our aircraft. Depending on operational needs, you may also conduct simulator sessions and classroom-based theoretical instruction.

You will guide students throughout their training journey and help ensure the highest standards of pilot education.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI

  • Set to have a split base between Denmark in the summer and Spain in the winter

  • Based in either DK or Spain

Read more and apply here

Career Path 2: Flight Instructor – Sponsored CRI/SPA Program

About the Role

This position is designed for pilots who meet the requirements for CRI/SPA training but have not yet obtained the qualification.

As a Flight Instructor, you will deliver flight training, simulator instruction, and classroom teaching while participating in our sponsored development pathway.

Sponsored Development Opportunity

GreyBird will sponsor the CRI/SPA training required for the role if you meet the eligibility criteria below.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for sponsorship for a full-time position based at Aarhus Airport in Denmark, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Experience as PIC on MEP aircraft

  • Meet EASA FCL requirements for:

  • CRI/SPA ME, or

  • IRI MEP

Read more and apply here

Career Path 3: Flight Instructor CRI/SPA/(ME) (fulltime / or flexible planned partime)

About the Role

This position is aimed at experienced instructors already holding CRI/SPA qualifications.

You will primarily conduct flight training and may also deliver simulator and classroom instruction as part of our integrated training programs.

For candidates with these qualifications, GreyBird offers a full-time position or a flexible employment for candidates who are interested in a combination of working as an instructor at GreyBird and an airline job or commute between residence and Aarhus airport.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • CRI/SPA qualification (mandatory)

  • ME qualification (preferred but not required)

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI)

Read more and apply here

Ready for Take-Off?

If you meet the requirements for one of the three career paths, we encourage you to apply for the position that matches your current qualifications.

Join GreyBird Pilot Academy and help shape the future of aviation.

We can’t wait to hear from you.

Relocation: Candidates must be willing to relocate and live within commuting distance of our base in Aarhus, DK fulltime or parttime depending on the position.

jobs.title: Sales Executive - Ready to turn Software/ERP expertise into closed deals? Interform HQ Birkerød, DK or Remote
jobs.description:
The role

Interform builds InterformNG2, an Output Management platform that sits next to the ERP and handles the documents a business runs on: invoices, labels, delivery notes, e-invoicing. When output fails, shipments stop and invoices get rejected. Our customers buy certainty that this never happens.

You will sell InterformNG2 to new customers across Europe - with our core markets in the Nordics, Germany and Austria, Benelux and the UK - typically manufacturing, logistics and distribution companies running ERPs such as Infor, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or IBM i. You own the full sales cycle from first conversation to signed agreement.

There is no BDR team here, but you are not starting from a blank sheet either. We identify the most relevant accounts together, backed by an AI-driven engine that tracks buying signals across our markets. Your job is what happens next: the outreach, the conversations, the proposals and the close.

What you will do

  • Turn qualified target accounts into meetings, pipeline and closed deals across your European territory.

  • Open doors through direct outreach and your own network of ERP consultants, partners and IT decision-makers.

  • Run full sales cycles - qualification, demo coordination, proposal, negotiation, close - in close collaboration with the rest of the commercial team.

  • Work with our partner ecosystem around Infor, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, IBM i and other ERP platforms as a second route to market.

  • Feed what you learn in the market back into how we position and price.

Who you are

  • Driven. You show up every day ready to do your best, and you keep that standard through long sales cycles.

  • Connected in the ERP ecosystem. Ecosystem knowledge is essential in this role: you know at least one major ERP ecosystem in real depth - the partners and implementation consultants in it, how they influence a deal and when to bring them in - and you bring a working network you can call on from day one.

  • Self-starting. You plan your own work, execute without being chased, and deliver.

  • Accountable. You own your number and you follow up - customers can trust that you are always a step ahead.

  • At home in the ERP world. You have sold software or services into environments running Infor, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, IBM i or comparable ERP platforms, and you speak the language of IT managers and operations directors.

  • AI-forward. You already use AI in your daily sales work - research, preparation, follow-up - and want a company that works the same way.

  • A closer. You have proven you can turn outreach into pipeline and pipeline into signed deals - not just manage inbound.

  • Languages: fluent English is required. German, Danish or Dutch on top is a strong advantage - ideally you cover one of our core markets natively.

What we offer

  • A place in a solid company: profitable, in strong growth, and with a large market still ahead of us.

  • A product that is easy to stand behind: more than 4,500 installations worldwide, and customers who stay.

  • A defined category - Output Management - where we compete on depth, not noise.

  • Short decision paths and direct access to management.

  • An AI-driven account-based marketing engine that shows you which companies are in the market - so your time goes to conversations, not list-building.

  • A competitive package that rewards what you close.

About Interform A/S

Interform has built Output Management software since 1987 from our headquarters in Birkerød, Denmark. Our platform, InterformNG2, works with any ERP, any format and any environment - customers change or upgrade their ERP and keep their output running. Our first customer from 1987 is still with us today. Our customer base is international - companies across the Nordics, Germany and Austria, Benelux, the UK and further afield - and our own team works across borders in the same way, with colleagues based in Denmark and Germany. We are a profitable, solidly run company in strong growth, and investment backing supports continued development of the platform.

Practical details

  • Location: our office in Birkerød, Denmark, or remote from anywhere in our European markets - we already have employees working outside Denmark, so a distributed setup is nothing new to us.

  • Travel: limited. Most sales work runs remotely, with occasional customer, partner and event travel.

  • Reports to: our Chief Commercial Officer - you will work alongside the rest of the commercial team.

  • Start: as soon as possible. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

How to apply

Upload your CV and cover letter, including the deals you are most proud of.

Birkerød I Remote

jobs.title: Backend Engineer (Ruby), Create: Change Record
PhD Research Fellowship in Circular Battery Strategies
jobs.description:
About the position

Center for Research on Digitalization and Sustainability (CREDS), part of Inland School of Business and Social Sciences, University of Inland Norway (INN), invites candidates to apply for a three-year PhD research fellowship. The position is connected to the field of innovation studies with a specific focus on sustainability transitions, circular economy, business model change and value chains related to electric vehicle (EV) batteries in the context of energy storage and mobility. This may include research on the circular resource flows, reuse and recycle strategies, and competing end-of-life pathways for batteries and battery materials. 

Admission to INN's PhD program, Innovation in Services in the Public and Private Sectors (INSEPP), is a condition for employment as a research fellow. The candidate is expected to participate actively in INSEPP’s activities. After commencement, the candidate must apply for admission to the PhD programme within three months. An agreement for admission to the PhD programme must be in place within six months after commencement. 

As a PhD research fellow, you will be an integral part of CREDS and actively contribute to one or both of its research groups. In addition, the candidate will be employed at a department of the Business School. The position preferably commences as soon as possible, and will conclude with the award of the Degree of Doctor upon successfully completing the program. 

The position is based at CREDS in Innlandet Science Park in Kongsvinger. A high degree of on-site presence is expected. 

For further information, please contact: 

  • CREDS Professor Johan Kask, +47 62 43 01 82, johan.kask@inn.no  
  • CREDS Director and Professor Bård Tronvoll, +47 90 78 55 68, bard.tronvoll@inn.no  
  • Head of INSEPP PhD Program Marit Engen, +47 61 28 81 07, marit.engen@inn.no 
About the project

Project overview 

The PhD research fellow will join an international team of researchers at CREDS, Inland School of Business and Social Sciences. We seek a highly motivated candidate to research circular battery strategies and future applications from a business and innovation perspective. CREDS’s overarching academic objective is accelerating research on the transitions enabling sustainable businesses and societies. The primary focus is to understand transitions at the level of ecosystems and markets and at the intersection between digitization and sustainability, for instance linked to new or changed business models, value chains and practices. 

The candidate’s PhD project should address how scarce resources in circular value chains related to energy and mobility are organized and governed across competing end-of-life pathways. Relevant topics include sustainable value creation, reuse and repair strategies, recycling systems, and business models that extend the useful life of batteries and battery materials. The project may examine how such arrangements work in practice, how they develop over time, and how different pathways can be assessed in relation to sustainability, loop extension, efficiency, resilience, and other relevant criteria. It may also focus on market formation, ecosystem dynamics, governance arrangements, power relations, and the role of technology in handling resource tensions across systems, as well as on how firms and other actors develop circular strategies under competing demands, regulatory change, and uncertainty about future resource use. One particularly relevant empirical example is end-of-life EV batteries, where tensions may arise between reusing or repurposing batteries for second-life energy storage and recycling materials back into battery production or other industrial uses. Norway provides a promising context for studying such issues due to its early and extensive adoption of battery-electric vehicles. 

Candidates are encouraged to define their own research design within this theme. This includes developing the specific research questions, theoretical perspective, empirical focus, and methodological approach in dialogue with the supervisory team and the academic environment at CREDS. A broad range of methodological approaches is relevant for the theme, including qualitative case studies, optimization models, system dynamics modelling, and agent-based modelling. Please note that the project may later be modified in accordance with the supervisors’ advice and the academic research agenda of CREDS. The successful candidate will have a primary supervisor among CREDS’ academic staff.

Qualifications
  • The candidate must have a master’s degree and thesis on a relevant topic. Relevant academic backgrounds may include business and management, innovation studies, energy systems, industrial ecology, system dynamics, systems modelling, sustainability transitions, science and technology studies, topic-related forms of engineering, and other related interdisciplinary fields. 
  • The master's degree must normally constitute 120 ECTS credits. INN’s PhD regulations require that the qualifying education includes a master’s thesis of 30 ECTS. As a rule, the average grade at master’s level must be B. 
  • The qualifying degree(s) must be awarded from institutions in Norway, the EU/EEA or Switzerland, or from an international institution accredited by AACSB, AMBA and/or EQUIS. Where applicable, candidates should specify such accreditation in the application.
  • Candidates who have not yet obtained the master’s degree at the time of application may apply. In this case, candidates must have submitted their master’s thesis by the application deadline. Temporary transcripts and the master’s thesis must be submitted with the application. The final diploma must be available by the time of employment. 
  • Candidates with a master’s degree from a university abroad must attach “Recognition of foreign higher education” from NOKUT. Instructions for obtaining this assessment are available from NOKUT, https://hkdir.no/en/foreign-education/education-from-outside-ofnorway/recognition-of-foreign-higher-education-bachelor-master-and-phd . 
  • Since the project is likely to involve extensive empirical research, dialogue with practitioners, meetings, and field-based data collection involving Norwegian and other Nordic actors, the ability to work effectively in Nordic industry and institutional contexts will be important. Relevant professional experience from industry or other practice-based settings in the Nordics, or in a comparable context, is therefore considered a strong merit. 
  • Oral and written English is required. Applicants from non-English speaking countries must document their English proficiency in accordance with the Supplementary Regulations for Admission to the PhD Programme at INN University. A command of a Scandinavian language is a strong merit. 
  • Expertise in relevant ICT software for research is an advantage. 
  • Research experience acquired after completion of the master’s degree is considered an advantage, but is not required. 
  • The candidate must be able to work independently and purposefully, and engage confidently with external actors to carry out empirical fieldwork. The role also requires the ability to collaborate well on academic research and publishing.

Evaluation of candidates for the position will be based on a total assessment of educational background, experience and personal suitability, as well as motivation and other eligibility requirements, as defined in the advertisement. In addition, the following will be emphasized: quality of the project description, documented independent research and development work or experience relevant to the project.

The position and associated tasks must be carried out in accordance with the applicable laws and regulations for government employees, including also the Act on Control of the Export of Strategic Goods, Services and Technology, etc. Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, come into conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to take up the position at University of Inland Norway. Necessary approvals must be maintained throughout the employment relationship.

How to apply

Relevant applications will be considered by an expert committee. The application and all attachments are to be submitted electronically and must include the following: 

  • The applicant must submit a project proposal with a progress plan (in Norwegian or English, 5-7 pages) that explains how the research work will be carried out and addresses academic relevance, challenges and possibilities within the project. The PhD research fellow hired will, in collaboration with a supervisor, prepare a complete project proposal creating the basis for admission to the PhD program. The project proposal plays an important part in evaluating applicants and must show how the project will lead to a successful completion of a doctoral degree within three years. 
  • Application letter 
  • CV (summarizing education, job positions, and academic work) 
  • Other work that is relevant for the application 
  • Certified copies of transcripts and diplomas for the whole bachelor and master’s degree. An English translation of all education documents is required unless the documents are in Norwegian/Scandinavian. 
  • Names and contact information of at least 2 reference persons. 
  • A copy of the master’s thesis (in PDF)

Attachments must be uploaded as separate files. If the attachments exceed 30 MB, they must be compressed prior to upload. It is the applicant's responsibility to ensure that all attachments are uploaded. Documents submitted after expiry of the deadline will not be considered in the evaluation of your application.

We offer
  • An academically stimulating and supportive work environment at a developing institution. 
  • Possibility of professional development in an exciting academic research environment. 
  • Position is paid and placed in position code PhD candidate 1017 in the Government Salary Scale. 
  • Membership in the Norwegian Public Service Pension, with among other things, good pension and insurance schemes.

For more information about INN University as an employer, please see here.

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F0FVnszhpJYGeneral information

INN believes that there is strength in inclusion and diversity. We desire employees with different competencies, professional combinations, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to an even better way of solving problems. We will facilitate for employees who need assitance to realise their goals. Relevant adaptations can be, for example, technical aids, adapting furniture or adjusting routines, work tasks and working hours.

If there are qualified applicants with disabilities, gaps in the CV or immigrant background, we shall call at least one applicant in each of these categories for an interview. In order to be considered as an applicant in these groups, the applicants must meet certain requirements. You can read more on this here: https://arbeidsgiver.difi.no/positivsaerbehandling.

We encourage applicants to tick in Jobbnorge if they have a disability, a gap in their CV or immigrant background. The ticks in the jobseeker portal form the basis for anonymised statistics that all state-owned enterprises report in their annual reports

Information about applicants may be made public even if the applicant has asked not to be named on the list of persons who have applied. The applicant must be notified if the request to be omitted is not met.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

University of Inland Norway is home to around 15,000 students and 1,450 employees. We have campuses in Lillehammer, Hamar, Elverum, Rena, Evenstad and Blæstad, and offer some courses at Kongsvinger and Tynset.

INN University is known for strong and enduring academic and research environments that will spearhead regionally, nationally and internationally.  

Our vision is "Stronger together - we build the university in an interdisciplinary community, together with the communities and the industries"

jobs.title: Granlund: Senior Full Stack Developer (C#, React)
jobs.description: **Type**: Full-time, permanent**Location**: Malminkaari 21, 00700 Helsinki**Application deadline**: 26.10.2026Experienced with C#/.NET and React? Join Granlund to take ownership of a growing software platform and shape its future development!**What will you be doing?**Granlund is looking for a **Senior Full Stack Developer** to further develop its Design Data Management (DDM) platform. DDM transforms building information models into structured, usable data for cost, lifecycle, and 4D calculations. The platform is already in production, with new features and use cases actively being explored. Your work will help turn these opportunities into practical solutions for the construction and real estate industry.In this role, you will develop the DDM platform, focusing mainly on C#/.NET backend development and SQL Server, while also working with React and TypeScript on the frontend. You will develop new features end-to-end, improve existing functionality, and propose practical technical and architectural solutions. Your responsibilities will also include maintaining code quality through automated testing and controlled releases.You will collaborate with colleagues across different business areas to develop solutions that address real business needs. Beyond implementing new features, you will evaluate technical feasibility and help prioritize development efforts. Initially, your focus will include turning existing proofs of concept into usable features.**What makes you a great fit?**We are looking for an experienced developer who has a strong background in software development and actively uses AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor. You understand software architecture, can critically evaluate AI-generated code, and enjoy building software.You take ownership of your work and approach development with a practical, business-oriented mindset. You can assess business needs, identify what is worth developing, and suggest technical solutions that make sense. You also know when something is not worth implementing and can explain why.You are comfortable working independently in a small team and collaborating with others to make technical decisions. You don't need previous experience in construction or real estate; we welcome applications from developers across all industries.**We hope you have:**- Several years of backend development experience, ideally with C#/.NET, and strong SQL skills - Experience with React and TypeScript, and the ability to develop frontend features independently - A good understanding of software architecture, clean code, and automated testing - Hands-on experience building software with AI coding agents, and the judgement to review their output - Good communication skills in English or Finnish **We consider as an asset:**- Experience with Python and data processing tools, such as FastAPI, pandas, pyarrow, or IfcOpenShell - Experience working with large language models or developing AI-powered features - Familiarity with Azure services and CI/CD pipelines - Experience combining data from different sources into structured, usable information - Experience in product development, startups, or other environments requiring broad technical ownership. **What does Granlund offer you?**- An opportunity to take ownership of a growing software platform and directly influence its technical development. - Meaningful work turning complex building data into solutions that support smarter and more sustainable construction. - The freedom to shape technical solutions and see your ideas progress from early concepts into working features. - A small, collaborative team within an established company, with potential to grow into product or team leadership. - Flexible remote and hybrid working arrangements that allow you to combine independent development with in-person collaboration. - Comprehensive employee benefits, including occupational healthcare, sports and cultural benefits, and professional development opportunities. **Practicalities**This is a permanent, full-time position, and you will be employed directly by Granlund. The role offers flexible remote and hybrid working arrangements. Still, we hope you are based in the Helsinki metropolitan area or nearby to make it easier to meet in person for collaboration and workshops at Granlund's office in Malmi when needed. We hope you can start as soon as possible, but the exact start date is negotiable.Salary in this position is approximately 6000-8000 €/month. The final salary will be determined based on your experience and expertise. Granlund also offers a company-wide performance bonus scheme.**Recruitment process**- Remote interviews with aTalent - Two rounds of interviews with Granlund, conducted remotely and/or in person **Interested? We'd love to hear from you!**Submit your application and CV in PDF-format latest by the 26th of October via our application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/390936/create/.We review applications throughout the application period in the order they are received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we only accept applications through our recruitment system, not by email.We welcome applicants from different backgrounds and are committed to an inclusive recruitment process. We will accommodate individual accessibility needs whenever possible. You can learn more about Granlund at www.granlund.fi. For more information about the recruitment process contact aTalents Managing Recruitment Consultant Sofia Latva-Koivisto (+358 50 321 4473, sofia.latva-koivisto(at)atalent.fi). If Sofia is unable to answer your call, please leave a text message and she will get back to you.

per 1\. August 2027  
Dein Aufgabengebiet  
abwechslungsreiche dreijährige Ausbildung

verabreichen, Blutzuckermessungen, Injektionen, etc.  
Ausführen von administrativen Arbeiten  
enge Zusammenarbeit im Team und regelmässiger Austausch mit dem/der Berufsbildner:in  
Deine Kompetenzen  
obligatorischer Schulabschluss  
offene, belastbare und freundliche Persönlichkeit,  
die gerne im Team arbeitet  
sorgfältige und verantwortungsbewusste Arbeitsweise  
engagierte und motivierte Person, die den Kontakt mit Menschen schätzt  
Deine Vorteile  
6 Wochen Ferien (Lernende): Als Lernende profitierst du bei uns von 6 Wochen Ferien pro Jahr. So bleibt genügend Zeit zum Erholen, für deine Hobbys und für alles, was das Leben neben der Ausbildung noch so bereithält.  
Halbtages\-Abo (Lernende): Damit du flexibel und stressfrei unterwegs bist, ob auf dem Schulweg oder in der Freizeit, übernehmen wir die Kosten für dein Halbtages\-Abo.  
Vergünstigungen Essen und Sport (Lernende): In unseren Personalrestaurants geniesst du täglich frische Mahlzeiten zu vergünstigten Preisen. Darüber hinaus profitierst du von vergünstigtem Zugang zu unserem Fitnessraum und zu Yoga\-Angeboten für den perfekten Ausgleich zum Berufsalltag.  
Bezahlter Wandertag (Lernende): Einmal im Jahr heisst es: Raus in die Natur! Du darfst auf Arbeitszeit am Wandertag teilnehmen und erkundest gemeinsam mit dem Team die wunderschöne Bergwelt rund um unsere Standorte.  
Wir bieten dir einen abwechslungsreichen und spannenden Alltag in einem gut eingespielten Team. Du erhältst Einblick in verschiedene Wohngruppen und lernst zahlreiche Fachgebiete und Krankheitsbilder kennen. Unsere fachkompetenten Berufsbildner:innen begleiten und fördern dich während deiner Ausbildung professionell. Mehr über die Ausbildung und unsere attraktiven Anstellungsbedingungen erfährst du hier.  
Wir freuen uns auf dich!  
Für Fragen zur Stelle wende dich gerne an Frau Stana Bozic, Leiterin Bildung Langzeitpflege.  
Wir freuen uns auf deine vollständige  
Bewerbung inklusive Schulzeugnisse ab der  
7\. Klasse, Berichte deiner absolvierten Schnupperlehren und falls vorhanden

Deshalb schaffen wir die Voraussetzungen dafür, dass die Arbeitszeit flexibel gestaltet werden kann – mit Angeboten für mobiles Arbeiten, Homeoffice und Teilzeit\-Pensen.**Wir pflegen ein familiäres Umfeld**Die genossenschaftlichen Werte sind unsere Grundpfeiler: Miteinander. * Kaufmännische Ausbildung mit guten Fachkenntnissen in der Buchhaltung und datenbankgestützter Administration, hohe digitale Kompetenz

jobs.description:
Cost Control Chief  


  











Cost Control Chief
==================




  








 **Department:** **Project Controls**



 **Reports to:** **Project Controls Manager**



 **Responsible for:** **Develop and follow up the Cost Controlling System, Control and reporting of cost and budget, Control of committed and realized invoices of manufacturers/ suppliers/ subcontractors and inserting them into the controls system, Controlling cash and bank movements.**



 **Location:** **Construction site office in Beringen**



 **Start Date:**  



 **Employment Type:** **Full time / On Site**



ENKA Investment AG is seeking a Cost Controls Chief for its planned data center project in Beringen, will lead implementation and maintenance of the project cost controlling system, working closely with the Swiss project organization and ENKA’s headquarters in Istanbul.



  ***Required Knowledge and Qualifications***



* Degree in Engineering, Quantity Surverying, Construction Management, or Economics
* 5\+ years cost control / project controls experience on major capital projects; experience on mission\-critical or data\-center facilities strongly preferred
* Construction\- and commissioning\-phase site experience on complex, multi\-discipline projects (high\-voltage electrical, mechanical, civil)
* Proficiency with IFS (ERP) and MMS, plus standard cost\-management and reporting tools
* Proven ability to control committed and realized costs across a large supplier and subcontractor base
* Solid grasp of change and claims management and of internal/external benchmarking for cost estimating
* Professional fluency spoken and written Turkish, English are essential. Turkish is required for daily technical meetings and reporting with ENKA’s Istanbul headquarters; English for the international project team and technical documentation.
* Strong communication, reporting and stakeholder\-coordination skills


  ***Main Duties and Responsibilities***



* Develop, implement and maintain the project cost controlling system
* Control and report project cost and budget across design, procurement, construction, and commissioning
* Prepare cost estimates and programme cost plans supported by consistent internal and external benchmarking data
* Control committed and realised invoices from manufacturers, suppliers, and subcontractors
* Monitor and control project cash and bank movements
* Work with project teams to forecast out\-turn cost, identify cost\-reduction opportunities and drive value\-engineered solutions
* Evaluate Change Notices and Claims together with project teams
* Ensure the coding structure for material requests complies with project requirements
* Maintain back\-up documentation for daily/weekly/monthly cost reports
* Ensure all works comply with QA procedures
* Ensure all works comply with HSE procedures

jobs.description:
Subcontracts Administrator  


  











Subcontracts Administrator
==========================




  








 **Department:** **Procurement and Subcontracts Management**



 **Reports to:** **Business Manager / Construction Manager**



 **Responsible for:** **Effective subcontract formation / administration / closeout; implementation of the project’s subcontract management procedures.**



 **Location:** **Construction site office in Beringen**



 **Start Date:**  



 **Employment Type:** **Full time / On\-Site**



ENKA Investment AG is seeking a Subcontracts Administrator for its planned data center project in Beringen, Schaffhausen. You will manage subcontractors across their full lifecycle, working closely with the Swiss project organization and ENKA’s headquarters in Istanbul.



  ***Required Knowledge and Qualifications***



* 5\-7\+ years experience in subcontracts/procurement administration
* Experience on major construction or infrastructure projects; mission\-critical or data\-center experience an advantage
* Fluency in Turkish and English or German
* Sound understanding of construction industry and of subcontract formation, administration and closeout
* Experience and good command of ENKA’s company document control system EDMS
* Strong negotiation skills and commercial/claims awareness
* Understanding and use of proper business ethics
* Proactive rather than reactive; positive attitude; able to guide junior administrators
* International work experience preferred


  ***Main Duties and Responsibilities***



* Manage assigned subcontractors across their full lifecycle; formation, administration and closeout, in accordance with the project’s Subcontract Management procedures
* Subcontract formation: review service requisitions for completeness, prepare bidder lists, compile and issue ITB packages, process all ITB correspondence, complete commercial and combined bid evaluations, present recommendations to Project Management, and hand over formation files to assigned administrator
* Maintain all electronic subcontract files in an orderly, organized manner
* Monitor correspondence and submittals in the EDMS; ensure replies are sent and received and action items are closed out on time; expedite subcontractor reports and submittals
* Verify acceptable insurance coverage and performance securities are obtained before subcontractor mobilization
* Interface with and train Construction, Engineering and Project Controls teams on subcontract provisions and compliance, and identify opportunities for savings, schedule relief and claim avoidance
* Administer the change process for assigned subcontracts, support preparation and negotiation of changes, administer Change Notices and Variation Orders, and review Technical Queries and Daily Reports for commercial issues
* Coordinate the review and approval of subcontractor progress payments and interrogate payment requests for entitlement issues
* Close out assigned subcontracts in accordance with project procedures

jobs.title: Manager / Senior Manager SAP S/4HANA Technical Transformation, Integration and Clean Core
jobs.description: We are looking for a senior SAP technical transformation leader with deep hands on S/4HANA solution design, integration, data replication and Clean Core experience. In this role, you will shape and deliver complex SAP transformation programs across multinational ERP landscapes, bridging business, functional and technical teams while guiding global delivery teams from assessment and planning through implementation and stabilization. You will act as a trusted advisor to senior clients, helping them define robust SAP S/4HANA landscapes, make sound architecture and integration decisions, improve development quality, and deliver measurable transformation outcomes with practical use of SAP BTP, cloud, automation, analytics and AI enabled SAP capabilities. Role Focus SAP S/4HANA technical transformation, integration architecture, Clean Core, SAP BTP and GenAI/Joule enabled innovation. Your Impact - Lead S/4HANA technical transformation and upgrade programs: Own technical assessments, readiness checks, impact analysis, retrofit strategy, risk strategy, test planning, cutover support and delivery governance for SAP S/4HANA implementations and upgrades. - Shape complex integration and data replication solutions: Design integration concepts between SAP and non SAP systems, including Central Finance, MDG, BW or BW/4HANA, external finance, tax, planning, reporting and CRM applications, using technologies such as SLT, SAP CPI, SAP PO, MuleSoft, IDoc, RFC, AIF and related middleware. - Drive Clean Core and extensibility decisions: Define pragmatic Clean Core approaches for custom code, RICEFW, Fiori, CDS views, AMDP, ABAP developments, SAP BTP extensions, integration patterns and code remediation. - Lead finance transformation technology streams: Support S/4HANA Finance and Central Finance programs across Record to Report, Procure to Pay, Project to Delivery, tax, group reporting, central payments, reconciliation and financial close topics. - Manage global teams and delivery quality: Lead multidisciplinary teams of consultants, developers, architects, client IT and technology partners, including offshore and nearshore delivery models. Establish code guidelines, review processes, quality gates and performance tuning practices. - Bridge stakeholders across business and IT: Align enterprise architects, process owners, functional leads, system owners and program leadership across multiple ERP landscapes and geographies. Create clear decision materials and drive structured issue and escalation management. - Bring innovation into practical SAP delivery: Assess and prototype useful applications of SAP BTP, SAP Business AI, Joule, automation, analytics and data services in real transformation contexts. - Contribute to commercial growth: Lead or support solution shaping, effort estimation, proposal preparation, sales materials, client presentations and commercial discussions for complex SAP opportunities. - Strengthen thought leadership and talent: Develop reusable assets, points of view, technical accelerators, training material and mentoring approaches for SAP technical transformation topics. Your Skill Set - This opportunity is aimed at hands on senior SAP transformation professionals who combine deep technical architecture expertise, consulting leadership and delivery ownership. The profile is suitable for Manager and Senior Manager level candidates who have already led large SAP S/4HANA technical and integration streams in complex client environments. Expected Qualifications - Education: Bachelor or Master degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Informatics, Business Administration with technology focus, or a related field. - SAP technical transformation experience: 10 or more years of experience in SAP technical solution design, S/4HANA implementation, S/4HANA upgrade, ERP modernization, enterprise application advisory or SAP enabled business transformation. - S/4HANA track record: Experience across multiple SAP S/4HANA implementations, upgrades or conversion programs, ideally covering several S/4HANA releases and recent releases such as 2021, 2023 or 2025. - Technical solution design depth: Strong SAP ABAP, RICEFW, CDS, AMDP, Fiori, HANA, performance tuning and debugging expertise, with the ability to review solution quality, guide development teams and define technical standards. - Integration and replication expertise: Proven experience with SAP and non SAP integration, data replication and technical connectivity using SLT, SAP CPI, SAP PO, MuleSoft, IDoc, RFC, AIF, BODS, Information Steward or comparable tools. - Central Finance and finance process exposure: Strong experience in S/4HANA Finance or Central Finance, including FI and CO replication, reconciliation, central payments, tax reporting, group reporting, FSCM or related finance transformation topics. - Clean Core, BTP and cloud mindset: Practical knowledge of Clean Core principles, SAP BTP capabilities, extensibility, cloud adoption and AI enabled SAP innovation. - Large program leadership: Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams, ideally including 20 or more consultants, across geographies, workstreams and delivery partners. - Stakeholder and consulting maturity: Experience managing senior client stakeholders, system owners, architects, functional leads and delivery partners, with clear communication, storytelling, estimation and presentation skills. - Commercial and proposal experience: Ability to support RfPs, solutioning, effort estimates, commercials, client presentations and account growth. - Language skills: Excellent written and spoken English. Desirable Qualifications - SAP certifications such as ABAP, SAP Enterprise Architecture, SAP BTP, SAP Integration Suite, S/4HANA Finance or comparable credentials. - Experience with S/4HANA Public Cloud, SAP Business AI, Joule, SAP Activate and agile delivery approaches. - Experience in multinational SAP landscapes with multiple ERP source systems, ideally more than 10 source ERPs and several countries. - Experience integrating SAP with applications such as Ariba, Salesforce, ONESOURCE, Longview, Bloomberg, CRM, tax reporting or financial consolidation platforms. - Experience in manufacturing, pharma, construction, real estate, finance or complex industrial environments. - German or French skills are a strong plus. - MBA, advanced technology degree or equivalent advisory leadership experience is beneficial. What We Offer - A platform to lead technical transformation in large SAP S/4HANA programs with leading organizations. - The opportunity to shape integration, Clean Core, Central Finance, SAP BTP and AI enabled SAP outcomes. - A collaborative environment with access to SAP, cloud, data, AI and business transformation expertise across PwC. - A role with clear client impact, team leadership responsibility, mentoring opportunities, asset development and contribution to market growth.

Shape the architecture connecting equipment, automation, software, data and enterprise systems, and help our production landscape evolve as one coherent system.

Sensirion is one of the world's leading developers and manufacturers of environmental and flow sensors that improve efficiency, health, safety and comfort in automotive, industrial, medical and consumer electronics applications.

Master's thesis in Reconstructing methanotrophic bacteria communities during the Holocene of an alpine lake (m/f/d)  


  











Master's thesis in Reconstructing methanotrophic bacteria communities during the Holocene of an alpine lake (m/f/d)
===================================================================================================================




  










 



Eawag, the Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology, is an internationally networked aquatic research institute within the ETH Domain (Swiss Federal Institutes of Technology). Eawag conducts research, education and expert consulting to achieve the dual goals of meeting direct human needs for water and maintaining the function and integrity of aquatic ecosystems.





The Department of Surface Waters \- Research and Management ([SURF](/)), in Dübendorf (ZH), has a vacancy for a



Master's thesis in Reconstructing methanotrophic bacteria communities during the Holocene of an alpine lake (m/f/d)
===================================================================================================================





 **Background:** Methane\-oxidizing bacteria (MOB) plays a key role in regulating methane emissions from lakes, yet their past community dynamics under changing environmental and climate conditions remain poorly constrained. Our group studies MOB communities in alpine and peri\-alpine lakes using a combination of lipid biomarker analysis and molecular biology tools. We are now looking for a motivated master's student to apply this approach to a 12\-meter\-long sediment core retrieved from the alpine Lac de Taney (VS).



 **Project description:** This MSc project will reconstruct MOB community composition and dynamics in the Lac de Taney sediment record using specific bacterial lipid biomarkers known as bacteriohopanepolyols (BHP), alongside complementary proxies (e.g., TOC, XRF elemental abundances) and relate these findings to the broader evolution of the lake's biogeochemistry during the Holocene. The Sedimentology Group is part of the Department of Surface Waters and is headed by Prof. , Head of the Department of Surface Waters. The project offers the possibility to shape the specific research questions together, depending on the student's interests.



 **What you will do** 





* Process and subsample the Lac de Taney sediment core (\~50 samples)
* Extract and analyze lipid biomarkers via UHPLC\-Orbitrap\-HRMS
* Perform DNA extraction and prepare samples for 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing
* Interpret multi\-proxy data to reconstruct past microbial community dynamics
* Optionally join a fieldwork campaign at Lake Rotsee to see the full workflow of core retrieval firsthand in October 2026



 **You will gain** hands\-on laboratory experience across a full analytical pipeline spanning organic geochemistry and molecular biology. You will have access to state\-of\-the\-art instrumentation at Eawag Dübendorf, including UHPLC\-Orbitrap\-HRMS, and receive close supervision within an active research group.



 **We are looking for** a student enrolled in an MSc programme at ETH in geoscience, environmental science, biology, or a related field. You have an interest in biogeochemistry, (paleo)limnology, and/or microbial ecology and are willing to work with a range of analytical techniques. No prior experience with mass spectrometry or molecular biology is required.



 **At Eawag,** we have a working environment in which people with different experiences, strengths, and perspectives can fully contribute and further develop. Here, you can help us advance! We promote genuine participation, exchange, and mutual understanding. We create structures that enable the compatibility of work and other areas of life, such as care work, and continuously make efforts to reduce barriers.



Do you have specific requirements regarding the application process or the position, or do you need additional information? Talk to us about it\-we will be happy to support you with possible flexible workplace, working hours, and job design solutions. For further information please visit our website about [Eawag](/) as well as our [conditions](/) of employment.



 **The project is scheduled to start** in the fall semester 2026 with the proposal phase (if required, e.g. D\-EAPS at ETH), followed by the project in the semester 2027\. The exact start date can be discussed. The project has a duration of 6 months. The supervisors are Lorenzo Cellino, PhD student, and Nora Richter, SNSF Ambizione Fellow.



 **Deadline for applications is 30 October 2026 or until the position is filled** and will therefore be evaluated on a rolling basis. Applications should include a very short cover letter (. one page) describing your interests and their relevance to this position, as well as a CV.



For more details on the position, please contact [Write an email](<>) or [Write an email](<>) by email.

jobs.description:
Health Safety Environment Manager / Deputy Health and Safety Manager  


  











Health Safety Environment Manager / Deputy Health and Safety Manager
====================================================================




  








 **Department:** **HSE Management**



 **Reports to:** **Project Manager / Deputy Project Manager**



 **Responsible for:** **providing professional and technical HSE expertise, direction and guidance to the project**



 **Location:** **Construction site office in Beringen**



 **Start Date:**  



 **Employment: Type** **Full time / On\-Site**



ENKA Investment AG is seeking an HSE Manager for its planned data center project in Beringen, Schaffhausen. You will lead site health, safety, and environmental management across construction and commissioning, working closely with local project leadership, subcontractors and ENKA’s headquarters HSE team in Istanbul.



  ***Required Knowledge and Qualifications***



* A degree or recognized professional diploma in occupational health and safety, engineering or a related field.
* At least 10 years of construction HSE experience, including at least 3 years in a leadership role managing HSE personnel and coordinating multiple subcontractors on a major project.
* Experience in energization or commissioning while construction activities were still in progress. A clear understanding of the transition from construction to live systems is essential.
* A working understanding of Civil, Structural and Architectural (CSA) and Mechanical, Electrical and Plumbing (MEP) construction risks, risk assessment, work permits and hazardous energy controls.
* Proven ability to lead investigations, challenge unsafe practices constructively and secure corrective action from project teams and subcontractors under programme pressure
* Professional working proficiency in English and Turkish, spoken and written. (German is a plus for local site coordination), English the international project team, and Turkish daily meetings and reporting with Istanbul headquarters.
* Strong reporting and document management skills, with experience using digital HSE systems and practical performance measures. A site\-based approach and the ability to coach a multicultural workforce are essential.


  ***Main Duties and Responsibilities***



* Lead the project Health, Safety and Environment programme from site mobilization and civil works through mechanical, electrical and plumbing (MEP) installation, energization, commissioning and handover, working with project leadership and ENKA’s headquarters HSE team.
* Develop and maintain the site HSE plan, responsibilities, risk registers and assurance arrangements in line with Swiss requirements, project procedures and applicable client obligations.
* Work with the Design Manager and construction leads to review design and sequencing risks, temporary works interfaces and safe access for installation and maintenance.
* Coordinate subcontractor HSE plans, competence checks, inductions and method statements. Verify that each party controls its own activities and that interfaces between trades are addressed before work starts.
* Monitor high risk construction activities, including excavations, temporary works, lifting operations, work at height, floor openings, steel and façade erection, hot works and confined space entry where applicable.
* Work with electrical and commissioning leads on permit to work, hazardous energy control, lockout/tagout, access restrictions and the separation of live systems from ongoing construction.
* Check that safety arrangements cover heavy plant installation, generators, UPS and battery systems, cooling equipment, pressure testing and associated fuel or hazardous substances, as applicable to the design.
* Maintain a strong site presence through inspections, audits and workforce engagement. Stop unsafe work, escalate significant risks and verify effective corrective action before authorized work resumption.
* Lead incident and near miss investigations, identify underlying causes and track corrective actions to closure. Maintain reliable records and report trends that support prevention and open reporting.
* Coordinate occupational health controls, welfare arrangements and environmental measures, including dust, noise, heat, waste, site water, spill prevention and relevant permit conditions.
* Develop emergency arrangements with site teams and relevant local services; organise drills and confirm that plans remain suitable as construction and commissioning conditions change.
* Coach HSE personnel and subcontractor supervisors, deliver practical briefings and ensure that safety instructions are understood across a multilingual workforce.
* Attend daily coordination meetings with ENKA’s Istanbul headquarters HSE team in Turkish and provide daily risk and action updates, together with regular project performance reports.

Data Center Design Manager  


  











Data Center Design Manager
==========================




  








 **Department:** **Design Group**



 **Reports to:** **Project Manager/Construction Manager**



 **Responsible for:** **Design Coordination and Development throughout the Project including Coordination of shop drawings**



 **Location:** **Construction site office in Beringen**



 **Start Date:**  



 **Employment Type:** **Full time / On Site**



ENKA Investment AG is seeking a Data Center Design Manager for its planned data center project in Beringen, Schaffhausen. You will lead coordinated design delivery across the building and its critical systems, working closely with the Swiss project organization and ENKA’s headquarters design and procurement team in Istanbul.



 **Data Center Design Manager**



The role combines technical leadership, design delivery management and close support to procurement, construction and commissioning.



  ***Required Knowledge and Qualifications***



* A degree in electrical, mechanical, civil, or building services engineering, architecture or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrable professional competence
* At least 10 years of relevant design or construction experience, with proven responsibility for leading multidisciplinary design delivery, including detailed design, construction, commissioning and handover
* Strong knowledge of CSA and critical MEP interfaces, power and cooling resilience, and practical construction requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to lead consultants and specialist designers, manage design deliverables and approvals, and resolve complex interfaces in an international EPC, main contractor or comparable project environment.
* Practical BIM coordination, model review and document control experience, using Navisworks or Solibri, Revit/IFC models and common data environment such as ACC, Aconex or equivalent.
* Commercial and programme awareness, including design scope, procurement interfaces and change control. Sound judgment, clear reporting and the ability to close decisions under construction deadlines.
* Professional fluency spoken and written Turkish, English are essential. Turkish is required for daily technical meetings and reporting with ENKA’s Istanbul headquarters; (German is a plus for local coordination); English for the international project team and technical documentation.


  ***Main Duties and Responsibilities***



* Lead civil structural, architectural and MEP design delivery from the current design stage through procurement, construction, commissioning and handover, coordinating ENKA’s consultants and specialist designers.
* Work daily with ENKA’s headquarters design team in Istanbul. Lead technical meetings in Turkish and provide daily reports on progress, outstanding decisions, design risks and actions.
* Maintain the design management plan, responsibility matrix, deliverables register and programme. Align releases with procurement lead times, construction sequencing and the integrated project schedule.
* Coordinate excavation, temporary works interfaces, foundations and piling where required, concrete, steel, architecture, façades and roofing with equipment loads, installation sequences and building services.
* Integrate critical power and cooling systems, including utility interfaces, transformers, generators, UPS, distribution, cooling plant, pumps and CRAH/CRAC units, together with controls, fire protection, security and ICT pathways.
* Close interfaces for openings, sleeves, shafts, plinths, embedded items, support and fire stopping before construction release. Coordinate structural approvals, maintenance access and equipment replacement routes.
* Lead multidisciplinary reviews and BIM coordination. Resolve technical and spatial issues, record decisions and maintain controlled models, drawings and specifications in the common data environment.
* Manage consultant scopes, technical submittals, RFIs and review comments. Coordinate approved construction information and track overdue inputs, revisions and approvals.
* Integrate vendor and subcontractor design, including employer supplied equipment where applicable. Coordinate technical procurement inputs, long lead equipment interfaces and vendor changes.
* Coordinate compliance reviews and permit submissions with Swiss consultants, authorities and utilities, addressing applicable SIA standards, fire safety requirements and project obligations.
* Assess changes and value engineering with Commercial and Project Controls teams, identifying effects on cost, programme, resilience, safety and operating performance before approval.
* Support side teams with buildability and design issue resolution. Manage design risks, safe access, construction interfaces and incorporation of approved site changes.
* Coordinate with commissioning and operations teams on testability and maintainability. Close design issues arising from factory and site acceptance tests and integrated systems testing.
* Track completion of as\-built records and operation and maintenance documentation. Report design progress, unresolved risks and required decisions through handover.

jobs.title: social- og sundhedshjælperelev hos Carelink Pleje
jobs.description:
Bliv social- og sundhedshjælperelev hos Carelink Pleje

Carelink Pleje søger dig, der vil i gang med – eller allerede er i gang med – uddannelsen som social- og sundhedshjælper. Uddannelsen veksler mellem skole og praktik. Skoleperioderne foregår på den nærmeste Social- og Sundhedsskole i Midt- og Vestjylland. Der er også mulighed for at tage en del af uddannelsen/praktikken i udlandet via en tilknyttet arbejdsplads (kontakt os for mere info og links).

Hvorfor blive elev hos Carelink Pleje?

Siden Carelink Pleje blev etableret, har vores vision været at være det bedste valg inden for pleje og omsorg – også som arbejdsplads. Vores medarbejdere er forudsætningen for glade borgere og en sund organisation.

Det tilbyder vi

  • Spændende og lærerige opgaver og udfordringer

  • Engagerede vejledere og et stærkt fagligt læringsmiljø

  • Oplæringsplads og løn i hele uddannelsen

  • Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst

  • Voksenelevløn kan opnås efter fastlagte kriterier (ring og hør nærmere)

  • Mulighed for at prøve Carelink Plejes forskellige afdelinger i Aalborg og Jammerbugt Kommune

Hvad indebærer en elevplads?

Du får et praktikforløb, der dækker alle oplæringsmål for SOSU-hjælperuddannelsen:

  • Du tilknyttes en vejleder og får løbende råd, sparring og feedback

  • Du får grundig oplæring og følger en faglært medarbejder i praksis

  • Du lærer at udføre personlig pleje og omsorg på et fagligt højt niveau

  • Du øver dig i at være nysgerrig og observerende over for borgerens behov og ressourcer

  • Du opnår viden om rehabiliterende indsatser

  • Du oplever en organisation med kort vej mellem ledelse og medarbejdere

  • Du bliver en del af et godt fællesskab med kompetente kolleger

Vores forventninger til dig

  • Du er mødestabil, velsoigneret, venlig og imødekommende over for borgere og kolleger

  • Du når oplæringsforløbets mål under vejledning og deltager aktivt i fællesskabet

  • Du tager ansvar for din egen læring og deler viden med kolleger

  • Du taler, læser og forstår dansk på et middel højt niveau

  • Du har kørekort (B) og ren straffeattest.

Praktiske oplysninger

  • Elevstilling på 37 timer ugentligt

  • Uddannelsens varighed: Grundforløb 20 uger + SOSU-hjælperuddannelsen 14 måneder

  • Løn under uddannelse (uddannelsesaftale)

  • Weekend og aften arbejde kan variere i løbet af uddannelsen

  • Løbende opstart – Carelink Pleje følger skolernes skole-/oplæringsforløb

  • Mulighed for at starte som afløser/ufaglært inden uddannelsesstart

Ansøgning og kontakt

Send din ansøgning, CV og relevante bilag

Har du spørgsmål til uddannelsen, er du velkommen til at kontakte:

  • Driftschef Birthe Rex, på hverdage kl. 10.00–14.00, tlf. 98 180199

Vi læser ansøgninger og indkalder til samtaler løbende. Vi forbeholder os retten til at lukke opslaget, når de rette kandidater er fundet.

Såfremt du har spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte

Ansøgningsfrist:Løbende

Søg stillingen

jobs.title: Carelink Pleje Aalborg søger social- og sundhedshjælper til dagvagt
jobs.description:
Carelink Pleje Aalborg søger social- og sundhedshjælper til dagvagt

Tænk på en arbejdsdag, hvor du bruger størstedelen af din tid på at skabe tryghed og livskvalitet for borgere i deres eget hjem. Her hjælper du med daglige behov og opbygger relationer, der gør en positiv forskel i deres liv. Lyder det som noget for dig? Hvis ja, så læs videre – måske er du Carelink Plejes nye dagvagt i Aalborg-afdelingen.

Hvorfor vælge Carelink Pleje som din nye arbejdsplads?

  1. Du træder ind i en vigtig rolle, hvor du bidrager til at skabe tryghed og omsorg i borgernes hverdag. Hos Carelink Pleje får du mulighed for at sætte dit præg på den lokale hjemmepleje og den måde, vi skaber livskvalitet for mennesker på.

  2. Du kommer tæt på de borgere, vi hjælper. Med din faglige ekspertise og omsorg kan du gøre en mærkbar forskel i deres liv. Sammen med borgerne finder du løsninger, der passer til deres individuelle behov og ønsker.

  3. Du bliver en del af et stærkt fællesskab med kollegaer, der brænder for omsorg og nærvær. Vi støtter hinanden, sparrer om udfordringer og fejrer de succeser, vi skaber sammen. For os er samarbejde nøglen til at lykkes – hver dag.

  4. En fleksibel arbejdsplads, hvor vi forstår, at livet skal hænge sammen. Har du brug for en løsning, der matcher din hverdag, finder vi ud af det sammen. Vores værdier er initiativ, omtanke, fællesskab og nr. 1 i service – det gør os til en arbejdsplads, der tager hensyn til dig som menneske.

Dine tre vigtigste arbejdsopgaver:

  1. Omsorg og pleje i borgernes hjem (ca. 70%)

  2. Du spiller en central rolle i borgernes hverdag ved at levere omsorg og støtte, som gør en reel forskel for deres livskvalitet. Du sørger for, at den rette hjælp gives til rette tid, så borgerne føler sig trygge og godt tilpas i deres eget hjem. Dette omfatter personlig pleje, praktisk hjælp og nærværende samtaler. Din gode kommunikationsevne og empati gør dig til en afgørende støtte for borgerne.

  3. Koordination og samarbejde (ca. 25%)

  4. Du samarbejder tæt med kollegaer, pårørende og andre fagfolk for at sikre høj kvalitet i plejen og servicen. Du koordinerer indsatsen på tværs af interessenter og sikrer, at borgernes individuelle behov opfyldes med omtanke og kvalitet. Dette indebærer løbende dokumentation og opfølgning for at leve op til vores værdier om at være nr. 1 i service.

  5. Køretid mellem borgerne (ca. 5%)

  6. En del af din arbejdsdag vil inkludere transport mellem borgernes hjem. Vi giver dig de nødvendige ressourcer og værktøjer, så du kan koncentrere dig om det vigtigste – at gøre en forskel for borgerne. Du skal have gyldigt kørekort, og om nødvendigt kunne stille egen bil til rådighed.

For at være en succes i stillingen er det vigtigt:

  1. At du er uddannet social- og sundhedshjælper eller social og sundhedsassistent.

  2. Stillingen er på 30-35 timer ugentligt og inkluderer arbejde hver 2. weekend.

  3. Vi søger en person, der kan arbejde selvstændigt, men som også trives i et fællesskab, hvor vi løfter i flok og leverer service på højeste niveau.

  4. Hos Carelink Pleje er vores mission klar: "Vi skaber rammerne for livskvalitet og et værdigt liv" – og vi søger en medarbejder, der brænder for at bidrage til dette hver dag.

Hvad får du mere ved at arbejde hos Carelink Pleje?

  • Faciliteter: På kontoret finder du kaffemaskine med kaffe, kakao og te

  • Aftaler og overenskomst: Vi følger overenskomsten med FOA , så du kan være tryg ved, at dine arbejdsforhold er ordentlige og fair. Derudover bliver du tilknyttet en privat sundhedsforsikring.

Har du brug for yderligere oplysninger, kan du kontakte Driftschef Birthe Rex alle hverdage mellem kl. 10:00-14:00 på tlf. 98180199.

Vi læser ansøgninger løbende og indkalder til samtaler, når den rette kandidat findes. Vi forbeholder os retten til at lukke stillingsopslaget, når stillingen er besat. Stillingen ønskes besat hurtigst muligt.

jobs.title: Farmworker piggery
jobs.description:
Farmworker with interest for piggery

  • Interests in pigs and and eager to achive knowlegde about animal wellfare

  • Have practical skills – are able to see when technical issues need to be taken care of, and best is, if you know something about technical matters ( animal care is first job)

We offer:

  • A position with influence, where you can help shape your role.

  • A workplace with skilled colleagues and a focus on well-being – for both people and animals.

  • Housing and salary according to qualifications.

  • Schooling about medication and caring about pigs

  • Free acces to swimstadions and bowling (and other activities)

  • Non smoking workplace

  • All needed workclothes ( and we wash them too)

  • Good staff kitchen, with all cooking facilities incl. free coffee, tea and hot chocloate.

About you: Interested in pigfarming, hardworking, social and english speaking. Danish class available.

About us:We are located in 6870 Ølgod, where we have run our family farm since 1947. Our goal is to create a great place to work, where the pigs thrive and where there is room for both family and leisure time. We could tell you much more, but we would rather meet you informally to give you an insight into our way of running a modern farm/sow herd.

We look forward to welcoming you.

International enviroment with workers from different countries.

International enviroment with workers from different countries.

Our farm is a family farm, which does not only means that the farm has been owned by same family in generations, but also that working in our farm is like to work in a big family. We value working together with responsibility for each and everyone, taking care of eachother, helping each other when things get difficult. But always with first priority of animal wellfare for our pigs

We are looking for someone to join our team, who are willing to do rutine work at our farm like washing with highpressure, feeding , cleaning. When you start working here, you need to take a "Medicine Course Diploma" involving: legislation, animal welfare, disease diagnosis, use of veterinarydrugs, injection techniques, euthanasia, castration of pigs, and post mortem examination. This is a diploma paid and arrranged by our company.

We are an international farm with people employed here from 6 different countries. We expect you to talk a minimum of english and to understand even better. Your colleaques are from 20 years of age till 72 years old.

We provide living at a nearby farmhouse, where you will have your own room in a shared house.

Working hours 37 pr. week. Salary agreed depending on your skills and experience. We welcome all.

No smoking.
